title.en: World Desk
title.zh: 全球焦点

strap.en: A fast view of global affairs, conflict, diplomacy, and human need.
strap.zh: 快速掌握国际局势、冲突、外交与人类处境。

title.en: Trump blasts decision that blocks mail-in voting executive orders: ‘This court has really let our country down’ – live
title.zh: 特朗普抨击阻止邮寄投票行政命令的裁决：“这个法院真的让我们的国家失望了”——直播

summary.en: The president called mail-in voting – which he has used on several occasions to cast a ballot – ‘a laughing stock’ across the world. The Supreme Court rejected Trump’s mail ballot restrictions for midterm elections. Kash Patel, the FBI director, is now testifying before lawmakers on the Senate judiciary committee. A...
summary.zh: 总统称邮寄投票——他本人曾多次使用此方式投票——是“全世界的笑柄”。最高法院驳回了特朗普对中期选举的邮寄选票限制。联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔（Kash...

body.en: The president called mail-in voting – which he has used on several occasions to cast a ballot – ‘a laughing stock’ across the world Supreme court rejects Trump’s mail ballot restrictions for midterm elections Sign up for US Breaking News emails Kash Patel , the FBI director, is now testifying before lawmakers on the Senate judiciary committee. A reminder that the last time he appeared before Congress was in May, when he sparred with senators on the appropriations committee and denied – under oath – allegations of excessive drinking and unexplained absences on the job, dismissing them as “baseless” during a fiery congressional hearing. Today’s hearing is also expected to be full of heated exchanges. “Mr Patel is the least qualified and most partisan FBI director in our nation’s history,” said Senator Dick Durbin, the judiciary committee’s top Democrat. “The bureau has been reshaped as a political weapon against President Trump’s political enemies and a shield to protect the president and his MAGA loyalists, not the American people.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 总统称邮寄投票——他曾多次使用这种方式进行投票——在全世界都是“笑柄”。最高法院驳回了特朗普对中期选举的邮寄选票限制。联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔目前正在参议院司法委员会的议员面前作证。提醒人们，他最后一次出现在国会是在五月份，当时他与拨款委员会的参议员发生争执，并在宣誓后否认了有关过度饮酒和不明原因缺勤的指控，并在一场激烈的国会听证会上驳斥称这些指控“毫无根据”。今天的听证会预计也会充满激烈的交流。 “帕特尔先生是我们国家历史上最不合格、最具党派倾向的联邦调查局局长，”司法委员会民主党领袖、参议员迪克·杜宾(Dick Durbin)说。 “该局已被重塑为对抗特朗普总统政敌的政治武器，以及保护总统和他的 MAGA 忠诚者而不是美国人民的盾牌。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The Supreme Court's decision to reject restrictions on mail-in voting, despite the president's strong objections, underscores the importance of due process and considering all arguments. Proverbs 18:17 reminds us that "The first to present his case seems right, till another comes and questions him." This principle encourages careful deliberation and hearing...
reflection.zh: 最高法院驳回对邮寄投票限制的裁决，尽管总统对此强烈反对，这凸显了正当程序和考虑所有论点的重要性。《箴言》18:17 提醒我们：“先诉的似乎有理，直到对方来到，把他审问清楚。”这一原则鼓励在得出结论之前进行仔细审议并听取多方观点，即使在表达强烈意见的情况下也是如此。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Leader of Reform UK in Wales stands down after arrest on suspicion of assault
title.zh: 英国改革党威尔士领导人因涉嫌袭击被捕后辞职

summary.en: Dan Thomas, the leader of Reform UK in Wales and a former Tory councillor, is stepping down after being arrested and bailed on suspicion of assault and coercive or controlling behavior. He was announced as Reform UK's Welsh leader in February and elected to the Senedd in May.
summary.zh: 英国改革党威尔士领导人、前保守党议员丹·托马斯因涉嫌袭击及强制或控制行为被捕并获保释后，已宣布辞职。他于二月被奈杰尔·法拉奇宣布为改革党威尔士领导人，并于五月当选为议会成员。

body.en: Dan Thomas, a former Tory councillor, was elected to Senedd as leader of the opposition in May The leader of Reform UK in Wales is standing down after he was arrested and bailed on suspicion of assault and coercive or controlling behaviour. Dan Thomas, a former Tory councillor, was announced as Reform UK’s Welsh leader by Nigel Farage in February. He was elected to the Senedd as leader of the opposition in May’s election. Continue reading...
body.zh: 前保守党议员丹·托马斯 (Dan Thomas) 今年 5 月当选为参议院反对党领袖。威尔士改革英国领袖丹·托马斯 (Dan Thomas) 因涉嫌袭击和胁迫或控制行为而被捕并保释，目前正在辞职。前保守党议员丹·托马斯 (Dan Thomas) 于二月被奈杰尔·法拉奇 (Nigel Farage) 任命为改革英国的威尔士领导人。在五月的选举中，他作为反对党领袖当选为参议院议员。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of Dan Thomas's arrest on serious charges brings to mind the biblical imperative to defend the vulnerable. Allegations of assault and coercive behavior strike at the heart of human dignity and safety, reminding us of the need for justice and protection for all, especially those who might be oppressed.
reflection.zh: 丹·托马斯因严重指控被捕的消息，令人联想到圣经中保护弱者的诫命。袭击和强制行为的指控触及人类尊严和安全的核心，提醒我们必须为所有人伸张正义并提供保护，特别是那些可能遭受压迫的人。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: UK retirees with no other income will not pay tax on new £13,000 state pension, No 10 says
title.zh: 英国退休人员若无其他收入，新养老金将免税，唐宁街表示

summary.en: The government has pledged to exempt retirees from paying taxes on the full amount of the new state pension. This assurance follows official data indicating an inflation-beating increase above the tax-free personal allowance, driven by a 3.9% rise in average wages over three months to July, which signals a similar...
summary.zh: 政府承诺将免除退休人员缴纳全额新州养老金税款的义务。此项保证是在官方数据显示，在截至7月的三个月内平均工资上涨了3.9%之后提出的，这预示着在“三重锁定”机制下，养老金将在2027年获得同等幅度的增长，超过免税个人所得税额度。

body.en: Average wages rose by 3.9% in three months to July, signalling pensioners will receive uplift of same percentage in 2027 under triple lock The government has promised retirees they will be excluded from paying tax on the full new state pension after official figures paved the way for an inflation-beating increase above the tax-free personal allowance. Figures published on Tuesday showed that average UK wages rose by 3.9% in the three months to July, signalling that pensioners will receive an uplift of the same percentage next year under the triple lock . Continue reading...
body.zh: 截至 7 月份的三个月内，平均工资上涨了 3.9%，这表明养老金领取者将在 2027 年在三重锁定下获得相同百分比的涨幅。政府已向退休人员承诺，在官方数据为高于免税个人津贴的通胀增长铺平道路后，他们将被排除在缴纳全额新国家养老金税之外。周二公布的数据显示，截至 7 月的三个月内，英国平均工资上涨了 3.9%，这表明养老金领取者明年将在三重锁定下获得相同百分比的涨幅。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The government's commitment to protect retirees from taxation on their state pension highlights a fundamental duty of governance: to care for its citizens, especially those in their later years. Jeremiah 22:3 calls for rulers to "execute justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers violence." While this story is...
reflection.zh: 政府承诺保护退休人员免缴州养老金税款，这凸显了治理的一项基本职责：关怀其公民，特别是老年人。耶利米书22:3呼吁统治者“施行公平和公义，拯救被压迫者脱离压迫者的手。”虽然这个故事涉及财政政策，但它触及了国家确保其人民获得一定程度的安全和尊严的责任。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Pensioners just above threshold shouldn’t pay income tax, says No 10 – UK politics live
title.zh: 法拉奇称，如果工会阻碍 7200 万英镑捐款，改革党政府将停止工会资助工党——英国政治直播

summary.en: Reform UK party leader Nigel Farage claims proposed retrospective laws are unfair and that his party would retaliate with a crackdown on union funding if elected. This statement comes amid discussions about trade union donations to the Labour party and multi-million pound donations to Reform UK from cryptocurrency...
summary.zh: 英国改革党领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇声称，拟议中的溯及性法律不公平，如果他领导的政党当选，将通过打击工会资金来报复。此番言论是在讨论工会向工党捐款以及加密货币亿万富翁向英国改革党捐赠数百万英镑的背景下发表的。商业大臣乔纳森·雷诺兹则认为，工会的捐款代表着成千上万普通民众的贡献，而非单一实体的捐赠。

body.en: PM’s spokesperson says those whose only income is the state pension should not pay income tax in this parliament despite the expected rise to £13,000 The Liberal Democrats have said that they will try to introduce a cap on the amount people donate to political parties by amending the representation of the people bill as it goes through the Lords. Lisa Smart , the Lib Dem Cabinet Office spokesperson, said: We can’t keep playing whack-a-mole with each new attempt by Farage to sell out our democracy. Labour’s residency requirements aren’t good enough and the Conservatives simply sat on their hands whilst in power. For decades governments of both colours have stood by and done nothing. The scale of donations made to Reform in recent days is unprecedented in British politics and should deeply concern anyone who cares about the health and integrity of our democracy. We cannot afford to see the Americanisation of our politics, with out of control political spending, funded by stratospheric sums of crypto and corporate cash. These donations show clearly whose side Reform are on, with crypto billionaires, foreign and powerful corporate interests lining up to pour in eye-watering sums of money to advance their agendas. Continue reading...
body.zh: 该党领导人声称，提议的新追溯法是不公平的，如果当选的商务部长乔纳森·雷诺兹今天早上代表政府进行媒体采访，改革将通过打击工会资金进行报复。当被问及工会向工党的捐款类似于加密货币亿万富翁向改革英国捐款的数百万英镑的说法时（参见上午 9 点 09 分），雷诺兹声称将它们视为等同的说法是错误的。他告诉时代广播电台：当我们谈论或人们谈论工会捐款时，那不是一个实体。那是数以万计的普通人选择进行的捐款，并且是由工会捆绑并提供的。但很容易选择不这样做。有管理政治资金、政治选票的规则。老实说，我认为将这些超级加密货币改革捐助者与选择向政治体系捐献一些钱的劳动人民自愿协会进行比较，我认为这两件事没有可比性。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Political discourse often devolves into threats of retaliation, where proposed actions are met with counter-threats. This cycle can obscure the fundamental call for justice and fairness. The prophet Micah reminds us that true leadership involves acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with Yahweh, principles that should guide all public life.
reflection.zh: 政治言论常常陷入相互报复的威胁之中，一项提议的行动会招致反击。这种循环可能会掩盖对公正和公平的基本呼吁。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的领导力在于秉持公义、喜爱怜悯、谦卑同行于雅伟，这些原则应当指导所有公共生活。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: British woman abducted in Malawi, police say
title.zh: 马里警方称一名英国女子被绑架

summary.en: A British woman, Nusrat Osman, 47, was abducted in the main city of Blantyre, Malawi, by four men. Police are investigating and have offered a reward for information leading to her rescue and the prosecution of those responsible. Her husband is reportedly in anguish.
summary.zh: 一名名叫努斯拉特·奥斯曼（Nusrat Osman）的47岁英国女子在马拉维主要城市布兰太尔被四名男子绑架。警方正在调查此事，并悬赏提供线索以营救她并起诉肇事者。据报道，她的丈夫对此失踪感到痛苦。

body.en:
Police in Malawi are investigating the kidnapping of a British national who was abducted in the southern African nation's main city, Blantyre.

Nusrat Osman, 47, was seized at around 12:30 local time on Friday by four men who had been travelling in a grey Nissan Dualis, according to a police statement.

The authorities have offered a reward of more than $17,000 (£12,600) for "credible information" that could lead to the rescue of the mother of two young children and the prosecution of the perpetrators.

A Malawi news outlet reported that Osman's husband was in anguish about the disappearance.

"I don't know where she is or how she is. My wife is an auditor and I have no issues with anyone," he was quoted by Nyasa Times as saying.

Police said the motive behind the abduction was unknown and that so far the kidnappers have not contacted the victim's family or the authorities.
body.zh: 马拉维警方正在调查一名英国国民在该南部非洲国家主要城市布兰太尔被绑架的事件。 警方声明称，47 岁的努斯拉特·奥斯曼 (Nusrat Osman) 于当地时间周五 12:30 左右被四名驾驶灰色日产 Dualis 的男子抓获。 当局悬赏超过 17,000 美元（12,600 英镑），奖励“可靠信息”，以营救两个幼儿的母亲并起诉肇事者。 马拉维一家新闻媒体报道称，奥斯曼的丈夫对失踪事件感到痛苦。 “我不知道她在哪里，也不知道她怎么样。我的妻子是一名审计员，我和任何人都没有问题，”《尼亚萨时报》援引他的话说。 警方表示，绑架动机尚不清楚，到目前为止，绑匪尚未联系受害者的家人或当局。

reflection.en: The abduction of Nusrat Osman, a mother of two, in broad daylight is a stark reminder of the dangers that can befall anyone, anywhere. In such moments of crisis and anguish, the call to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves becomes urgent. May those responsible be brought to justice and Nusrat be returned safely to her family.
reflection.zh: 努斯拉特·奥斯曼（Nusrat Osman）是一位有两个孩子的母亲，她在光天化日之下被绑架，这 stark地提醒我们危险可能降临在任何人、任何地方。在这样的危机和痛苦时刻，为那些不能为自己发声的人发声的呼召变得紧迫。愿肇事者被绳之以法，努斯拉特能安全地回到家人身边。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Ash from Mount Etna grounds flights at Sicily airport
title.zh: 埃特纳火山灰导致西西里机场航班停飞

summary.en: All flights have been suspended from Catania International Airport in Sicily until Tuesday night due to volcanic ash from Mount Etna, Europe's tallest active volcano. This is the second such closure in recent months, with the observatory issuing a red aviation alert.
summary.zh: 由于欧洲最高的活火山埃特纳火山喷发出的火山灰，西西里岛卡塔尼亚国际机场的所有航班已暂停至周二晚间。这是近几个月来该机场第二次因火山灰停飞，火山台已发布红色航空警报。

body.en:
All flights have been suspended from one of Italy's busiest airports because of volcanic ash released from nearby Mount Etna.

It is the second time in recent months that Catania International Airport, on the island of Sicily, has stopped flights due to emissions from Etna, which is Europe's tallest active volcano and erupts frequently.

Airport officials said arrivals and departures, which were first halted on Monday, would be suspended until 22:00 (20:00 GMT) on Tuesday.

Ongoing activity at Etna prompted the INGV Etneo Observatory to issue a red aviation alert on Monday.

In a statement on its website on Tuesday, Catania - Italy's fifth-busiest airport by passenger traffic - said further updates would follow.

It also advised passengers due to fly from Catania to check with their airline for updates before travelling to the airport.

Catania, which usually serves about 12 million passengers each year, was closed for almost a week during the peak summer season last month because of volcanic activity.

There have been calls for the airport to shut and other facilities in Sicily to be expanded because of its proximity to Etna.

The volcano, which stands at 3,324 metres (10,906ft), is about 40km (25 miles) away from the airport.

Despite air traffic disruption, August's eruption drew large crowds of onlookers to Etna's lava flows. About 1.5 million people visit Etna every year.
body.zh: 由于附近埃特纳火山释放的火山灰，意大利最繁忙的机场之一的所有航班已暂停。 这是西西里岛卡塔尼亚国际机场近几个月来第二次因埃特纳火山喷发而停止航班。埃特纳火山是欧洲最高的活火山，经常喷发。 机场官员表示，抵达和出发航班于周一首次停止，随后将暂停至周二 22:00（格林威治标准时间 20:00）。 埃特纳火山正在进行的活动促使 INGV 埃特内奥天文台于周一发布红色航空警报。 意大利客流量第五繁忙的机场卡塔尼亚周二在其网站上发表声明称，随后将进行进一步更新。 它还建议从卡塔尼亚起飞的乘客在前往机场之前向航空公司查询最新情况。 卡塔尼亚通常每年接待约 1200 万名乘客，但上个月夏季高峰期间，由于火山活动，该机场关闭了近一周。 由于靠近埃特纳火山，有人呼吁关闭西西里岛机场并扩建其他设施。 该火山海拔 3,324 米（10,906 英尺），距机场约 40 公里（25 英里）。 尽管空中交通中断，八月的火山喷发还是吸引了大量围观者观看埃特纳火山的熔岩流。每年约有 150 万人参观埃特纳火山。

reflection.en: Mount Etna's eruption has disrupted travel and daily life in Sicily, reminding us that even the most powerful human endeavors are subject to the forces of nature. In times of such disruption, Psalm 46:1 offers comfort, reminding us that God is our refuge and strength, a present help in times of trouble.
reflection.zh: 埃特纳火山的喷发扰乱了西西里岛的交通和日常生活，提醒我们即使是最强大的人类活动也受制于自然的力量。在这样的动荡时期，《诗篇》46:1 提供了安慰，提醒我们上帝是我们的避难所和力量，是患难中随时的帮助。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: What weapon could the US have put into space?
title.zh: 美国可能在太空中部署了什么武器？

summary.en: The US has announced the deployment of a space weapon in Earth's orbit, sparking questions about the nature of such weaponry and its role in the competition among major powers for dominance in space. The US Air Force Secretary stated the weapon is necessary for safeguarding US forces but provided no further details.
summary.zh: 美国宣布已在地球轨道上部署了一件太空武器，这引发了关于此类武器性质及其在大国争夺太空主导权中所扮演角色的疑问。美国空军部长表示，该武器对于保护美军免受敌方敌对行动的侵害是必要的，但未提供任何进一步的细节。

body.en:
The announcement by the United States that it has deployed a space weapon in Earth's orbit has raised questions about what weaponry is actually in space, and what role it could play in efforts by great powers to dominate that arena.

Washington has given away little in its announcement. Secretary of the Air Force Troy Meink said the "on orbit" weapon was necessary to safeguard US forces against hostile enemy action, but gave no details about the weapon's capabilities or when it was put into orbit.

So what could this weapon be, and what is wider picture like for military developments in space? Who else could have similar weaponry?

Advanced militaries already deploy satellites in space for range of purposes, from supplying secure communications to reconnaissance, and providing precise location information for targeted strikes and detecting missile launches.

As warfare become more technologically advanced, analysts expect the use of military hardware in space to increase.

Dr Bleddyn Bowen, an associate fellow in military sciences at the Royal United Services Institute and associate professor in astropolitics at Durham University, said he was only able to hazard a guess about the weapon announced by the US.

"I would expect there to be some kind of electronic warfare or radio-jamming platform, possibly, this would be a non-destructive kind of anti-satellite weapon," he told BBC Radio 4's Today programme.

Such weaponry already exists on Earth and can disrupt satellite communications, he said. "If you take out the radio links then your satellite is very useless."

Bowen also would not rule out some sort of more disruptive and riskier weaponry, which could create a lot of debris and destruction.

"Less likely would be a kinetic kill vehicle of some sort, so a vehicle that would release a projectile of some sort that could ram into a satellite and destroy it," he said.

"Possibly some sort of close inspection and grappling satellite would be another possibility as well."

But while the weapon placed in orbit appears to be a first, the US - and indeed its Russian and Chinese rivals - have had weapons that can be pointed and shot into space for some time.

In fact in the last 10 years, Russia and China have been doing a lot more manoeuvres in space, known as rendezvous and proximity operations (RPOs) - "buzzing" Western satellites.

"Theoretically, these RPO sats can become hunter-killer satellites by physically colliding with them or by nudging them out of orbit," Dr Rod Thornton, reader in Russian Defence and Security Studies at King's College, London, told the BBC.

Bowen adds that the Chinese have demonstrated "space tug capability", saying: "A vehicle can go up to a satellite, can grapple it and move it into a different orbit."

body.zh: 美国宣布在地球轨道上部署太空武器，引发了人们的疑问：太空中到底有哪些武器，以及它在大国主导太空领域的努力中可以发挥什么作用。 华盛顿在声明中没有透露太多信息。美国空军部长特洛伊·梅克表示，“在轨”武器对于保护美军免受敌方行动是必要的，但没有透露该武器的能力或何时进入轨道的详细信息。 那么这种武器会是什么？太空军事发展的更广阔前景是怎样的？还有谁能拥有类似的武器？ 先进军队已经在太空中部署卫星用于多种用途，从提供安全通信到侦察，以及为有针对性的打击和探测导弹发射提供精确的位置信息。 随着战争技术变得更加先进，分析人士预计太空军事硬件的使用将会增加。 英国皇家联合军种研究所军事科学研究所副研究员、杜伦大学天体政治学副教授布莱丁·鲍文博士表示，他只能对美国宣布的这种武器进行大胆猜测。 “我预计会有某种电子战或无线电干扰平台，这可能是一种非破坏性的反卫星武器，”他告诉英国广播公司第四台“今日”节目。 他说，这种武器已经存在于地球上，并且可以扰乱卫星通信。 “如果你去掉无线电链路，那么你的卫星就毫无用处了。” 鲍文也不排除某种更具破坏性和风险性的武器，这可能会造成大量碎片和破坏。 他说：“不太可能是某种动能杀伤飞行器，因此可以释放某种射弹，撞击卫星并摧毁它。” “也许某种近距离检查和擒抱卫星也是另一种可能性。” 不过，虽然这种进入轨道的武器似乎是首创，但美国——实际上还有俄罗斯和中国的竞争对手——拥有可以瞄准并射入太空的武器已有一段时间了。 事实上，在过去十年中，俄罗斯和中国在太空进行了更多的演习，称为交会和邻近操作（RPO）——“嗡嗡”西方卫星。 伦敦国王学院俄罗斯国防与安全研究系的读者罗德·桑顿博士告诉英国广播公司：“理论上，这些 RPO 卫星可以通过与它们发生物理碰撞或将它们推出轨道而成为猎杀卫星。” 鲍文补充说，中国人已经展示了“太空拖拽能力”，他说：“飞行器可以到达卫星，可以抓住它并将其移入不同的轨道。” 他说，这可以...

reflection.zh: 宣布部署太空武器，引发了关于地球轨道军事化不断升级的深刻问题。随着各国开发用于太空战争的先进技术，以赛亚书 2:4 中将武器转化为农具的预言性景象，提供了一个鲜明的对比和充满希望的替代方案。愿智慧引导领导者走向裁军与和平，而非太空军备竞赛。

title.en: Satellite image reveals major damage that shut crucial oil pipeline
title.zh: 卫星图像显示关键石油管道严重受损，导致停运

summary.en: Satellite images reveal significant damage to a vital oil pipeline in Saudi Arabia following a strike last week. Experts estimate repairs could take over a month, potentially impacting global oil supplies and prices.
summary.zh: 卫星图像显示，沙特阿拉伯一条重要的石油管道在上周的袭击后遭到严重损坏。专家估计修复工作可能需要一个月以上，这可能影响全球石油供应和价格。

body.en:
Satellite imagery shows a key oil pipeline in Saudi Arabia has been badly damaged after a strike last week, which experts have told BBC Verify could take more than a month to repair and force oil prices even higher.

The image shows the most significant damage is at a pumping station along the East-West Pipeline, which Saudi Arabia has increasingly relied on to export crude oil via the Red Sea rather than through the Strait of Hormuz, where ships have been attacked by Iran and the US during their six-month war.

The Saudi government has accused Iranian-backed militias in Iraq of the pipeline strike, which followed days of renewed missile and drone attacks on south-western Saudi Arabia by Yemen's Houthi group - which is also backed by Iran. Saudi Arabia has retaliated by carrying out strikes on Houthi-controlled areas of western Yemen.

New satellite images also show damage to Saudi Arabia's King Khalid Air Base after a Houthi strike last week.

The Saudi government said on Tuesday it would respond "firmly" to attacks by the Houthis.

While the Houthis have been fighting a long-running civil war against Saudi-backed Yemeni pro-government forces, the group has stepped up its campaign in recent weeks.

It seized control of significant new territory across Yemen's south-western coast last week, including areas overlooking the crucial Bab al-Mandab waterway, strengthening its ability to enforce its declared blockade of Saudi shipping.

The price of a barrel of oil has surged since Saudi Arabia said on Friday it was closing the pipeline as a precaution. Brent crude was trading as high as $108 (£80) a barrel on Tuesday, down slightly from $109.80 on Monday.

Experts from trade intelligence firm Kpler said the pipeline's closure could reduce oil supplies by as much as 3.6 million barrels per day - or about 3.6% of global demand.

"Based on new information we've received, damage to the pipeline could take four to six weeks to resolve, given spare-parts availability and impaired supply chains," said Homayoun Falakshahi, Kpler's head of crude oil analysis.

Anne-Sophie Corbeau, from the Center on Global Energy Policy at Columbia University, said pipelines are "like sitting ducks" and recent strikes are a "very important signal" indicating workarounds being used to avoid the Strait of Hormuz "may not be super useful because they can be destroyed".

The Houthis have targeted other Saudi oil infrastructure with drones and missiles which has led to some operations being suspended.

There have also been attacks on military bases. New satellite images captured on Monday show damage to Saudi Arabia's King Khalid Air Base near Khamis Mushait which the Houthis said they had targeted with ballistic missiles and drones last week after it was used to carry out air strikes...
body.zh: 卫星图像显示，沙特阿拉伯的一条重要石油管道在上周的袭击后遭到严重损坏，专家告诉 BBC verify，修复可能需要一个多月的时间，这将迫使油价进一步走高。 该图显示，受损最严重的是东西管道沿线的一个泵站，沙特阿拉伯越来越依赖该管道通过红海而不是霍尔木兹海峡出口原油，霍尔木兹海峡的船只在为期六个月的战争中遭到伊朗和美国的袭击。 沙特政府指责伊朗支持的伊拉克民兵组织发动了此次管道袭击，此前几天，也门胡塞武装再次对沙特阿拉伯西南部发动导弹和无人机袭击，该组织也得到了伊朗的支持。作为报复，沙特阿拉伯对也门西部胡塞武装控制的地区发动了袭击。 新的卫星图像还显示，上周胡塞武装发动袭击后，沙特阿拉伯哈立德国王空军基地遭到破坏。 沙特政府周二表示，将“坚决”回应胡塞武装的袭击。 虽然胡塞武装一直在与沙特支持的也门亲政府部队进行长期内战，但该组织最近几周加大了行动力度。 上周，它控制了也门西南海岸的重要新领土，包括俯瞰重要的曼德水道的地区，加强了其执行其宣布的对沙特航运封锁的能力。 自沙特阿拉伯周五表示将关闭管道作为预防措施以来，每桶石油的价格已经飙升。周二布伦特原油交易价格高达每桶 108 美元（80 英镑），略低于周一的 109.80 美元。 贸易情报公司 Kpler 的专家表示，该管道的关闭可能会导致石油供应量减少多达 360 万桶/日，约占全球需求的 3.6%。 Kpler 原油分析主管 Homayoun Falakshahi 表示：“根据我们收到的新信息，考虑到备件供应和供应链受损，管道损坏可能需要四到六周的时间才能解决。” 哥伦比亚大学全球能源政策中心的安妮-索菲·科尔博表示，管道“就像是坐鸭子”，最近的罢工是一个“非常重要的信号”，表明用于避开霍尔木兹海峡的变通办法“可能不会非常有用，因为它们可能会被摧毁”。 胡塞武装用无人机和导弹攻击沙特其他石油基础设施，导致一些行动暂停。 军事基地也遭到袭击。周一拍摄的新卫星图像显示，海米斯穆谢特附近的沙特阿拉伯哈立德国王空军基地遭到破坏，胡塞武装称，他们上周用弹道导弹和无人机瞄准了该基地，此前该基地被用来进行空袭。

reflection.en: The closure of this vital oil pipeline, attributed to a strike, highlights the destructive cycles of conflict. The temptation to retaliate is strong, but Scripture calls us to a higher path. 'Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good' (Romans 12:21). May wisdom guide leaders away from further escalation and toward paths of peace and...
reflection.zh: 这条关键石油管道的关闭，归因于一次袭击，凸显了冲突的破坏性循环。报复的诱惑很强烈，但圣经呼召我们走上一条更高的道路。“不要被恶所胜，反要以善胜恶”（罗马书 12:21）。愿智慧引导领导者远离进一步的升级，走向和平与复兴的道路。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Saudi Arabia faces hard choices as Houthis gain in Yemen
title.zh: 沙特阿拉伯面临艰难抉择，也门胡塞武装步步紧逼

summary.en: Saudi Arabia is experiencing increasing security and economic challenges as it attempts to balance deterrence and diplomacy in its escalating conflict with the Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen. Houthi attacks have injured approximately 100 people since July, and they have also disrupted oil shipping in a key strait.
summary.zh: 沙特阿拉伯在与也门胡塞武装不断升级的冲突中，试图在威慑与外交之间取得平衡，但面临日益严峻的安全和经济挑战。自7月以来，胡塞武装的袭击已造成约100人受伤，并扰乱了关键海峡的石油运输。

body.en:
Saudi Arabia faces growing security and economic problems as it seeks to balance deterrence and diplomacy during its escalating conflict with the Iran-backed Houthis in neighboring Yemen.

Saudi Arabia is being increasingly affected by the rapidly escalating conflict across its southern border in Yemen , where the Iran-backed Houthis are fighting Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces.

Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia injured another 13 people on Monday night  bringing the total number of people injured since the conflict escalated in July to about 100.

In July, the Houthis also blocked Saudi oil shipping in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a key waterway that had been serving as an  alternative route for Saudi oil exports amid Iran's blockade of the nearby Strait of Hormuz.

Last week, Saudi Arabia's alternative lifeline for oil export, the East-West pipeline, was allegedly targeted by Iranian proxy militias in Iraq. On Tuesday, officials said that it might take weeks to repair the damage to the pipeline which runs 1,200 kilometers (745 miles) across the country and ends at the port of Yanbu on the Red Sea .

"Riyadh faces a genuine dilemma," Neil Quilliam, associate fellow of the Middle East and North Africa program at the London-based think tank Chatham House, told DW. "The Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman is trying to protect both Saudi security and Saudi economic development simultaneously," he said. "The difficulty is that the Houthis are increasingly able to threaten both."

Saudi Arabia has one of the most heavily armed and technologically sophisticated militaries in the Middle East, especially in combat aviation and air defense.

But the country is "reluctant to become drawn back into a costly military campaign in Yemen," Quilliam said.

A Saudi-led military coalition intervened in Yemen in 2015 to support the government's fight against Houthi insurgents. After seven years of intense war between the Houthis and the Saudi-backed government, the fighting eased in 2022 with a UN-brokered truce .

The latest Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and the Saudi-backed government in Yemen aim to pressure Saudi Arabia to end its air and sea blockades on Houthi-held territory which have not been fully lifted despite the 2022 truce.

"Saudi Arabia is now in a very complicated situation," Sebastian Sons, Middle East observer at the German Middle East Research Center CARPO, said.

"On the one hand, it needs to make it clear to the Houthis that a red line has been crossed and that there must also be a military response , particularly in coordination with Yemen's internationally recognized government.

"But on the other hand, it also needs to keep the lines of communication open in order to get back to the negotiating table and...
body.zh: 沙特阿拉伯在邻国也门与伊朗支持的胡塞武装的冲突不断升级时寻求平衡威慑和外交，因此面临着日益严重的安全和经济问题。 沙特阿拉伯越来越受到也门南部边境迅速升级的冲突的影响，伊朗支持的胡塞武装正在与沙特支持的也门政府军作战。 周一晚上，胡塞武装对沙特阿拉伯的袭击又造成 13 人受伤，使自 7 月份冲突升级以来受伤的总人数达到约 100 人。 7月，胡塞武装还封锁了曼德海峡的沙特石油运输，该海峡是伊朗封锁附近霍尔木兹海峡期间沙特石油出口的替代路线的重要水道。 上周，沙特阿拉伯石油出口的替代生命线——东西方管道据称成为伊拉克境内伊朗代理民兵的袭击目标。周二，官员们表示，修复受损管道可能需要数周时间，该管道全长 1,200 公里（745 英里），横跨全国，终点为红海延布港。 伦敦智库查塔姆研究所中东和北非项目副研究员尼尔·奎利亚姆告诉德国之声：“利雅得面临着真正的困境。” “沙特王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼正在努力同时保护沙特安全和沙特经济发展，”他说。 “困难在于胡塞武装越来越有能力威胁两者。” 沙特阿拉伯拥有中东地区武装最齐全、技术最先进的军队之一，特别是在作战航空和防空方面。 但奎利亚姆说，该国“不愿卷入也门代价高昂的军事行动”。 2015年，沙特领导的军事联盟介入也门，支持政府打击胡塞叛乱分子。胡塞武装与沙特支持的政府之间经历了七年的激烈战争，2022 年，在联合国斡旋下达成休战，战事有所缓和。 胡塞武装最近对沙特阿拉伯和沙特支持的也门政府发动的袭击旨在迫使沙特阿拉伯结束对胡塞武装控制领土的空中和海上封锁，尽管已于 2022 年停战，但这些封锁尚未完全解除。 德国中东研究中心CARPO中东观察员塞巴斯蒂安·桑斯表示：“沙特阿拉伯现在的局势非常复杂。” “一方面，它需要向胡塞武装明确表示，红线已经被跨越，必须采取军事反应，特别是与也门国际公认的政府协调。 “但另一方面，它也需要保持沟通渠道畅通，以便回到谈判桌......

reflection.en: The escalating conflict in Yemen presents Saudi Arabia with a difficult balancing act between military deterrence and diplomatic engagement. The ongoing hostilities, marked by attacks and disruptions, underscore the persistent challenge of finding a path toward peace when tensions are high. May wisdom guide leaders toward de-escalation and lasting...
reflection.zh: 也门冲突的升级使沙特阿拉伯在军事威慑与外交斡旋之间面临艰难的平衡。持续的敌对行动，伴随着袭击和破坏，凸显了在高压局势下寻求和平之路的严峻挑战。愿智慧引导领导者走向缓和局势和持久的和解。

title.en: Why the era of cheap government debt is over
title.zh: 廉价政府债务时代已结束

summary.en: US debt has surpassed $40 trillion, raising concerns about the country's growing debt burden and investor confidence in funding Washington's deficits. Norway's sovereign wealth fund plans to significantly reduce its US bond holdings, signaling a potential shift in global investor sentiment.
summary.zh: 美国债务已超过40万亿美元，引发了对其日益增长的债务负担以及投资者对资助华盛顿赤字信心的担忧。挪威主权财富基金计划大幅削减其美国债券持有量，这标志着全球投资者情绪可能发生转变。

body.en:
US debt has topped $40 trillion. How risky is the country's growing debt burden. And will investors keep funding Washington's deficits?

When the world's largest pension fund changes its investment strategy, the financial world pays close attention, especially when it plans to drastically reduce its holdings of US government bonds. 

According to Reuters, Norway's sovereign wealth fund wants to cut its US bond holdings — which totaled about $215 billion (€186 billion) at the end of June — by $80 billion.

Global investors are increasingly viewing the debt binge with suspicion, especially as the US's national debt passed $40 trillion in August. This week, the yield on 30-year US Treasury bonds climbed to nearly 5.4%, the highest level since 2007.

For highly indebted countries such as Japan , where debt exceeds 200% of economic output, borrowing money on capital markets is getting increasingly expensive. The same applies to Italy, France and the UK.

Germany is in a much better position. At around 65% of gross domestic product (GDP), its debt-to-GDP ratio is only about half that of the US.

Borrowing to modernize its armed forces and infrastructure, however, means that ratio is set to move toward 80%  over the coming years.

The US now spends over $1 trillion annually on interest payments — more than $3 billion per day — according to calculations by the Congressional Budget Office. Since 2024, Washington has spent more annually on servicing its debt than on its entire military. 

The Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis calculated that the US national debt has risen by around 650% over the past 30 years  from $5.2 trillion in 1996. 

The US budget deficit is on course to reach nearly 6% in 2026. Yet, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent aims to cut it by half — a goal seen as unrealistic given the huge cost of the Iran war  plus a shortfall in revenue due to corporate tax cuts and the tariffs struck down by the Supreme Court.

"That is a very difficult path," Carsten Roemheld, a capital market strategist at Fidelity International, told DW. "Nervousness is also rising sharply within the US administration — that is clearly evident. If this trajectory continues, it will be very difficult to sustain."

The $10 trillion mark was passed during the 2008 financial crisis; $20 trillion was reached in 2017. By early 2022, the figure had already hit $30 trillion. It took just four and a half years to reach the next record high of $40 trillion this summer.

On September 9, he announced that he would triple the volume of long-term US government bond buybacks from the previous $2 billion to as much as $6...
body.zh: 美国债务已突破40万亿美元。该国不断增长的债务负担的风险有多大。投资者会继续为华盛顿的赤字提供资金吗？ 当全球最大的养老基金改变投资策略时，金融界密切关注，尤其是当它计划大幅减持美国政府债券时。 据路透社报道，挪威主权财富基金希望将其持有的美国债券（截至 6 月底总计约 2,150 亿美元（1,860 亿欧元））削减 800 亿美元。 全球投资者对债务狂潮越来越持怀疑态度，尤其是在 8 月份美国国债超过 40 万亿美元的情况下。本周，30年期美国国债收益率攀升至近5.4%，为2007年以来的最高水平。 对于日本这样的高负债国家来说，债务超过经济产出的 200%，在资本市场上借钱变得越来越昂贵。意大利、法国和英国也是如此。 德国的处境要好得多。其债务与 GDP 之比约为国内生产总值 (GDP) 的 65%，仅为美国的一半左右。 然而，借款用于武装部队和基础设施现代化意味着未来几年这一比例将接近 80%。 根据国会预算办公室的计算，美国目前每年在利息支付上的支出超过 1 万亿美元，即每天超过 30 亿美元。自 2024 年以来，华盛顿每年用于偿还债务的支出比其整个军队的支出还要多。 圣路易斯联邦储备银行计算出，美国国债在过去 30 年里从 1996 年的 5.2 万亿美元增加了约 650%。 到 2026 年，美国预算赤字预计将达到近 6%。然而，财政部长斯科特·贝森特 (Scott Bessent) 的目标是将其削减一半——考虑到伊朗战争的巨大成本，加上企业减税和最高法院取消关税导致的收入短缺，这一目标被认为是不切实际的。 富达国际资本市场策略师卡斯滕·罗姆霍尔德（Carsten Roemheld）告诉德国之声：“这是一条非常艰难的道路。” “美国政府内部的紧张情绪也在急剧上升——这一点是显而易见的。如果这种趋势继续下去，将很难维持。” 2008年金融危机期间突破10万亿美元大关； 2017年达到20万亿美元。到2022年初，这一数字已达到30万亿美元。仅用了四年半的时间，今年夏天就达到了 40 万亿美元的下一个历史新高。 9 月 9 日，他宣布将长期美国政府债券回购规模从之前的 20 亿美元增加两倍至 6 美元……

reflection.en: The news that US debt has crossed the $40 trillion mark, coupled with Norway's sovereign wealth fund reducing its holdings, points to a growing unease about national debt. Proverbs 22:7 warns, 'The borrower is slave to the lender.' This ancient wisdom resonates today, reminding us of the potential burdens and dependencies that arise from significant debt,...
reflection.zh: 美国债务突破40万亿美元的消息，加上挪威主权财富基金减持其债券，都表明人们对国家债务的担忧日益加剧。《箴言》22:7警告说：“欠债的是债主的仆人。”这句古老的智慧在今天仍然适用，提醒我们无论个人还是国家，巨额债务都可能带来负担和依赖。

verse.textEn: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is slave to the lender.
verse.textZh: 富户管辖穷人；欠债的是债主的仆人。

title.en: US allies in Asia alarmed as think tank calls for pullback
title.zh: 亚洲盟友对智库呼吁撤军感到震惊

summary.en: Analysts warn that a US withdrawal from the western Pacific, as recently suggested by a think tank, would weaken deterrence and strengthen China's position.
summary.zh: 分析人士警告称，美国从西太平洋撤军，正如一个智库最近建议的那样，将削弱威慑力并加强中国的地位。

body.en:
Analysts warn that a US withdrawal from the western Pacific, as recently suggested by a think tank, would weaken deterrence and strengthen China's position.

A study by a US foreign policy think tank advocates a major military pullback from the western Pacific, prompting concern among long-standing allies of the United States across the Indo-Pacific, analysts say.

The report  was authored by Jennifer Kavanagh, a senior fellow and director of military analysis at the right-of-center Defense Priorities Foundation. Kavanagh calls for the US to "narrow its defense commitments in the region" by ending mutual defense alliances with South Korea , Japan , Australia and the Philippines .

The priority for Washington, she states, is to defend the US homeland and safeguard access to key economic markets and trade routes. That would be best served by pulling back from the "first island chain," which runs from Okinawa in southern Japan, through Taiwan and on to the Philippines.

Kavanagh writes that US forces should be pared back and moved to the "second island chain," which runs from eastern Japan to the Northern Marianas Islands in the central Pacific, Guam, Palau and on to Papua New Guinea.

The report states that moving the troops back would make their positions easier to defend and "reduce the risk of a catastrophic war with China."

Such a withdrawal would arguably be most keenly felt in Taiwan , which Beijing views as a renegade province that must one day be assimilated into greater China .

In her report, Kavanagh notes that the US has no formal commitment to come to the assistance of Taiwan in the event of an attack by China. She warns that any armed clash "would come at an exorbitant cost for the United States, far in excess of any benefits."

"With a cost-benefit calculation this lopsided, a change in the US commitment to Taiwan seems wise," she said. "The United States should shift from strategic ambiguity to a clear non-intervention policy in the event of any military confrontation over Taiwan."

The countries named in the report have made no formal comments on the think tank's proposals, but its conclusions "will be viewed with shock," William Yang, a Taiwan-based security analyst for the International Crisis Group, told DW.

The concern will be even deeper given that the Defense Priorities Foundation is known for its isolationist foreign and defense policy positions and is reputed to have ties with a number of senior and like-minded decision-makers in the White House, Yang said.

Yang noted that US President Donald Trump has repeatedly threatened to withdraw troops from allied nations in Europe and Asia if his demands for larger payments or concessions in some other area of the bilateral relationship were not met, Yang...
body.zh: 分析人士警告说，正如一家智库最近建议的那样，美国从西太平洋撤军将削弱威慑力并加强中国的地位。 分析人士称，美国外交政策智囊团的一项研究主张从西太平洋地区大规模撤军，这引起了美国在印太地区的长期盟友的担忧。 该报告的作者詹妮弗·卡瓦纳 (Jennifer Kavanagh) 是中右翼国防优先基金会的高级研究员兼军事分析主任。卡瓦纳呼吁美国终止与韩国、日本、澳大利亚和菲律宾的共同防御联盟，“缩小其在该地区的防务承诺”。 她表示，华盛顿的首要任务是保卫美国本土并保障进入主要经济市场和贸易路线的机会。最好的办法是从“第一岛链”撤军，该岛链从日本南部的冲绳岛，穿过台湾，一直延伸到菲律宾。 卡瓦纳写道，美军应该削减规模，并转移到“第二岛链”，该岛链从日本东部到太平洋中部的北马里亚纳群岛、关岛、帕劳，再到巴布亚新几内亚。 报告指出，撤军将使他们的阵地更容易保卫，并“减少与中国发生灾难性战争的风险”。 可以说，这种撤军对台湾的感受最为强烈，北京将台湾视为一个叛逆的省份，有一天必须被纳入大中华区。 卡瓦纳在报告中指出，美国没有正式承诺在台湾遭受中国袭击时向台湾提供援助。她警告说，任何武装冲突“都会给美国带来高昂的代价，远远超过任何好处”。 她说：“鉴于成本效益计算如此不平衡，美国改变对台湾的承诺似乎是明智的。” “如果台湾问题发生任何军事对抗，美国应该从战略模糊转向明确的不干预政策。” 国际危机组织驻台湾安全分析师杨威廉告诉德国之声，报告中点名的国家尚未对该智库的提议发表正式评论，但其结论“将会令人震惊”。 杨说，鉴于国防优先基金会以其孤立主义外交和国防政策立场而闻名，并且据称与白宫许多高级和志同道合的决策者有联系，这种担忧将会更加严重。 杨指出，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普多次威胁称，如果他在双边关系其他领域提出的更多付款或让步的要求得不到满足，他将从欧洲和亚洲盟国撤军。

reflection.en: A report from the Defense Priorities Foundation suggests a significant US military withdrawal from the western Pacific, a proposal that has alarmed long-standing allies. The potential consequences, including weakened deterrence and a strengthened China, underscore the critical need for careful consideration and wise counsel in matters of national security...
reflection.zh: 美国国防优先基金会的一份报告建议美国大幅撤出西太平洋的军事力量，这一提议令长期盟友感到担忧。其潜在后果，包括威慑力的削弱和中国的实力增强，凸显了在国家安全和国际关系事务中，审慎考虑和明智建议的至关重要性。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: 'Woman, Life, Freedom' spirit lives on as Iran war drags on
title.zh: “女人，生命，自由”精神仍在继续，伊朗战争仍在继续

summary.en: The 2022 death of Jina Mahsa Amini in police custody sparked a resistance movement in Iran. Four years later, the Iranian regime persists, but so does the legacy of the 'Woman, Life, Freedom' protests.
summary.zh: 2022年，吉娜·玛莎·阿米尼在警方拘留期间死亡，引发了伊朗的抵抗运动。四年后，伊朗政权依然存在，但“女人，生命，自由”抗议活动的遗产也依然存在。

body.en:
The 2022 death of Jina Mahsa Amini in police custody triggered a resistance movement in Iran. Four years later, the Iranian regime endures — but so does the legacy of the "Woman, Life, Freedom" protests.

On September 16, 2022, Jina Mahsa Amini , a 22-year-old Kurdish woman, died away in a Tehran hospital . She had left her home in northwestern Iran to visit the capital and was then confronted by Tehran's morality police , who claimed the she was violating the mandate for women to cover their hair. The police arrested her. Three days later, she was declared dead .

For many Iranians, the brutality of law enforcement officers toward  women accused of violating hijab rules was nothing new. And yet, Amini's death triggered an unprecedented outpouring of anger. Protesters all across the country took to the streets under the slogan "Woman, Life, Freedom." They marched for months , but the regime eventually managed to suppress the movement with a violent clampdown.

"From my perspective, the movement 'Woman, Life, Freedom' is the biggest social and cultural change in Iran in decades," the writer, poet and activist Pouran Nazemi told DW.

Nazemi's work as a women's rights activist has gotten her arrested several times in recent years. Still, she refuses to be intimidated.

She said the movement had clear goals right from the start: ending the hijab mandate and ending state violence against Iran's population. Though those goals were ultimately not met, the protests did lead many people to recognize their own power within the society.

"The institutions still use physical violence and occasional arrests against us," Nazemi said. "But something fundamental has changed."

Even now, amid the ongoing war with the United States , parts of the Iranian regime are still focusing on the hijab mandate . Many politicians are supporting a new bill which would introduce significantly stricter punishments for women violating the hijab order in public places.

One lawmaker described the missing head coverings as a "deep wound in the body of society."

The proposed law has been in limbo for years and marked by wrangling between various state institutions.

I a virtual parliamentary session on September 6, several lawmakers urged Parliamentary Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf to pass the proposed legislation to the president for signing. 

A 17-year-old female student told DW that she doesn't even think about wearing a hijab in public. Like many other young women , the pupil is posting pictures and videos of herself in colorful skirts and summer clothing on social media. To her, this is the new normal.

"My mother is not wearing a hijab either," the student said. "She is still a bit afraid and always carries a scarf so she can cover up in an...
body.zh: 2022 年，吉娜·马赫萨·阿米尼 (Jina Mahsa Amini) 在警方拘留期间死亡，引发了伊朗的抵抗运动。四年后，伊朗政权依然存在，但“妇女、生命、自由”抗议活动的遗产也依然存在。 2022 年 9 月 16 日，22 岁的库尔德妇女吉娜·马赫萨·阿米尼 (Jina Mahsa Amini) 在德黑兰一家医院去世。她离开伊朗西北部的家前往首都访问，然后遭到德黑兰道德警察的质询，警察声称她违反了女性遮盖头发的规定。警察逮捕了她。三天后，她被宣布死亡。 对于许多伊朗人来说，执法人员对被指控违反头巾规定的女性实施暴力并不是什么新鲜事。然而，阿米尼的死引发了前所未有的愤怒。全国各地的抗议者在“妇女、生命、自由”的口号下走上街头。他们游行了几个月，但当局最终通过暴力镇压镇压了这场运动。 作家、诗人兼活动家普兰·纳泽米 (Pouran Nazemi) 告诉德国之声：“在我看来，‘女性、生命、自由’运动是伊朗几十年来最大的社会和文化变革。” 纳泽米作为一名女权活动家，近年来曾多次被捕。尽管如此，她拒绝被吓倒。 她说，该运动从一开始就有明确的目标：结束头巾强制规定并结束针对伊朗人民的国家暴力。尽管这些目标最终没有实现，但抗议活动确实让许多人认识到自己在社会中的力量。 “这些机构仍然对我们使用身体暴力，偶尔还会逮捕我们，”纳泽米说。 “但一些根本性的事情发生了变化。” 即使现在，在与美国的战争持续不断的情况下，伊朗政权的部分成员仍然把重点放在头巾的强制上。许多政界人士支持一项新法案，该法案将对在公共场所违反头巾命令的女性实施更严厉的惩罚。 一位立法者将失踪的头巾描述为“社会的深深伤口”。 拟议的法律多年来一直处于悬而未决的状态，并以各个国家机构之间的争论为标志。 在 9 月 6 日的虚拟议会会议上，几位立法者敦促议长穆罕默德·巴格尔·加利巴夫将拟议的立法提交总统签署。 一名17岁女学生告诉德国之声，她根本没想过在公共场合戴头巾。和许多其他年轻女性一样，这名学生在社交媒体上发布了自己穿着彩色裙子和夏季服装的照片和视频。对她来说，这是新常态。 “我妈妈也没有戴头巾，”学生说。 “她还是有点害怕，总是带着围巾，这样她就可以盖起来......

reflection.en: The spirit of 'Woman, Life, Freedom,' ignited by the tragic death of Jina Mahsa Amini, demonstrates a persistent yearning for justice and dignity. Though the regime endures, the movement's legacy shows that the cry for righteousness cannot be silenced. May we, like the ancient prophets, champion justice and compassion in our own spheres.
reflection.zh: 由吉娜·玛莎·阿米尼的悲惨死亡点燃的“女人，生命，自由”精神，展现了对正义和尊严的持久渴望。尽管政权依然存在，但这场运动的遗产表明，对公义的呼喊无法被压制。愿我们也能像古代的先知一样，在我们自己的领域里倡导正义与怜悯。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Saudi Arabia warns it will respond 'firmly' to Houthi attacks, as oil prices surge
title.zh: 沙特警告将‘坚决’回应胡塞武装袭击，油价飙升

summary.en: Saudi Arabia has warned it will respond 'firmly' to attacks by Yemen's Houthis after the rebels used ballistic missiles and drones to wound 13 civilians. The Houthis have been engaged in renewed fighting with Saudi-backed forces since July, escalating tensions and impacting Red Sea shipping. Saudi Arabia responded to...
summary.zh: 沙特阿拉伯警告将对也门胡塞武装的袭击作出“坚决”回应，此前胡塞武装使用弹道导弹和无人机造成13名平民受伤。自7月以来，胡塞武装一直与沙特支持的政府军进行新的战斗，加剧了紧张局势并影响了红海航运。沙特阿拉伯以其自身的50多次打击回应了这些袭击。

body.en:
Saudi Arabia warned on Tuesday it will react "firmly" to Yemen's Houthis, after a series of attacks carried out by the pro-Iranian rebels using ballistic missiles and drones wounded 13 civilians in the country's south.

The Houthis have been engaged in renewed fighting with Saudi-backed government forces since Yemen's civil war reignited in July, when the group declared a maritime blockade on Riyadh and began targeting its ships in the Red Sea.

The group seized control of Yemen's Red Sea coast and the Bab al-Mandab Strait last week, which has become vital as the wider US-Iran war chokes the Strait of Hormuz, in a significant blow to Yemeni government forces.

It has also targeted the oil infrastructure of Saudi Arabia, the world's leading crude exporter, pushing oil prices above the US$100 ($140) threshold.

A Houthi strike in western Yemen on Monday killed eight soldiers from government forces, according to two military sources.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The Houthis claimed a new "large-scale" attack using "dozens of ballistic missiles and drones" against the King Khalid airbase in Khamis Mushait, in southern Saudi Arabia.

A Khamis Mushait resident told the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency he heard "intense blasts" which left fires burning for a "long time".

The Saudi-led coalition confirmed on Tuesday there had been missile and drone attacks the previous day on Khamis Mushait, Abha and Taif, reporting 13 wounded.

Saudi Arabia responded with more than 50 strikes, as it had the day before, according to the Houthis.

The coalition said it would deal with the attacks "firmly to protect the sovereignty of the Kingdom" and would take "all necessary operational measures to deter this ... hostile and extremist approach".

Hazem al-Assad from the Houthis' politburo said the "Yemeni response will continue and escalate as long as they (Saudi Arabia) persist in their aggression against our people".

In the early hours of Tuesday, Saudi civil defence issued air-raid alerts in six regions, before lifting them.

The renewed fighting in Yemen comes as the wider regional war remains at a stalemate. But US President Donald Trump said on Monday he was open to holding talks with Iran.

"The failing Nation of Iran wants to make a deal, quickly and badly. I will determine whether or not the USA will choose to engage — The concept of which we are open to," Trump said on his Truth Social network.

Iran's top security chief Mohsen Rezaei said on X that "there will be no negotiations until Iran's conditions are met. That is all there is to it".

title.en: Could a Scottish, Welsh and Northern Irish independence pact threaten UK unity?
title.zh: 苏格兰、威尔士和北爱尔兰独立协议是否会威胁英国统一？

summary.en: The leaders of Wales, Scotland, and Northern Ireland have signed a pact that could lead to the breakup of the United Kingdom.
summary.zh: 威尔士、苏格兰和北爱尔兰的领导人签署了一项可能导致英国分裂的协议。

body.en:
Leaders of the main Scottish, Northern Irish and Welsh nationalist parties declared at a meeting overnight that they have the right to choose whether to stay in the United Kingdom, with all three seeing their future as nations within the European Union.

The Scottish National Party (SNP), Plaid Cymru in Wales, and the pro-Irish-unity Sinn Féin want to break away from the UK, although under different timelines and conditions.

The rare meeting in the Welsh capital came just days after United States President Donald Trump waded in on the issue, saying he would back a united Ireland.

His comments showed "the unity debate is very much alive", Northern Ireland's Michelle O'Neill said alongside fellow party leaders as they announced a memorandum of understanding.

"Our nations have the right to self-determination. No Westminster government (the UK government) has the right to block democracy or undermine the principle that our people will decide their own future," the agreement said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

SNP leader John Swinney, Rhun ap Iorwerth, leader of Plaid Cymru in Wales, and Mary Lou McDonald and O'Neill, leader and deputy leader of Sinn Féin, met in their roles as party leaders, rather than as top officials in their respective governments.

O'Neill is Northern Ireland's first minister while Iorwerth and Swinney lead their respective nationalist parties in Scotland and Wales.

The agreement said that, for the first time, each nation had a first minister "committed to independence from the UK", adding: "The future of our nations belongs in the European Union."

The independence parties are the biggest in both the Scottish and Welsh parliaments for the first time since devolution measures began in 1999. Sinn Féin has been the biggest party in Northern Ireland's assembly since 2022.

The SNP wants a second independence referendum after an earlier ballot in 2014 saw Scotland narrowly vote to remain in Britain. Successive UK governments have ruled out an immediate rerun.

Sinn Féin, the former political wing of the paramilitary Irish Republican Army (IRA), wants a vote on the UK territory of Northern Ireland being reunified with Ireland.

Plaid Cymru seeks Welsh independence in the longer term, but Iorwerth has ruled out pressing for a referendum immediately.

Laura McAllister, a politics professor at Cardiff University, said the deliberately broad term "self-determination" was used due to these differing timelines and goals.

"Plaid Cymru was elected with heavy emphasis on avoiding the issue of independence this term," she told Agence France-Presse (AFP).

title.en: 'Enormously confronting': The uncomfortable truth behind the HYROX defecation controversy
title.zh: “令人震惊”：HYROX如厕争议背后的令人不安的真相

summary.en: An Australian athlete appeared to experience a bowel movement during the international competition, triggering debate about hygiene and fairness, though the athlete continued and won the race.
summary.zh: 一名澳大利亚运动员在国际比赛中似乎发生了排便事件，引发了关于卫生和公平性的争论，但该运动员继续比赛并获胜。

body.en:
It was an incident that triggered international headlines. But while a HYROX athlete's mid-race bowel movement has raised questions about hygiene and fairness, the urge to go is a familiar reality for many endurance athletes.

HYROX is a fitness and endurance race that combines 8km of running with exercises such as rowing, sled pushes and wall balls, carried out in indoor exhibition halls.

The co-founder of the global sport, Moritz Fürste, apologised on Monday after Australian athlete Joanna Wietrzyk soiled herself during a race in Beijing over the weekend and went on to win.

Footage posted on social media showed Wietrzyk, who holds the sport's women's solo pro world record, competing at stations with faeces on her legs.

"I apologise to all that were directly or indirectly affected, as well as to everyone who felt like we did not handle the situation like we should have," Fürste's statement said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Fürste said the organisation had immediately begun improving its event processes and had introduced new rules and procedures to prevent a similar situation from occurring again.

The incident triggered significant backlash online, with some arguing it had affected other racers' ability to compete in a safe and hygienic environment.

"These competitors pay hundreds of dollars to participate and spend weeks, if not months, training for these events. Their health, safety, and ability to perform should matter just as much as anyone else's," read one comment which received thousands of likes.

Critics also questioned why officials did not intervene, given HYROX imposes penalties for other acts such as spitting and nostril clearing.

It's not unusual for endurance athletes to experience gastrointestinal symptoms during competition, nor is it unheard of for them to continue despite soiling themselves.

During the 2005 London Marathon, eventual winner Paula Radcliffe stopped and relieved herself in view of TV cameras.

She later explained she had been running through stomach cramps — likely affecting her speed — because of her reluctance to relieve herself in front of "however many thousands of people were watching on television".

French race walker Yohann Diniz experienced intestinal issues during the 2016 Olympics, but continued walking for many kilometres despite soiling himself.

According to research by Monash University, strenuous exercise lasting two hours or more — particularly running — appears to exacerbate gut disturbances.

Researchers estimate 30 to 70 per cent of athletes experience gastrointestinal symptoms, with endurance athletes particularly susceptible.

title.en: US rapper Macklemore dropped from Ed Sheeran's tour after 'free Palestine' speech
title.zh: 美国说唱歌手因“自由巴勒斯坦”言论被谢幕巡演

summary.en: American rapper Macklemore has been removed from Ed Sheeran's US tour after making pro-Palestinian remarks during a concert in New Jersey. Venue owners reportedly notified promoters they would not host a concert with Macklemore on the bill, leading to his removal from the remaining support dates.
summary.zh: 美国说唱歌手Macklemore在新泽西州的一场演唱会上发表了支持巴勒斯坦的言论后，被从艾德·希兰的美国巡演中除名。据报道，场馆所有者通知主办方，他们不会允许Macklemore在演出阵容中进行演出，因此他被从剩余的演出中移除。

body.en:
United States rapper Macklemore, whose real name is Benjamin Haggerty, said he was dropped from pop star Ed Sheeran's US tour after his pro-Palestinian comments and "free Palestine" remarks during a 4 September concert in New Jersey.

A post on Macklemore's Instagram said that he and Sheeran had "some difficult conversations this past week".

Messina Touring Group, promoter of the US leg of Sheeran's Loop tour, told Rolling Stone that the owners of several venues hosting concerts on the tour notified the promoters they would not allow a concert to take place with Macklemore, in the lineup.

"After discussions with stakeholders, Macklemore will not be performing on the remaining support dates," the group said. Sheeran had no immediate comment.

Macklemore has previously made pro-Palestinian statements and been critical of Israel's assault on Gaza and its occupation of the West Bank.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In 2024, Macklemore released Hind's Hall, a protest anthem in solidarity with pro-Palestinian demonstrators and in memory of five-year-old Palestinian girl Hind Rajab , who was killed by Israeli troops in Gaza as she pleaded for medical help.

Israel's military said last month it had opened a criminal investigation into her killing , though rights groups say such probes rarely lead to convictions.

"A big part of the reason why I wanted to do this tour in the first place is so I could stand up in stadiums like this and say two words that are very near and dear to my heart: 'Free Palestine,'" Macklemore told a New Jersey crowd while opening for Sheeran earlier this month.

"I want those words to be loud and clear, so that people all the way in Gaza to the occupied West Bank know that we have not forgotten about them."

Macklemore, a Grammy-winning artist, was on the bill to perform at eight of the 10 shows Sheeran has left on his stadium tour, which will resume on 19 September in Philadelphia, according to Variety magazine.

The Israeli-American Council started a petition urging Sheeran to remove Macklemore from the tour after his comments earlier this month.

A post on Macklemore's Instagram said billionaire Robert Kraft, owner of US sports franchise the New England Patriots, rallied support among some stadium owners and told Sheeran they will not allow him to perform at their venues if Macklemore stayed on the tour.

Sheeran is booked to play Massachusetts's Gillette Stadium — the Patriots' home stadium — later this month.
