title.en: US confirms for first time it has deployed weapons in space
title.zh: 美国首次确认已在太空部署武器

summary.en: The US military has confirmed for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space. Analysts warn this move could accelerate a high-risk arms race with Russia and China in Earth's orbit.
summary.zh: 美国军方首次证实已在太空部署武器。分析人士警告，此举可能加速与俄罗斯和中国在地球轨道上进行高风险的军备竞赛。

body.en: Analysts warn of an acceleration in high-risk arms race with Russia and China in Earth’s orbit The US has deployed weapons in space, the US military has confirmed, in an extraordinary public announcement that analysts warn will accelerate a high-risk arms race with Russia and China in Earth’s orbit. The US secretary of the air force, Troy Meink, said Washington had active “on-orbit” weapons, meaning they had been deployed and were circling the globe. Continue reading...
body.zh: 分析人士警告称，与俄罗斯和中国在地球轨道上的高风险军备竞赛将加速美国军方在一份非同寻常的公开声明中证实，美国已在太空部署武器，分析人士警告称，这将加速与俄罗斯和中国在地球轨道上的高风险军备竞赛。美国空军部长特洛伊·梅因克表示，华盛顿拥有活跃的“在轨”武器，这意味着它们已经部署并正在环绕地球飞行。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The confirmation of weapons in space marks a concerning escalation, potentially fueling an arms race. Isaiah's vision of nations beating swords into plowshares offers a stark contrast to this trajectory, reminding us of a future where military might is transformed into tools for peace and productivity.
reflection.zh: 在太空部署武器的确认标志着一个令人担忧的升级，可能加剧军备竞赛。以赛亚关于列国将刀打成犁头的异象与这一轨迹形成了鲜明对比，提醒我们一个军事力量将被转化为和平与生产力工具的未来。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: US allies in Asia alarmed as think tank calls for pullback
title.zh: 亚洲盟友对智库呼吁撤军感到震惊

summary.en: Analysts warn that a US withdrawal from the western Pacific, as recently suggested by a think tank, would weaken deterrence and strengthen China's position. A report by Jennifer Kavanagh of the Defense Priorities Foundation advocates for the US to "narrow its defense commitments in the region" by ending mutual defense...
summary.zh: 分析人士警告称，正如一家智库最近建议的那样，美国从西太平洋撤军将削弱威慑力并加强中国的地位。珍妮弗·卡瓦纳（Jennifer Kavanagh）在偏右的国防优先基金会（Defense Priorities...

body.en:
Analysts warn that a US withdrawal from the western Pacific, as recently suggested by a think tank, would weaken deterrence and strengthen China's position.

A study by a US foreign policy think tank advocates a major military pullback from the western Pacific, prompting concern among long-standing allies of the United States across the Indo-Pacific, analysts say.

The report  was authored by Jennifer Kavanagh, a senior fellow and director of military analysis at the right-of-center Defense Priorities Foundation. Kavanagh calls for the US to "narrow its defense commitments in the region" by ending mutual defense alliances with South Korea , Japan , Australia and the Philippines .

The priority for Washington, she states, is to defend the US homeland and safeguard access to key economic markets and trade routes. That would be best served by pulling back from the "first island chain," which runs from Okinawa in southern Japan, through Taiwan and on to the Philippines.

Kavanagh writes that US forces should be pared back and moved to the "second island chain," which runs from eastern Japan to the Northern Marianas Islands in the central Pacific, Guam, Palau and on to Papua New Guinea.

The report states that moving the troops back would make their positions easier to defend and "reduce the risk of a catastrophic war with China."

Such a withdrawal would arguably be most keenly felt in Taiwan , which Beijing views as a renegade province that must one day be assimilated into greater China .

In her report, Kavanagh notes that the US has no formal commitment to come to the assistance of Taiwan in the event of an attack by China. She warns that any armed clash "would come at an exorbitant cost for the United States, far in excess of any benefits."

"With a cost-benefit calculation this lopsided, a change in the US commitment to Taiwan seems wise," she said. "The United States should shift from strategic ambiguity to a clear non-intervention policy in the event of any military confrontation over Taiwan."

The countries named in the report have made no formal comments on the think tank's proposals, but its conclusions "will be viewed with shock," William Yang, a Taiwan-based security analyst for the International Crisis Group, told DW.

The concern will be even deeper given that the Defense Priorities Foundation is known for its isolationist foreign and defense policy positions and is reputed to have ties with a number of senior and like-minded decision-makers in the White House, Yang said.

Yang noted that US President Donald Trump has repeatedly threatened to withdraw troops from allied nations in Europe and Asia if his demands for larger payments or concessions in some other area of the bilateral relationship were not met, Yang...
body.zh: 分析人士警告说，正如一家智库最近建议的那样，美国从西太平洋撤军将削弱威慑力并加强中国的地位。 分析人士称，美国外交政策智囊团的一项研究主张从西太平洋地区大规模撤军，这引起了美国在印太地区的长期盟友的担忧。 该报告的作者詹妮弗·卡瓦纳 (Jennifer Kavanagh) 是中右翼国防优先基金会的高级研究员兼军事分析主任。卡瓦纳呼吁美国终止与韩国、日本、澳大利亚和菲律宾的共同防御联盟，“缩小其在该地区的防务承诺”。 她表示，华盛顿的首要任务是保卫美国本土并保障进入主要经济市场和贸易路线的机会。最好的办法是从“第一岛链”撤军，该岛链从日本南部的冲绳岛，穿过台湾，一直延伸到菲律宾。 卡瓦纳写道，美军应该削减规模，并转移到“第二岛链”，该岛链从日本东部到太平洋中部的北马里亚纳群岛、关岛、帕劳，再到巴布亚新几内亚。 报告指出，撤军将使他们的阵地更容易保卫，并“减少与中国发生灾难性战争的风险”。 可以说，这种撤军对台湾的感受最为强烈，北京将台湾视为一个叛逆的省份，有一天必须被纳入大中华区。 卡瓦纳在报告中指出，美国没有正式承诺在台湾遭受中国袭击时向台湾提供援助。她警告说，任何武装冲突“都会给美国带来高昂的代价，远远超过任何好处”。 她说：“鉴于成本效益计算如此不平衡，美国改变对台湾的承诺似乎是明智的。” “如果台湾问题发生任何军事对抗，美国应该从战略模糊转向明确的不干预政策。” 国际危机组织驻台湾安全分析师杨威廉告诉德国之声，报告中点名的国家尚未对该智库的提议发表正式评论，但其结论“将会令人震惊”。 杨说，鉴于国防优先基金会以其孤立主义外交和国防政策立场而闻名，并且据称与白宫许多高级和志同道合的决策者有联系，这种担忧将会更加严重。 杨指出，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普多次威胁称，如果他在双边关系其他领域提出的更多付款或让步的要求得不到满足，他将从欧洲和亚洲盟国撤军。

reflection.en: A report from the Defense Priorities Foundation suggests a significant shift in US defense strategy, advocating for a pullback from the western Pacific and the termination of key alliances. This proposal, intended to re-evaluate commitments, has understandably alarmed long-standing allies who rely on these security arrangements. The situation underscores...
reflection.zh: 国防优先基金会的一份报告建议美国国防战略发生重大转变，主张从西太平洋撤军并终止关键联盟。这项旨在重新评估承诺的提议，可以理解地引起了那些依赖这些安全安排的长期盟友的警惕。这一局势凸显了在考虑影响全球稳定和信任的重大政策变革时，审慎权衡和明智咨询的至关重要性。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: China tightens travel rules over tech security
title.zh: 中国收紧旅行规定以保障科技安全

summary.en: Beijing has implemented new travel restrictions, including exit bans for individuals deemed to have endangered China's "industrial or technological security." These rules, particularly relevant to artificial intelligence and technology import/export violations, aim to protect national sovereignty, security, and...
summary.zh: 北京实施了新的旅行限制，包括对被认为危害中国“工业或技术安全”的个人实施出境禁令。这些规定尤其针对人工智能以及技术进出口违规行为，旨在保护国家主权、安全和发展利益，并可能影响外国及台湾国民。

body.en:
Beijing says the new rules, which could also apply to foreign and Taiwanese nationals, are aimed at safeguarding "national security."

Sweeping travel restrictions on Chinese citizens came into effect on Tuesday, including exit bans for people considered to have endangered China 's "industrial or technological security."

The new exit-and-entry rules, which were passed in July, apply to citizens deemed to have violated technology import and export regulations, particularly in the field of artificial intelligence .

The State Council in Beijing said the new rules were formulated to "safeguard national sovereignty, security, and development interests."

The regulations apply not only to people within China but also to Chinese citizens deemed to have committed criminal acts abroad.

In such cases, citizens could be "prohibited from leaving the country for a period of six months to three years from the date of their return to China," said the State Council.

The restrictions come as China remains locked in a technological arms race with the United States , with both countries accusing each other of stealing locally developed AI models in recent months.

And analysts warn that the full scope of the new rules will only become clear once they start being implemented.

Security and criminal activities "can be vaguely defined and easily adjusted," said Chong Ja Ian, an analyst from the National University of Singapore , telling the AFP news agency that Beijing has given itself a "wide remit."

Under the new regulations, foreign nationals could also be denied entry to China for up to five years if found to have made false statements in ​visa applications.

Foreign governments have often reported instances of citizens being denied permission to leave China due ⁠to security-related ​investigations.

Analyst Chong highlighted the recent case of US citizen Min Zin who the US government said was detained improperly in Yunnan province in June.

"The case of Min Zin is a reminder that the range of people [that Beijing] could restrict from exiting could be quite wide – and potentially arbitrary," he said.

The new rules could have particular implications for Taiwanese nationals who work in the tech sector and who travel between Taiwan and China .

Authorities in Taipei have warned citizens to take extra care on visits to China, which considers people from Taiwan to be Chinese citizens.

Beijing has dismissed any such concerns, claiming the rules provide better legal protection for Taiwanese.

Dylan Loh, an associate professor at Singapore's Nanyang Technological University, told AFP the travel restrictions "send a message" that China will take action to prevent "leaks in security or national interest-sensitive areas."

If you rely on our team for trusted...
body.zh: 北京表示，新规定也可能适用于外国人和台湾公民，旨在维护“国家安全”。 对中国公民的全面旅行限制于周二生效，包括对被认为危及中国“工业或技术安全”的人实施出境禁令。 7月份通过的新出入境规定适用于被视为违反技术进出口规定的公民，特别是在人工智能领域。 北京国务院表示，制定新规定是为了“维护国家主权、安全、发展利益”。 该规定不仅适用于中国境内的人，也适用于被认为在国外有犯罪行为的中国公民。 国务院表示，在这种情况下，公民可能“自返回中国之日起六个月至三年内禁止出境”。 这些限制出台之际，中国仍陷入与美国的技术军备竞赛，近几个月来两国互相指责对方窃取当地开发的人工智能模型。 分析人士警告说，新规则的全部范围只有在开始实施后才会变得清晰。 新加坡国立大学分析师庄嘉伊恩 (Chong Ja Ian) 告诉法新社，安全和犯罪活动“可以被模糊地定义，并且很容易调整”。他告诉法新社，北京方面已经赋予了自己“广泛的职权范围”。 根据新规定，如果发现在签证申请中提供虚假陈述，外国人也可能被拒绝进入中国，最长可达五年。 外国政府经常报告公民因安全相关调查而被拒绝离开中国的情况。 分析师 Chong 重点介绍了最近发生的美国公民敏津的案件，美国政府称其于 6 月在云南省被不当拘留。 “敏津的案例提醒我们，（北京）可以限制退出的人群范围可能相当广泛，而且可能是任意的，”他说。 新规定可能对在科技行业工作以及在台湾和中国大陆之间旅行的台湾国民产生特别影响。 台北当局警告公民前往中国大陆时要格外小心，中国将台湾人视为中国公民。 北京方面否认了任何此类担忧，声称这些规则为台湾人提供了更好的法律保护。 新加坡南洋理工大学副教授迪伦·卢告诉法新社，旅行限制“发出了一个信息”，即中国将采取行动防止“安全或国家利益敏感领域的泄密”。 如果您信赖我们的团队值得信赖...

reflection.en: The implementation of sweeping travel restrictions and exit bans in China, justified under the banner of national security, raises concerns about the potential for unchecked state power. Proverbs 28:15 warns that "when the wicked rule, people groan," highlighting the human cost when security measures become oppressive.
reflection.zh: 中国以国家安全为由实施广泛的旅行限制和出境禁令，这引发了对国家权力不受制约的担忧。《箴言》28章15节警告说：“恶人掌权，人民就叹息。”这句经文强调了当安全措施变得压迫性时，所带来的巨大的人类代价。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: ‘This is seriously bold’: How China turned Taiwan tensions into a top-rating TV spy drama
title.zh: “这真是大胆”：中国如何将台湾紧张局势变成一部收视率飙升的电视间谍剧

summary.en: A new Chinese spy drama, 'Long Watch' (Jiaofeng), co-produced by the Ministry of State Security, has become a hit across the Taiwan Strait. The show, which fictionalizes real-life crises, follows a double agent working for China whose cover is blown. While dismissed as propaganda in Taiwan, the series' success...
summary.zh: 一部由国家安全部联合制作的中国新间谍剧《交锋》（Jiaofeng）已成为海峡两岸的热门剧集。该剧将现实生活中的危机虚构化，讲述了一名在中国大陆秘密工作的双面间谍被揭穿的故事。尽管在台湾被斥为宣传片，但该剧的成功凸显了娱乐媒体在处理敏感政治话题方面的作用。

body.en: Dismissed in Taiwan as simply propaganda, the Long Watch, or Jiaofeng, has proved a sensation across the strait with its references to real-life crises After shaking off the people trailing her through a crowded market and emerging from a bathroom in disguise, the double agent appears to have escaped. But a sip of water on a plane eventually gets her. She is poisoned after Taiwan’s military intelligence service discovers that she has been working secretly for China. The plot comes from a new Chinese spy drama co-produced by the Ministry of State Security. Since its premiere on 6 September, it has become a TV hit, with a fictionalised take on a subject rarely treated so directly: the modern history of tensions with Taiwan. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在台湾，《长守》或《叫风》被认为只是宣传品，但它却因提及现实生活中的危机而轰动了海峡两岸。在摆脱了跟踪她的人穿过拥挤的市场，乔装打扮地从浴室里出来后，这位双重间谍似乎已经逃脱了。但飞机上的一小口水最终让她崩溃了。台湾军事情报部门发现她一直在为中国大陆秘密工作后，她被毒死。剧情来自于国家安全部联合制作的一部新的中国谍战剧。自 9 月 6 日首播以来，它已成为电视热门节目，以虚构的方式讲述了一个很少如此直接处理的主题：与台湾紧张关系的现代历史。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This drama, 'Long Watch,' produced with the involvement of China's Ministry of State Security, uses fictionalized events to explore cross-strait tensions. It raises questions about how narratives are shaped and disseminated through popular media, reminding us of the importance of discerning truth from fiction, as Ephesians 4:25 urges us to speak truthfully...
reflection.zh: 这部由中国国家安全部参与制作的《交锋》剧集，通过虚构的情节来探讨海峡两岸的紧张局势。它引发了关于叙事如何通过大众媒体塑造和传播的疑问，提醒我们要分辨真伪，正如以弗所书4章25节所劝勉的，要说诚实话。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: China dismisses AI ‘fearmongering’ as spy chief warns of threat to Communist party rule
title.zh: 中国驳斥人工智能‘危言耸听’，因间谍头子警告其威胁执政党统治

summary.en: Beijing has responded to calls for the US to hinder China's AI industry, dismissing them as 'fearmongering.' This comes as China's top spy chief expressed concerns that the advancement of artificial intelligence could pose a threat to the rule of the Communist party.
summary.zh: 北京方面驳斥了要求美国阻碍中国人工智能产业发展的呼吁，称其为‘危言耸听’。与此同时，中国最高情报官员警告称，人工智能的不断发展可能威胁到共产党统治。

body.en: Beijing hits back after Anthropic CEO calls for US to impede China’s progress in AI China has dismissed what it said were “fearmongering” calls for the US to block Beijing’s AI industry, even as the top Chinese spy chief warned the evolving technology could threaten Communist party rule. The US tech entrepreneur and Anthropic chief executive, Dario Amodei, wrote an essay published over the weekend that called for a global slowdown in AI capabilities, but also said Washington should actively impede Beijing’s advancement in order to keep a technological edge. Continue reading...
body.zh: Anthropic首席执行官呼吁美国阻止中国在人工智能领域取得进展，北京对此进行了反击。尽管中国最高间谍头子警告说，不断发展的技术可能会威胁共产党的统治，但中国驳回了所谓美国封锁北京人工智能产业的“恐吓”呼吁。美国科技企业家兼 Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 在周末发表了一篇文章，呼吁全球人工智能能力放缓，但也表示华盛顿应积极阻碍北京的进步，以保持技术优势。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence presents humanity with unprecedented capabilities, prompting both excitement and apprehension. As nations and leaders grapple with its potential, the ancient story of Babel reminds us that unchecked ambition, even in pursuit of knowledge or power, can lead to unintended consequences and division.
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展为人类带来了前所未有的能力，既引发了兴奋，也带来了忧虑。当国家和领导人都在努力应对其潜力时，古老的巴别塔故事提醒我们，即使是在追求知识或权力的过程中，不受约束的野心也可能导致意想不到的后果和分裂。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Europe must build own AI or risk getting cut off by US or China, says ECB’s Lagarde
title.zh: 欧洲必须建立自己的人工智能，否则就有被美国或中国切断的风险，欧洲央行行长表示

summary.en: Christine Lagarde, president of the European Central Bank, has stated that Europe must develop its own artificial intelligence (AI) technology and build more data centers to avoid the risk of being cut off by the United States or China. She believes that Europe's dependency on AI could grant trade partners significant...
summary.zh: 欧洲央行行长克里斯蒂娜·拉加德表示，欧洲必须发展自己的人工智能（AI）技术并建立更多数据中心，以避免被美国或中国切断的风险。她认为，欧洲对人工智能的依赖可能使贸易伙伴在谈判中获得巨大的影响力，而发展足够强大的国内人工智能模型将减弱这种威胁。

body.en: Central bank chief says continent’s AI dependency could give trade partners unprecedented leverage in negotiations Europe must develop its own AI technology and build more datacentres in order to nullify the threat of being cut off by the US or China, according to the president of the European Central Bank. Christine Lagarde said the continent needed AI models – the technology that powers AI tools such as chatbots – that were “good enough” to carry out most tasks and run from domestic datacentres. If Europe invests in its own AI tech, said Lagarde, “the threat of being cut off loses its force”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 欧洲央行行长表示，欧洲大陆对人工智能的依赖可能会给贸易伙伴在谈判中带来前所未有的影响力，欧洲必须开发自己的人工智能技术并建立更多的数据中心，以消除被美国或中国切断联系的威胁。克里斯蒂娜·拉加德表示，非洲大陆需要人工智能模型——为聊天机器人等人工智能工具提供动力的技术——“足够好”来执行大多数任务并在国内数据中心运行。拉加德表示，如果欧洲投资自己的人工智能技术，“被切断的威胁就会失去力量”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The Tower of Babel narrative in Genesis 11 describes humanity's unified ambition to reach the heavens, only to have their languages confused, scattering them across the earth. Christine Lagarde's warning about Europe's AI dependency and the potential for trade partners to exert leverage echoes this theme of unchecked ambition leading to unintended...
reflection.zh: 《创世记》第11章的巴别塔故事描述了人类统一的野心，试图达到天堂，却因语言混乱而被分散到全地。欧洲央行行长拉加德关于欧洲在人工智能方面依赖他国以及贸易伙伴可能施加压力的警告，呼应了这种不受约束的野心导致意想不到的后果和分裂的主题。...

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Jeremy Thomas obituary
title.zh: 杰里米·托马斯逝世悼词

summary.en: Jeremy Thomas, a film producer known for his greatest success with the 1987 epic 'The Last Emperor,' for which he won an Oscar, has died at the age of 77. He was recognized for his ability to take risks in filmmaking, a trait inherited from his family of directors.
summary.zh: 电影制片人杰里米·托马斯（Jeremy Thomas）因其1987年的史诗巨作《末代皇帝》而获得奥斯卡奖，他于本周去世，享年77岁。他以其在电影制作中冒险的才能而闻名，这种特质也继承自他的导演世家。

body.en: Film producer who enjoyed his greatest success with the 1987 epic The Last Emperor for which he won an Oscar Asked whether he had ever cautioned restraint from a director, the film producer Jeremy Thomas replied: “My nature would be to go further and see what we can get away with.” Thomas, who has died aged 77, was an expert in getting away with it. A taste for irreverence ran in his family: he was the son of Ralph Thomas , director of the Doctor … comedies that began in 1954 with Doctor in the House, and the nephew of Gerald Thomas, who made all 31 Carry On titles. Jeremy’s own films, however, were risky rather than risque. Continue reading...
body.zh: 凭借 1987 年史诗片《末代皇帝》获得奥斯卡奖而获得最大成功的电影制片人 当被问及是否曾警告过导演克制时，电影制片人杰里米·托马斯回答说：“我的本性是走得更远，看看我们能做些什么。”托马斯去世时享年 77 岁，他是逃脱惩罚的专家。他的家族中流淌着不敬的品味：他是拉尔夫·托马斯 (Ralph Thomas) 的儿子，拉尔夫·托马斯 (Ralph Thomas) 是喜剧片《医生》(Doctor) 的导演，该喜剧于 1954 年以《Doctor in the House》开始，他是杰拉尔德·托马斯 (Gerald Thomas) 的侄子，杰拉德·托马斯 (Gerald Thomas) 制作了全部 31 部《Carry On》影片。然而，杰里米自己的电影是有风险的，而不是有伤风化的。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Jeremy Thomas, the acclaimed producer behind 'The Last Emperor,' has passed away at 77. His life's work, marked by bold artistic choices, now concludes. As we reflect on his passing, we are reminded of our own finitude, a universal truth that calls us to consider the legacy we leave behind.
reflection.zh: 凭借《末代皇帝》而闻名的著名制片人杰里米·托马斯（Jeremy Thomas）已于77岁辞世。他一生致力于大胆的艺术选择，如今已画上句点。当我们回顾他的离世时，也提醒了我们自身的有限性，这一普遍真理促使我们反思自己留下的遗产。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Xi Jinping gets red carpet at Brics summit amid thaw in India-China relations
title.zh: 习近平出席金砖峰会获红地毯礼遇，中印关系出现缓和

summary.en: Chinese President Xi Jinping received a formal welcome in India for the BRICS summit, marking a significant step toward reconciliation after the 2020 military conflict. While the two nations remain regional rivals, the public display of thawing relations suggests a mutual desire to stabilize the border and cooperate...
summary.zh: 中国国家主席习近平在印度出席金砖国家峰会时受到红地毯欢迎，这被视为中印在2020年发生致命军事冲突后迈向和解的重要一步。尽管两国仍是地区竞争对手，但这种公开的缓和迹象表明，双方都有意稳定边境并在全球舞台上进行合作。

body.en: Chinese president’s arrival in Delhi seen as step towards reconciliation after deadly 2020 military clash The Chinese president, Xi Jinping, has received a red-carpet welcome in India for a summit of Brics developing nations, as regional rivals Beijing and Delhi make a public display of thawing relations while quietly competing to lead at a time of shaky US global dominance. As Xi stepped off the plane, he was walked past an honour guard of Indian soldiers and traditional dancers in colourful dresses. Later on Saturday, he was due to attend a gala dinner for the two-day summit. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国国家主席抵达德里被视为2020年致命军事冲突后迈向和解的一步 中国国家主席习近平在印度出席金砖国家发展中国家峰会时受到红地毯欢迎，区域竞争对手北京和德里公开展示关系解冻，同时在美国全球主导地位摇摇欲坠之际悄悄竞争领导地位。当习近平走下飞机时，他走过由印度士兵和身着彩色服装的传统舞者组成的仪仗队。周六晚些时候，他将出席为期两天的峰会的晚宴。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The red-carpet welcome for President Xi in Delhi serves as a powerful symbol of reconciliation following the deadly 2020 military clash. It demonstrates that even between fierce regional rivals, the pursuit of stability is a necessary and honorable path. This diplomatic effort reflects the heart of Yahweh, who calls us to live at peace with all people as...
reflection.zh: 习近平主席在德里受到红地毯欢迎，是2020年致命军事冲突后和解的有力象征。这表明，即使在激烈的地区竞争对手之间，追求稳定也是一条必要且光荣的道路。这种外交努力反映了雅伟的心意，祂呼召我们要竭力与众人和睦相处，只要凡事能在乎自己。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Why North Korea's Kim Jong Un doesn't need a US deal
title.zh: 朝鲜的金正恩为何不需要与美国达成协议

summary.en: Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，平壤在得到鼓舞后正在加速其核计划，并巩固与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。

body.en:
Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.

In August, US President Donald Trump revived a charm offensive aimed at Pyongyang by drastically scaling back joint US military exercises with South Korea and heaping praise on North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. The US president said the North Korean dictator "has always treated me with great respect."

North Korea's response to Trump's overtures has been markedly less enthusiastic, ranging from firing a barrage of missiles to publicly denying Trump's claims that Kim has responded "very positively" to a request for talks.

This week, as the US and South Korea, along with Japan, kicked off a five-day military drill, there was no mention of any pullback from Washington, nor any sign of diplomatic progress with Pyongyang.

Instead, Kim on Monday commissioned a naval destroyer, while again emphasizing North Korea must establish a "powerful and reliable nuclear war deterrent" and strengthen "maritime defense." Kim also said North Korea would soon unveil a "significant" naval advancement.

Unlike the summit diplomacy of Trump's first term, Kim's dismissive stance comes at a time when North Korea has alternatives to a grand bargain with the United States.

"For Kim, the stakes are simply lower than they were in 2019. There is no longer the same sense of urgency in Pyongyang to get back to the negotiating table with Washington," Joon Ha Park, a correspondent at Korea Risk Group in Seoul, told DW.

"North Korea now has a treaty-based alliance with Moscow and is drawing closer to Beijing, while its military capabilities have expanded significantly. That's why a single reduction in ROK-US military exercises is not enough for Pyongyang to be swayed," he added, referring to military ties between South Korea and the US.

Park agrees that Kim is arguably in his strongest position since taking power in 2011. Just six years ago, amid crippling sanctions and the coronavirus pandemic, an emotional Kim stood at the lectern marking the 75th anniversary of the Korean Workers' Party and expressed regret for having failed the North Korean people.

Fast forward to today, and North Korea's economy appears to be on a stronger footing . Estimates released last year by South Korea's central bank showed the economy expanded by 3.7% in 2024, its fastest rate of growth in eight years.

Kim has brought North Korea closer to Russia and China than the traditionally isolated country has been in decades. This week, both Moscow and Beijing sent messages marking North Korea's 78th founding anniversary and praising the strategic importance of their deepening partnerships with...
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，胆大妄为的平壤加速了核计划，并巩固了与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。 上个月，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普大幅缩减美国与韩国的联合军演，并对朝鲜领导人金正恩大加赞扬，从而重新发起针对平壤的魅力攻势。美国总统表示，朝鲜独裁者“一直非常尊重我”。 朝鲜对特朗普提议的反应明显不那么热情，从发射一连串导弹到公开否认特朗普关于金正恩对会谈请求做出“非常积极”回应的说法。 本周，美国、韩国以及日本开始了为期五天的军事演习，但没有提到华盛顿有任何撤军，也没有任何与平壤取得外交进展的迹象。 相反，金正恩周一委托了一艘海军驱逐舰，同时再次强调朝鲜必须建立“强大而可靠的核战争威慑力量”并加强“海上防御”。金正恩还表示，朝鲜很快将公布一项“重大”海军进展。 与特朗普第一任期的峰会外交不同，金正恩的不屑一顾的立场是在朝鲜除了与美国达成大交易之外还有其他选择之际采取的。 “对金正恩来说，赌注比2019年要低。平壤不再有回到与华盛顿谈判桌的紧迫感，”首尔韩国风险集团记者Joon Ha Park告诉德国之声。 “朝鲜现在与莫斯科建立了基于条约的联盟，并且正在向北京靠拢，而其军事能力也显着增强。这就是为什么韩美军事演习的一次减少不足以让平壤动摇，”他在谈到韩国和美国之间的军事关系时补充道。 朴槿惠也同意，金正恩可以说是自 2011 年上台以来处于最有利的位置。 就在六年前，在严厉的制裁和冠状病毒大流行的背景下，金正恩情绪激动地站在纪念朝鲜劳动党成立75周年的讲台上，对辜负了朝鲜人民的期望表示遗憾。 快进到今天，朝鲜经济似乎已经站稳了脚跟。韩国央行去年发布的预测显示，2024年经济将增长3.7%，为八年来最快增速。 金正恩使朝鲜与俄罗斯和中国的关系比这个传统上孤立的国家几十年来更加接近。本周，莫斯科和北京都发出了纪念朝鲜成立 78 周年的信息，并赞扬了两国深化与朝鲜的伙伴关系的战略重要性……

reflection.en: The news highlights how Kim Jong Un's regime continues to advance its nuclear ambitions, seemingly unfazed by diplomatic overtures. Proverbs 28:15 warns that 'When the wicked rule, people groan.' This verse speaks to the inherent instability and suffering that can arise when power is wielded without accountability, as seen in the continued acceleration of...
reflection.zh: 新闻指出，金正恩政权似乎并未受到外交示好的影响，仍在推进其核野心。箴言 28:15 警告说：“恶人在位，人就叹息。”这节经文呼应了当权力在缺乏问责的情况下被滥用时，可能产生的固有不稳定和苦难，正如在国际关注下朝鲜核计划的持续加速所见。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Call in China to end English's core status sparks debate
title.zh: 中国呼吁结束英语核心地位引发辩论

summary.en: A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers, and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.
summary.zh: 在中国学校降低英语地位的呼吁正在引发关于其对学生、职业以及人工智能时代中国全球竞争力的价值的讨论。

body.en:
A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.

From business and academia to social media and entertainment — English is considered the dominant global language. One in five people on Earth actively uses this lingua franca. In China , a mathematics professor specializing in vector algebra is now challenging this dominance in no uncertain terms. Tang Jiafeng believes that English should be abolished as a core subject in elementary schools, secondary schools and universities.

Tang is convinced that no other country in the world has placed as much importance on English as China has.

"Our children desperately begin learning English even before they have properly mastered their native language. Yet we are a civilization that dates back thousands of years. English is just a tool. It's enough to be able to use it. The tradition of revering and emulating Western cultures must come to an end," Tang says in social media.

English is considered difficult in China, since the Chinese language does not use an alphabetic script. It is a required subject starting in third grade. It is graded on par with Chinese and mathematics on the entrance exam for secondary schools, the central exam after 9th grade, and the high school graduation exam. A maximum of 150 points can be earned on the latter.

"How many resources and how much time do our children, parents and schools invest in a subject that is completely irrelevant to the majority of people in their future professional lives?" the mathematician asks, explaining his position.

He became well-known because many of his students achieved full scores on state math exams; in the class of 2011, six students from a single class did so.

"Why cram for English when artificial intelligence can translate everything in seconds?" comments a user from Beijing.

Another suggestion from the southern province of Guangdong is to at least adjust the scoring — for example, to 120 points instead of 150 on the high school graduation exam.

Many parents invest in private tutoring that focuses specifically on exam questions. In addition, all bachelor's students must pass the English exam before being admitted to master's programs. Tang suspects that this could cause many young talents in the natural sciences to fail, even though they have great potential to become top researchers.

There is no question that English is also important for STEM subjects. Research on future-oriented topics is typically published in English. There are fears circulating online that cutting back on English instruction could lead to a decline in China's competitiveness. A prominent advocate for English as a required subject is Hu Xijin,...
body.zh: 降低中国学校英语等级的呼声引发了关于人工智能时代英语对学生、职业和中国全球竞争力价值的讨论。 从商业和学术界到社交媒体和娱乐——英语被认为是全球主导语言。地球上五分之一的人积极使用这种通用语言。在中国，一位专门研究向量代数的数学教授现在正在毫不含糊地挑战这一主导地位。唐家峰认为，应该取消英语作为小学、中学和大学的核心科目。 唐坚信，世界上没有哪个国家像中国一样重视英语。 唐在社交媒体上表示：“我们的孩子在还没有真正掌握母语之前就拼命地开始学习英语。但我们是一个有着数千年历史的文明。英语只是一种工具，能够使用它就足够了。尊重和效仿西方文化的传统必须结束。” 英语在中国被认为很难，因为中文不使用字母文字。这是从三年级开始的必修科目。中学入学考试、九年级后的集中考试和高中毕业考试的成绩与语文和数学同等。后者最多可获得 150 点积分。 “我们的孩子、家长和学校在一个与大多数人未来职业生涯完全无关的主题上投入了多少资源和时间？”数学家问道，并解释了他的立场。 他之所以出名，是因为他的许多学生在州数学考试中取得了满分。 2011届的一个班有六名学生这样做了。 “当人工智能可以在几秒钟内翻译所有内容时，为什么还要死记硬背英语呢？”北京网友评论。 来自南方省份广东省的另一项建议是至少调整分数——例如，高中毕业考试的分数从150分调整为120分。 许多家长投资专门针对考试问题的私人辅导。此外，所有学士学生必须通过英语考试才能进入硕士课程。唐怀疑这可能会导致许多自然科学领域的年轻人才失败，尽管他们有成为顶尖研究人员的巨大潜力。 毫无疑问，英语对于 STEM 科目也很重要。面向未来的主题的研究通常以英文发表。网上流传着这样的担忧：削减英语教学可能会导致中国竞争力下降。将英语作为必修科目的一位著名倡导者是胡锡进……

reflection.en: The debate in China about the role of English in education touches on how societies navigate the explosion of knowledge and global communication. As Professor Tang Jiafeng questions English's dominance, it mirrors the broader challenge of discerning which knowledge serves us best in an era of unprecedented information growth, as described in Daniel 12:4:...
reflection.zh: 在中国关于英语教育作用的辩论，触及了社会如何应对知识的爆炸式增长和全球交流。正如唐嘉风教授质疑英语的主导地位，这也反映了一个更广泛的挑战：在一个信息空前增长的时代，辨别哪些知识最能服务于我们。正如但以理书12:4所描述的：“必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。”

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

reflection.en: Political discourse can often become a stage for ego and partisan conflict, as seen in the clash between Andrew Hastie and Pauline Hanson. The call to "do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit, but in humility consider others better than yourselves" reminds us to seek unity and service over personal gain or political point-scoring.
reflection.zh: 政治论述常常可能成为个人野心和党派冲突的舞台，安德鲁·哈斯蒂与宝琳·汉森之间的争执便是一个例子。《腓立比书》2章3节呼吁“凡所行的，都不要出于好争好胜，或虚荣心，乃要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强”，提醒我们要寻求合一与服务，而非个人利益或政治上的争胜。

title.en: How a 100-year-old population estimate may have got Australia wrong
title.zh: 一项有100年历史的人口估计可能让澳大利亚出了错

summary.en: Australia's pre-colonial population estimates have long been influenced by a figure from decades ago, which a new study suggests was far too low. Researchers now estimate that around 2.2 million Indigenous Australians lived on the continent before British colonization in 1788, a figure that, if accurate, implies a...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚殖民前的估计人口长期以来受到几十年前一个数字的影响，而一项新研究表明该数字可能过低。研究人员现在估计，在1788年英国殖民澳大利亚之前，大陆上约有220万原住民澳大利亚人居住，如果这个数字准确，则意味着在1788年至1861年间人口减少了200多万。

body.en:
How many people lived in Australia before colonisation? For nearly a century, many answers to that question have been influenced by a figure developed by anthropologist Alfred Radcliffe-Brown, who estimated the population at 250,000.

But new research from a national team of academics suggests there could have been about 2.2 million Indigenous Australians living on the continent before the British colonisation in 1788.

Based on the revised population figure and comparisons with early Census records, researchers estimate the Indigenous population declined by more than two million people between 1788 and 1861.

Corey Bradshaw, a professor of global ecology at Flinders University who co-led the research, told SBS News the findings illustrate the magnitude of the demographic collapse experienced by Indigenous Australians.

Researchers believe the decline was likely driven by a combination of introduced diseases, frontier violence, malnutrition, dispossession and other impacts of colonisation.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"We're now starting to look at things like the massacres and try to de-bias a lot of that as well, because of course that's only the tip of the iceberg in terms of what was recorded," Bradshaw said.

The team relied on three independent approaches — archaeological, genetic and environmental modelling — rather than relying primarily on historical accounts.

Bradshaw said the approach is less vulnerable to the biases and gaps in historical records, and each of the three methods produced a relatively congruent set of estimates.

The 1930 estimate of roughly 250,000, Bradshaw said, was developed at a time when researchers lacked access to modern tools.

He said its creator acknowledged it was likely an underestimate, but the figure became widely accepted despite its limitations.

Other historical estimates suggested the population of Indigenous Australians may have been up to one million people, still under half of what the new research suggests.

Bradshaw said understanding the size of Indigenous populations before colonisation was essential to truth-telling and reconciliation.

"It's something that we have to acknowledge in our history and not sweep under the carpet," he said.

"It's part of understanding why the gap still exists in many aspects of society, and how to address it, and how long we might expect things to take to realign. I mean, these are huge demographic catastrophes that affected people for generations and generations."

The Indigenous population in Australia has grown since the 1950s, and represented 3.2 per cent of the overall population at the time of the 2021 Census at just under 813,000...
body.zh: 殖民之前有多少人居住在澳大利亚？近一个世纪以来，这个问题的许多答案都受到人类学家阿尔弗雷德·拉德克利夫-布朗 (Alfred Radcliffe-Brown) 提出的一个数字的影响，他估计人口为 25 万。 但国家学术团队的最新研究表明，在 1788 年英国殖民之前，可能有大约 220 万澳大利亚原住民生活在这片大陆上。 根据修订后的人口数据以及与早期人口普查记录的比较，研究人员估计 1788 年至 1861 年间，原住民人口减少了超过 200 万人。 这项研究的共同领导者、弗林德斯大学全球生态学教授科里·布拉德肖 (Corey Bradshaw) 告诉 SBS 新闻，研究结果说明了澳大利亚原住民经历的人口崩溃的严重程度。 研究人员认为，这种下降可能是由外来疾病、边境暴力、营养不良、剥夺和殖民化的其他影响共同造成的。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 布拉德肖说：“我们现在开始关注大屠杀等事情，并尝试消除其中的偏见，因为当然这只是记录的冰山一角。” 该团队依赖于三种独立的方法——考古学、遗传和环境模型——而不是主要依赖于历史记录。 布拉德肖表示，这种方法不太容易受到历史记录中的偏差和差距的影响，并且三种方法中的每一种都产生了一组相对一致的估计。 布拉德肖说，1930 年的估计约为 25 万，是在研究人员缺乏现代工具的情况下得出的。 他说，其创建者承认这可能被低估，但尽管有其局限性，该数字仍被广泛接受。 其他历史估计表明，澳大利亚原住民人口可能高达 100 万人，但仍不到新研究表明的一半。 布拉德肖表示，了解殖民前原住民人口的规模对于讲真话与和解至关重要。 “这是我们必须在历史上承认的事情，而不是掩盖起来，”他说。 “这是理解为什么社会许多方面仍然存在差距、如何解决它以及我们预计事情需要多长时间才能重新调整的一部分。我的意思是，这些是巨大的人口灾难，影响了一代又一代的人们。” 澳大利亚原住民人口自 2050 年代以来一直在增长，2021 年人口普查时占总人口的 3.2%，略低于 813,000 人……

reflection.en: For nearly a century, a single estimate shaped the understanding of Australia's pre-colonial Indigenous population. New research suggests this figure was drastically low, implying a devastating population loss. This story calls us to seek a more just and accurate accounting of history, reminding us that true justice flows like a mighty river, bringing life...
reflection.zh: 近一个世纪以来，一个单一的估计塑造了人们对澳大利亚殖民前原住民人口的认识。新的研究表明，这个数字大大偏低，暗示着毁灭性的人口损失。这个故事呼吁我们寻求一个更公正、更准确的历史记录，提醒我们真正的公义如江河滔滔，在曾经只有微弱误解的地方带来生命和真理。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!

title.en: 'Won't back away': Hanson's partial apology to Indigenous Australians and Albanese
title.zh: 汉森对澳大利亚原住民和阿尔巴尼斯的部分道歉：‘不会退缩’

summary.en: One Nation leader Pauline Hanson has issued a partial apology for comments made on a podcast where she described Indigenous Australians as 'the most primitive race on Earth.' While she expressed regret for offending people with the term, she stated her intention to continue speaking out on issues she perceives...
summary.zh: 一国党领袖宝琳·汉森就她在播客中称澳大利亚原住民为“地球上最原始的种族”的言论发表了部分道歉。她表示后悔用词冒犯了人们，但同时声明她将继续就她认为与该社群有关的问题发表看法。

body.en:
One Nation leader Pauline Hanson says she "regrets" comments she made on a podcast describing Indigenous Australians as "the most primitive race on Earth" but said she would continue to speak out about issues she perceives about the community.

"If I've offended people by using that (word), yes, I will apologise for that," Hanson told reporters in Canberra.

Hanson, during an interview with the JJ Podcast a year ago, criticised the study of Indigenous history in schools.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"What the hell have they done in this country for, you know, supposedly 60,000 years? They never invented the wheel. There was nothing there. What are we actually holding up? A few, you know, rock paintings?" Hanson said.

"Sorry, they're the most primitive race on Earth, and we're supposed to be holding up and saying what they've achieved. They've achieved nothing."

The comments sparked widespread outrage from politicians of all sides. Indigenous Australians Minister Malarndirri McCarthy called on Hanson to apologise, labelling her words "outrageous, completely racist" and divisive.

Greens leader Larissa Waters said the comments were "vile" and whitewashed 60,000 years of "proud" Indigenous history, while Opposition Indigenous Australians spokesperson Julian Leeser said they "belittled" the country.

Speaking separately on News24 before addressing reporters, Hanson did not address whether she would apologise for the comments.

"If we go back to the time of settlement in Australia, they were primitive compared to ... the settlers that came out here from England. But I'm not talking those terms now."

"I regret saying that because I don't want to upset people. That's not my intention. That wasn't my intention, to hurt people."

She said she would continue to speak out about "accountability" — calling for an audit into Indigenous funding — "third world conditions" and abuse.

"We're teaching [kids] Aboriginal languages that no longer is going to give them a job. We're not going to give them any future. We have to be realistic."

Hanson also offered a qualified apology to Prime Minister Anthony Albanese, after criticising his mother for spending decades in public housing and appearing to mock his story about growing up in housing commission.

"I don’t think my comments were derogatory towards his mother at all," Hanson said.

"I was referring to house commission at that time. So if he's taken offence to it, well, I'm sorry for that."

Albanese said he was proud of his upbringing and defended his mother as "way out of Pauline Hanson's league".

body.zh: 一国党领袖宝琳·汉森表示，她对自己在播客中发表的将澳大利亚原住民描述为“地球上最原始的种族”的言论感到“遗憾”，但表示她将继续谈论她对社区的看法。 汉森在堪培拉对记者说：“如果我用这个词冒犯了人们，是的，我会为此道歉。” 汉森在一年前接受 JJ 播客采访时批评了学校对土著历史的研究。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “他们到底在这个国家做了什么，你知道，据说有六万年了？他们从来没有发明过轮子。那里什么也没有。我们到底在拿什么？一些，你知道的，岩画？”汉森说道。 “抱歉，他们是地球上最原始的种族，我们应该坚持说他们所取得的成就。他们什么也没取得。” 这些言论引发了各方政界人士的普遍愤怒。澳大利亚原住民部长马拉迪里·麦卡锡呼吁汉森道歉，称她的言论“令人愤慨，完全是种族主义”和分裂性的。 绿党领袖拉里萨·沃特斯(Larissa Waters)表示，这些言论是“卑鄙的”，粉饰了6万年“自豪”的原住民历史，而反对党澳大利亚原住民发言人朱利安·利瑟(Julian Leeser)则表示，他们“贬低”了这个国家。 在向记者发表讲话之前，汉森在 News24 上单独发表讲话，但没有提及是否会为这些言论道歉。 “如果我们回到在澳大利亚定居的时代，与……从英国来到这里的定居者相比，他们是原始的。但我现在不是在谈论这些术语。” “我很遗憾这么说，因为我不想让别人不高兴。那不是我的本意。伤害别人不是我的本意。” 她说，她将继续谈论“问责制”——呼吁对土著资金进行审计——“第三世界条件”和虐待。 “我们教[孩子]原住民语言，这不再会给他们提供工作。我们不会给他们任何未来。我们必须现实一点。” 汉森还批评他的母亲在公共住房中度过了数十年，并似乎嘲笑了他在住房委员会长大的故事，并向总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯提出了有保留的道歉。 汉森说：“我认为我的言论根本没有贬低他的母亲。” “我当时指的是房屋佣金。所以如果他对此感到生气，那么，我对此感到抱歉。” 阿尔巴尼斯表示，他为自己的成长经历感到自豪，并为自己的母亲辩护称，“远远超出了宝琳·汉森的水平”。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: Words carry immense power, capable of inflicting deep wounds or building bridges. Pauline Hanson's description of Indigenous Australians as 'primitive' caused offense, leading to a partial apology. This highlights the profound impact of our language and the responsibility we bear for the words we choose, especially when discussing diverse communities.
reflection.zh: 言语拥有巨大的力量，既能造成深刻的创伤，也能搭建桥梁。宝琳·汉森将澳大利亚原住民描述为“原始的”，这引起了冒犯，并导致了部分道歉。这凸显了我们语言的深远影响，以及我们为所选词语所负的责任，尤其是在讨论不同社群时。

verse.textEn: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
verse.textZh: 生死在舌头的权下；喜爱它的，必吃它所结的果子。

title.en: Want a comfortable retirement? Here's the new super figure Australians need
title.zh: 想舒适退休？澳大利亚人需要的新退休金数字

summary.en: The gap between a modest retirement and a comfortable one is growing. See how much you need to bridge it.
summary.zh: 温和退休与舒适退休之间的差距正在扩大。看看你需要多少才能弥合它。

body.en:
Australians now need a little bit more in their super to retire comfortably, with the rising cost of living driving up the latest retirement standard.

A couple who own their home and are seeking a comfortable retirement will need $78,998 a year, or $1,513 a week. A single homeowner will need $56,166 a year, or $1,076 a week.

Those figures were released on Tuesday by the Association of Superannuation Funds of Australia (ASFA), the peak body for the super industry.

It showed for homeowners aged 65 to 84, the budget for a comfortable retirement rose 0.5 per cent for couples and 0.4 per cent for singles in the June quarter.

For a modest retirement, their budget rose 0.4 per cent for couples and 0.3 per cent for singles, to $52,690 and $36,548 a year respectively.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

For retirees aged 85 and over, a comfortable retirement will cost $74,484 per year for couples and $53,964 per year for singles. For retirees who rent privately, a modest budget is now $69,376 per year for a couple and $51,418 per year for a single.

ASFA CEO Mary Delahunty says retirees are being affected by the soaring cost of living more than others because the things they buy are rising quicker than the inflation rate of 3.8 per cent.

These include electricity, which the group said rose 22.4 per cent after federal and state rebates ended (22 per cent), car costs (6.5 per cent), medical services (5 per cent), insurance (almost 5 per cent) and meals out (4 per cent).

"Retirees are among the groups hit hardest by the cost of living crisis because their budgets are weighted towards the things going up in price the most," Delahunty said.

AFSA defines a comfortable retirement as being able to afford quality private health insurance, eat out most weeks, and go on a yearly holiday in Australia or overseas every few years.

A modest retirement includes basic health cover, such as a hospital-only plan, domestic-only holidays, and occasional eating out.

On the age pension alone, it's a much slimmer budget with limited lifestyle and basic living spending.

"Most of these things drop out of your budget entirely," ASFA CEO Mary Delahunty said.

She said while the age pension goes up with inflation, it doesn't allow for spending on other things like private health and holidays, which are increasing in price, and leaving retirees more reliant on their super to make those payments.

"Super is the difference between watching every dollar and having a sense of financial security in retirement," Delahunty said.

body.zh: 随着生活成本的上升推高了最新的退休标准，澳大利亚人现在需要在退休金中多存一些钱才能舒适地退休。 一对拥有自己房屋并寻求舒适退休生活的夫妇每年需要 78,998 美元，或每周 1,513 美元。单身房主每年需要 56,166 美元，或每周 1,076 美元。 这些数据是由超级行业的最高机构澳大利亚退休基金协会（ASFA）于周二发布的。 报告显示，对于 65 岁至 84 岁的房主来说，第二季度的舒适退休预算（夫妇）增长了 0.5%，单身人士增长了 0.4%。 对于适度的退休生活，夫妇的预算增加了 0.4%，单身的预算增加了 0.3%，分别达到每年 52,690 美元和 36,548 美元。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 对于85岁及以上的退休人员来说，舒适的退休生活每年花费夫妻74,484美元，单身每年53,964美元。对于私人租房的退休人员来说，目前的预算为夫妇每年 69,376 美元，单身每年 51,418 美元。 ASFA首席执行官玛丽·德拉亨蒂(Mary Delahunty)表示，退休人员比其他人受到生活成本飙升的影响更大，因为他们购买的东西的上涨速度快于3.8%的通货膨胀率。 其中包括电力（该组织称联邦和州回扣结束后上涨了22.4%）、汽车费用（6.5%）、医疗服务（5%）、保险（近5%）和外出就餐（4%）。 德拉亨蒂说：“退休人员是受生活成本危机打击最严重的群体之一，因为他们的预算偏向于价格上涨幅度最大的物品。” AFSA 将舒适的退休生活定义为能够负担得起优质的私人健康保险、大部分时间都在外面吃饭、每隔几年就去澳大利亚或海外度假。 适度的退休包括基本的医疗保险，例如仅限医院的计划、仅限国内的假期和偶尔外出就餐。 仅就养老金而言，由于生活方式和基本生活支出有限，预算就少得多。 ASFA 首席执行官玛丽·德拉亨蒂 (Mary Delahunty) 表示：“这些事情中的大部分都完全超出了你的预算。” 她说，虽然养老金随着通货膨胀而上涨，但它不允许用于私人医疗和假期等其他方面的支出，这些支出的价格正在上涨，并使退休人员更加依赖他们的退休金来支付这些费用。 “超级是关注每一块钱和在退休时拥有财务安全感之间的区别，”德拉亨蒂说。 随着澳大利亚联邦选举的临近，养老金已成为主要的政治竞选路线，因为各党派试图在生活成本高昂的情况下赢得选民......

title.en: Millions of Australians set to face spring wintry blast this week
title.zh: 本周数百万人将面临严寒的春天

summary.en: Spring sunshine is giving way to a cold snap across the south-east, before another change arrives.
summary.zh: 春日阳光正被一股寒流取代，席卷东南部地区，随后还将有另一波天气变化。

body.en:
Australians in the south-east states are being advised to expect a wintry blast this week, ending a brief spell of spring sunshine.

The Bureau of Meteorology says it's thanks to a cold front that will race up the east coast from Tuesday, which may even bring snow in Tasmania, Victoria and NSW.

For Victorians, it will mean showers and possible small hail in Melbourne and Geelong before clearing at the end of the day. For Melburnians, Tuesday's maximum of 14C will feel much cooler because of gusty winds.

That cold front, starting in Tasmania and Victoria, will then head towards NSW's east. The cold front will drop daily temperatures in Sydney from a maximum of 24C to 15C. In Newcastle it will go from 27C to 13C.

As the cold front hits the mid-north coast, it will combine with the afternoon heat to potentially bring thunderstorms.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In the country's west, showers and storms are expected, brought by onshore winds from the tropical north. It will then hit Western Australia's south and south-west.

The bureau said while all south-east capitals are forecast to have a cool start to the week, temperatures will warm up towards the weekend.

Its long-range forecast for September to November predicts both daytime and overnight temperatures are likely to be above average in most of Australia.

Rainfall is expected to be below average across parts of Australia's south and east, and above average across much of the western half of the country.

body.zh: 东南部各州的澳大利亚人被告知本周将迎来寒冷的天气，结束短暂的春日阳光。 气象局表示，这要归功于一股冷锋将从周二开始席卷东海岸，甚至可能给塔斯马尼亚州、维多利亚州和新南威尔士州带来降雪。 对于维多利亚州人来说，这意味着墨尔本和吉朗将有阵雨，并可能有小冰雹，然后在当天结束时放晴。对于墨尔本人来说，由于阵风，周二最高气温为 14 摄氏度，感觉会凉爽得多。 这股冷锋从塔斯马尼亚州和维多利亚州开始，然后将向新南威尔士州东部移动。冷锋将使悉尼每日气温从最高 24 摄氏度降至 15 摄氏度。纽卡斯尔气温将从 27 摄氏度升至 13 摄氏度。 当冷锋袭击中北部海岸时，它将与下午的炎热结合起来，可能会带来雷暴。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 在该国西部，预计将有阵雨和风暴，这是由热带北部吹来的陆上风带来的。然后它将袭击西澳大利亚州的南部和西南部。 气象局表示，虽然预计所有东南部首府本周都会有凉爽的天气，但周末气温将回升。 其对 9 月至 11 月的长期预测预测，澳大利亚大部分地区的白天和夜间气温可能会高于平均水平。 预计澳大利亚南部和东部部分地区的降雨量将低于平均水平，而该国西半部大部分地区的降雨量将高于平均水平。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

title.en: 'New low': Zali Steggall weighs in on controversial Sydney Sweeney ad
title.zh: “新低点”：扎利·斯特格尔评论悉尼·斯威尼的争议性广告

summary.en: The MP, who is Australia's most successful alpine skier, has added her thoughts to the criticism surrounding Sweeney's latest ad.
summary.zh: 这位澳大利亚最成功的冬季两项滑雪运动员的国会议员，对斯威尼最新的广告所引发的批评发表了自己的看法。

body.en:
Independent MP and former Olympian Zali Steggall has criticised a new sexualised sports betting advertisement featuring United States actress Sydney Sweeney as a "new low", amid mounting uproar over its depiction of women in sport.

In her latest controversial ad, Sweeney features naked in the ad for a sports betting company — in some scenes her private parts covered only by footballs or other sports gear.

"They wanted to show just sports," she says while sitting topless on a basketball hoop, before repeatedly saying "sports" in other suggestive poses.

The ad has sparked backlash from current and former female athletes around the world, outraged by its portrayal of women in sport. Some, including Australian water poloist Matilda Kearns, have taken to social media to show "real" women in sport.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Kearns posted a video of her competing in the pool and training at the gym with the caption: "Here's some real women sports content."

Retired Australian swimming champion Ariarne Titmus said the ad was "a kick in the face" to women who'd dedicated their lives to perfecting their craft.

"I can't describe how infuriated I feel when I watch this," she said in a since-expired social media post.

"How do we live in a world where monetising a woman's body and sexualising women's sport is still a thing? To take the mickey like this, I thought we were genuinely moving past this bullsh-t."

Steggall, Australia's most successful alpine skier, described the gambling ad as "incredibly disappointing and just offensive".

"It uses a woman's body to sell sports betting while reducing women's sport to a sexualised punchline. It's a trope that we need to do away with and it comes from an industry already targeting young men through sports to gamble to ruin their lives," Steggall said.

She said as a young athlete she was often pressured to do sexualised campaigns showing her body in ways that made her uncomfortable, and "really cheapened me as an athlete".

"Female athletes have fought for decades to be recognised for what we are, serious competitive athletes — strong and powerful," the MP for the Sydney seat of Warringah said in a social media post.

Steggall appealed to young girls, saying her Olympian's body is strong and powerful and she was proud of what her body was capable of.

"It doesn't look like what Sydney Sweeney and others show. It comes in all shapes and sizes.

"To young men — don't be fooled, this is a gambling company trying to lure you using sex to get your attention so they can lose their money."

body.zh: 独立议员、前奥运选手扎利·斯特格尔批评美国女演员西德尼·斯威尼主演的一则新的色情体育博彩广告“新低”，而女运动员对其对体育运动中女性形象的批评越来越多。 在她最新的备受争议的广告中，斯威尼在一家体育博彩公司的广告中赤身裸体，引发了轩然大波——在某些场景中，她的私处仅被足球或其他运动装备覆盖。 “他们只想展示体育运动，”她一边赤裸上身坐在篮球筐上，一边摆出其他姿势。 该广告引发了世界各地现任和前任女运动员的强烈反对，对其对体育运动中女性的描述感到愤怒。一些人在社交媒体上展示了运动中“真正的”女性，其中包括澳大利亚水球运动员玛蒂尔达·卡恩斯(Matilda Kearns)。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 卡恩斯发布了一段她在泳池比赛和在健身房训练的视频，并配上标题：“这里有一些真实的女性运动内容。” 澳大利亚退役游泳冠军阿莉亚妮·蒂特姆斯 (Ariarne Titmus) 表示，这则广告对那些毕生致力于完善游泳技术的女性来说是“一记耳光”。 她在一篇已过期的社交媒体帖子中表示：“我无法形容看到这一幕时我有多么愤怒。” “我们如何生活在一个将女性身体货币化和女性运动性感化仍然存在的世界里？以这样的方式对待米奇，我认为我们真的已经摆脱了这种胡言乱语。” 澳大利亚最成功的高山滑雪运动员斯特格尔将这则赌博广告描述为“令人难以置信的失望和无礼”。 “它利用女性的身体来推销体育博彩，同时将女性运动简化为性感的笑点。这是我们需要废除的一种比喻，它来自一个已经针对年轻男性的行业，通过体育赌博来毁掉他们的生活，”斯特格尔说。 她说，作为一名年轻的运动员，她经常被迫进行性感的活动，以让她不舒服的方式展示自己的身体，“这真的让我作为一名运动员贬低了”。 悉尼沃林加选区的议员在社交媒体上发帖称，“几十年来，女运动员一直在努力争取真正的竞技运动员的认可，她们坚强有力。” 斯蒂格尔对年轻女孩很有吸引力，她说她的奥运选手身体强壮有力，她为自己身体的能力感到自豪。 “它看起来不像西德尼·斯威尼和其他人展示的那样。它有各种形状和大小。 “年轻人，别被愚弄了，这是一家赌博公司，试图利用性来引诱你，以引起你的注意，这样他们就可以输掉钱。” 这并不是斯威尼第一次因广告引起争议。去年，她被指控...

reflection.en: The advertisement featuring Sydney Sweeney has drawn sharp criticism from female athletes for its sexualized depiction of women in sport. This situation calls to mind the call to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, ensuring their dignity is upheld. We are reminded to advocate for fairness and respect, particularly where vulnerability is...
reflection.zh: 由悉尼·斯威尼主演的这则广告因其对女性运动的性化描绘而引发了女运动员的严厉批评。这种情况让人联想到为那些不能为自己发声的人挺身而出的呼吁，确保他们的尊严得到维护。我们被提醒要倡导公平和尊重，尤其是在弱势群体被利用的情况下。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Hong Kong Desk
title.zh: 香港快讯

strap.zh: 聚焦香港时事、政策与社会动态。

title.en: Hong Kong finance chief urges Cathay to keep fares attractive, add routes
title.zh: 香港财政司司长敦促国泰航空保持票价吸引力并增加航线

summary.en: Hong Kong's Financial Secretary Paul Chan Mo-po has urged Cathay Pacific Airways to maintain competitive fares and broaden its route network. This call comes as China's national development plan aims to solidify Hong Kong's position as a global aviation hub, with Chan emphasizing the airline's role as an ambassador...
summary.zh: 香港财政司司长陈茂波敦促国泰航空保持票价竞争力并扩大航线网络。此举正值中国国家发展规划旨在巩固香港作为全球航空枢纽的地位之际，陈茂波强调该航空公司是香港的“超级联系人”和“大使”。

body.en: Hong Kong’s finance chief has called on Cathay Pacific Airways to offer attractive fares and expand its route network, as China’s national development plan reinforces the city’s status as a global aviation hub. Speaking at Cathay’s 80th anniversary celebration on Tuesday, Financial Secretary Paul Chan Mo-po described the flag carrier as more than just a transport provider, calling it an ambassador for Hong Kong that reinforced the city’s status as a global aviation hub and “superconnector”. Chan...
body.zh: 香港财政司长呼吁国泰航空提供有吸引力的票价并扩大其航线网络，因为中国的国家发展计划巩固了香港作为全球航空枢纽的地位。周二，财政司司长陈茂波在国泰航空成立 80 周年庆典上发表讲话时表示，这家旗舰航空公司不仅仅是一家运输提供商，还称其是香港的大使，巩固了香港作为全球航空枢纽和“超级联系人”的地位。陈...

reflection.en: As Hong Kong's finance chief encourages Cathay Pacific to strategically expand and offer attractive fares, we are reminded of the importance of entrusting all business endeavors to God's guidance. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our plans and works to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish them. This principle applies whether we are leading a global...
reflection.zh: 香港财政司司长鼓励国泰航空进行战略扩张并提供有吸引力的票价，这提醒我们应将所有商业活动都交托给雅伟的指引。《箴言》16:3鼓励我们将计划和工作交托给雅伟，并信靠祂必成就。无论我们是经营一家全球航空公司还是管理日常事务，这一原则都适用。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Nearly 1 tonne of fuel seized in illegal station bust
title.zh: 非法加油站被查获，缴获近一吨燃油

summary.en: Hong Kong's Fire Services Department arrested a man and seized nearly one tonne of petrol after discovering an illegal fuel filling station operating in a public housing estate car park in Wong Tai Sin. The operation was prompted by a report of a car leaking fuel and emitting a strong petrol odor.
summary.zh: 香港消防部门在黄大仙一个公共屋邨停车场内查获一个疑似非法加油站，并缴获近一吨汽油，随后拘捕一名男子。此次行动源于接获举报，指一辆汽车漏油并散发出浓烈汽油味。

body.en: The Fire Services Department (FSD) has arrested a man after busting a suspected illegal filling station located at a public housing estate car park in Wong Tai Sin, seizing nearly one tonne of petrol. The department was alerted on Monday that a car parked at Phase 2 of Tsz Lok Estate was leaking fuel and giving off a strong smell of petrol. Upon arrival, firefighters found a seven-seat vehicle leaking fuel and discovered a fuel tank along with refuelling equipment stored inside. During the operation, officers seized 921 litres of petrol – which was enough to fill around 20 private cars. A 34-year-old man holding a two-way permit was arrested on suspicion of committing multiple offences under the Dangerous Goods Ordinance and the Fire Services Ordinance. The department stressed that petrol is a highly flammable liquid fuel, posing a severe explosion risk in a densely populated area like Tsz Lok Estate. To combat illegal fuel activities, the FSD held a joint meeting on Tuesday with the Wong Tai Sin District Office, the local Fire Safety Committee, and the relevant property management firm to discuss ways to strengthen monitoring and heighten vigilance among front-line staff. The department also urged the public to report any suspected illegal refuelling activities through its complaints platform. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 消防处捣毁位于黄大仙公屋停车场的一个怀疑非法加油站，并检获近一吨汽油，拘捕一名男子。部门周一接获警报，一辆停泊在慈乐村二期的汽车出现漏油现象，并散发出浓烈的汽油味。消防队员到达后发现一辆七座车漏油，并发现一个油箱以及里面存放的加油设备。行动中，警方起获 921 升汽油，足以装满约 20 辆私家车。一名持有双向许可证的三十四岁男子因涉嫌触犯《危险品条例》及《消防条例》多项罪行而被捕。运输署强调，汽油是高度易燃的液体燃料，在慈乐村等人口稠密地区构成严重爆炸风险。为打击非法燃油活动，消防处周二与黄大仙民政事务处、当地消防安全委员会及相关物业管理公司举行联席会议，商讨如何加强监察，提高前线员工的警觉性。该部门还呼吁公众通过投诉平台举报任何涉嫌非法加油活动。谭咏麟编辑

reflection.en: This incident in Wong Tai Sin, where nearly a tonne of petrol was illegally stored and dispensed, points to a disregard for the safety and well-being of the community. It calls to mind the prophet Micah's timeless instruction: to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Yahweh. Such actions, prioritizing profit over people's safety, stand in stark...
reflection.zh: 黄大仙此次事件中，近一吨汽油被非法储存和分发，显示出对社区安全和福祉的漠视。这让人想起先知弥迦的永恒教导：当行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心与雅伟同行。此类将利润置于民众安全之上的行为，与这些道德要求形成了鲜明对比。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Tighter scrutiny of Hong Kong IPOs could slow deal flow, analysts say
title.zh: 香港IPO审查收紧或减缓交易量，分析师称

summary.en: Securities regulators in Hong Kong and mainland China are intensifying efforts to improve the quality of Hong Kong initial public offerings (IPOs). Analysts suggest this may slow the pace of new listings but is unlikely to dampen underlying demand. The China Securities Regulatory Commission has requested additional...
summary.zh: 香港和中国内地的证券监管机构正加大力度，以提高香港首次公开募股（IPO）的质量。分析师认为，这可能会减缓新股上市的速度，但不会削弱潜在需求。中国证券监督管理委员会最近要求九家已获批上市的内地公司提供有关资金使用、股权结构和待处理事项的补充材料。

body.en: Securities regulators in Hong Kong and mainland China are doubling down on efforts to raise the quality of Hong Kong initial public offerings (IPOs), which could slow the flow of new listings but would not reduce underlying demand, according to analysts. In an unusual move, the China Securities Regulatory Commission recently asked nine mainland companies, which had already been pre-approved for listings, to provide supplementary materials detailing fund usage, shareholding structures and pending...
body.zh: 分析师表示，香港和中国大陆的证券监管机构正在加倍努力提高香港首次公开募股(IPO)的质量，这可能会减缓新股上市的速度，但不会减少潜在需求。证监会最近一反常态，要求九家已获上市预核准的内地公司提供补充材料，详细说明资金用途、股权结构和待...

reflection.en: The pursuit of integrity in financial markets is a reflection of a deeper commitment to justice. When regulators increase scrutiny on IPOs, they are striving for a more honest and trustworthy system, echoing the call to 'act justly.' This effort, though it may slow processes, aims to build a foundation of fairness for investors and companies alike.
reflection.zh: 在金融市场追求诚信，是更深层次的公正承诺的体现。当监管机构加强对首次公开募股的审查时，他们是在努力建立一个更诚实、更值得信赖的体系，这呼应了‘秉公行义’的呼召。这项努力，尽管可能会放慢进程，但旨在为投资者和公司建立一个公平的基础。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.zh: 香港卫视新闻32台 - 9月15日

This echoes the ancient prophetic call for leaders to ensure the safety and well-being of the populace. Public service demands diligence and a commitment to the people's welfare, especially in essential services like healthcare infrastructure.

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Mainland Chinese joint venture launches new electric taxi in Hong Kong
title.zh: 内地合资企业在香港推出新款电动出租车

summary.en: A mainland Chinese joint venture is set to launch an electric taxi in Hong Kong next month. However, a lawmaker has raised concerns that the lack of quick-charging stations poses the biggest obstacle to the government's goal of having 3,000 such taxis by next year. The new six-seater e-taxi, named Darion Taxi, was...
summary.zh: 一家中国内地合资企业将于下月在香港推出一款电动出租车。然而，一位立法会议员警告称，快速充电站的缺乏是实现政府明年引入3000辆此类出租车目标的最大挑战。上汽通用五菱公司于周二发布了其“大郎出租车”，这是一款将在香港推出的新款六座电动出租车。

body.en: A mainland Chinese joint venture will introduce an electric taxi in Hong Kong next month, but a lawmaker has warned that a lack of quick-charging stations remains the biggest challenge to the government’s target of introducing 3,000 such cabs by next year. SAIC-GM-Wuling, a joint venture between SAIC Motor, General Motors China and Guangxi Automobile Group, on Tuesday unveiled its Darion Taxi, a new six-seater e-taxi to be launched in Hong Kong. DH Legend Motors, the joint venture’s sole Hong...
body.zh: 中国大陆的一家合资企业将于下个月在香港推出电动出租车，但一名立法者警告说，缺乏快速充电站仍然是政府明年推出 3,000 辆电动出租车的目标面临的最大挑战。上汽通用五菱是上汽集团、通用汽车中国和广西汽车集团的合资企业，周二推出了Darion Taxi，这是一款即将在香港推出的新型六座电动出租车。 DH Legend Motors 是该合资企业的唯一香港...

reflection.en: The introduction of new electric taxis in Hong Kong represents a significant business venture, a step towards greener transportation. Proverbs 16:3 reminds us to commit our endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans. May this new venture be guided by wisdom and integrity, contributing positively to the city's future.
reflection.zh: 在香港推出新款电动出租车，标志着一项重要的商业创举，也是迈向更绿色交通的一步。《箴言》16章3节提醒我们，要将所做的托付于雅伟，信靠祂必成就我们的计划。愿这项新事业能以智慧和诚信为指引，为这座城市的未来做出积极贡献。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Eight gymnasts figure highly in Asian Games hopes
title.zh: 八名体操运动员在亚运会寄予厚望

summary.en: Hong Kong, China will field five female and three male gymnasts at the upcoming Asian Games in Nagoya. One of the athletes, Li Ting-huen, will be making her debut in both the Asian Games and rhythmic gymnastics, marking the first time the SAR is represented in this discipline. The team will also compete in trampoline...
summary.zh: 中国香港将派出五名女选手和三名男选手参加在日本名古屋举行的亚运会。其中一名运动员李婷轩将首次参加亚运会，并且是首次参加艺术体操项目，这是香港特别行政区首次在该项目上获得代表权。代表队还将参加蹦床和竞技体操项目。这位十八岁的李婷轩表示，她对首次参加亚运会感到非常期待和兴奋，并希望发挥出最佳水平。

body.en: Hong Kong, China will field five female and three male gymnasts at the upcoming Asian Games in Nagoya. One of the athletes will be making her debut in more ways than one: it Li Ting-huen is appearing in the Asian Games for the first time and in rhythmic gymnastics – the first time that the SAR is represented in the discipline. Other disciplines in which the squad is competing include trampoline and artistic gymnastics. Eighteen-year-old Li will compete in the women’s individual all-around event. “Recent training has become more intense," she said. "I am very much looking forward to and excited about joining the Asian Games for the first time. I hope that I can perform at my absolute best during the Asian Games.” Li said that having participated in the National Games and Asian Championships has helped calm her nerves for Nagoya. “Mentally, I have managed to overcome a great deal of the nervousness and fear I used to feel on stage. I managed to turn that around and start enjoying the stage,” she said. Ng Ka-ki, who will compete in the men's vault event, said he recently returned from a two-month training stint in Beijing. “In Beijing, I trained with gymnasts from the national team," he said. "I also joined their team tests. The atmosphere and the exchanges… I think it’s a valuable experience for me to train and do tests with probably the best gymnasts in the world. "This is a very valuable chance and experience.” Ng said he had feared he would miss out on the Games after suffering a calf muscle tear this year but, now that it has healed, his main focus is to enjoy his time on the competition floor. Head coach Sergiy Agafontsev said the squad is ready to show their best in Nagoya. "To our athletes, you go to Japan with all support from Hong Kong society," he said. "Trust your preparation, stay composed... and fight for your best performance. Just do your best," he said. Agafontsev also expressed hope that the public would not be overly concerned with the results but instead appreciate the preparation and training the athletes put in. Gymnastics competitions at the Nagoya Asian Games will begin on Monday. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 中国香港将派出五名女子体操运动员和三名男子体操运动员参加即将在名古屋举行的亚运会。其中一位运动员将以多种方式首次亮相：李廷轩首次参加亚运会，并参加艺术体操比赛，这是特区首次代表特区参加该项目。该队参加的其他项目包括蹦床和艺术体操。十八岁的李娜将参加女子个人全能比赛。 “最近的训练变得更加激烈，”她说。 “第一次参加亚运会我非常期待和兴奋。我希望我能在亚运会期间发挥出最好的水平。”李说，参加全运会和亚锦赛让她在名古屋的紧张情绪得到了缓解。 “在精神上，我已经成功克服了以前在舞台上感受到的大量紧张和恐惧。我成功地扭转了局面，开始享受舞台，”她说。将参加男子跳马项目的吴家琪表示，他最近在北京结束了两个月的训练归来。 “在北京，我和国家队的体操运动员一起训练，”他说。 “我也参加了他们的团队测试。气氛和交流......我认为与可能是世界上最好的体操运动员一起训练和测试对我来说是一次宝贵的经历。“这是一次非常宝贵的机会和经历。吴说，今年小腿肌肉撕裂后，他曾担心自己会错过奥运会，但现在伤势已经痊愈，他的主要关注点是享受在比赛场上的时光。主教练谢尔盖·阿加丰采夫表示，球队已准备好在名古屋展示自己的最佳状态。他说：“对于我们的运动员来说，你们在香港社会的全力支持下前往日本。” “相信你的准备，保持镇静......并为你的最佳表现而奋斗。他说：“只要尽力就好。”阿加丰采夫还表示，希望公众不要过分关注比赛结果，而应该欣赏运动员所付出的准备和训练。名古屋亚运会体操比赛将于周一开始。编辑：Edmond Fong

reflection.en: The upcoming Asian Games present a significant opportunity for Hong Kong's eight gymnasts, including Li Ting-huen, who is making her debut in both the event and her discipline. Their dedication mirrors the Apostle Paul's exhortation to athletes to train with discipline, knowing that only one receives the prize. This pursuit of excellence, fueled by intense...
reflection.zh: 即将到来的亚运会为香港的八名体操运动员，包括首次参加该赛事和艺术体操项目的李婷轩，提供了一个重要的舞台。她们的奉献精神呼应了使徒保罗对运动员的劝勉，要以纪律训练，因为只有一人能获得奖赏。这种追求卓越的精神，源于刻苦训练和充满希望的期待，体现了在每一个努力中尽善尽美的承诺。

verse.textEn: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.
verse.textZh: 岂不知在场上赛跑的都跑，但得奖赏的只有一人？你们也当这样跑，好叫你们得着奖赏。

title.en: NGO concerned about South China Morning Post reporter Minnie Chan, 3 years after apparent disappearance
title.zh: 非政府组织关注《南华早报》记者陈敏儿，在其失踪近三年后

summary.en: Reporters Without Borders (RSF) has voiced concern over the apparent disappearance of South China Morning Post (SCMP) reporter Minnie Chan, who has not been heard from since October 2023. Chan, who reported on defense issues, was last known to be covering the Xiangshan Forum in Beijing. RSF sources suggest she may be...
summary.zh: 自由表达非政府组织“无国界记者”（RSF）对《南华早报》（SCMP）记者陈敏儿（Minnie Chan）近三年前的失踪表示担忧。陈敏儿报道国防议题，但自2023年10月在北京报道香山论坛以来便杳无音信。RSF的消息人士称，陈敏儿可能被中国当局以未公开的国家安全相关罪名拘留。

body.en: Free expression NGO Reporters Without Borders (RSF) has expressed concern over the apparent disappearance of South China Morning Post (SCMP) reporter Minnie Chan close to three years ago. SCMP reporter Minnie Chan. Photo: Facebook. Chan reported on defence issues, but was last heard from in October 2023 while she was covering the Xiangshan Forum, a three-day security conference, in Beijing. The French NGO said that there has been no news of the whereabouts of the award-winning reporter since: “Various RSF sources in China also believe Minnie Chan is being held by the Chinese regime under charges which they say have not been publicly disclosed but appear to be national-security-related, and that she is facing at least 10 years in prison. RSF could not verify this information or find clear evidence of her detention,” they said in a Tuesday press release. Reporters Without Borders’ Asia-Pacific Bureau Advocacy Officer Aleksandra Bielakowska⁩. Photo: RSF. Aleksandra Bielakowska, advocacy manager at RSF’s Asia-Pacific office, said that Chan’s “whereabouts must be made public, and the international community must do everything in its power to secure the release of this talented journalist, who does not belong in a Chinese prison.” When asked about Chan in 2023, China’s Foreign Ministry spokesperson Wang Wenbin said: “I’m not aware of that [situation].” SCMP silent RSF said it approached the SCMP “requesting information about Chan’s current employment status, confirmation of her detention and the nature of any charges, as well as information about what support is being provided to the journalist in the event she is detained. At the time of publication, the SCMP had not replied.” SCMP did not respond to HKFP’s enquiries on Tuesday. It threatened legal action over HKFP’s initial coverage of Chan’s apparent disappearance, without disputing the reporting. At the time, the paper said the safety of journalists was of utmost importance and that it had no further information to disclose. According to RSF, China is the “world’s largest prison for journalists,” with over 100 currently behind bars. Chinese Bloomberg journalist Haze Fan disappeared in 2020 in China but was released on bail in 2022. Cheng Lei, an Australian journalist , was held in China in 2020 and released in 2023. In 2015, Hong Kong bookseller Gui Minhai disappeared in Thailand before being imprisoned in China.
body.zh: 言论自由 非政府组织记者无国界组织 (RSF) 对近三年前南华早报 (SCMP) 记者 Minnie Chan 的明显失踪表示担忧。南华早报记者陈敏妮。照片：脸书。陈报道了国防问题，但最后一次听到她的消息是在 2023 年 10 月，当时她正在北京报道为期三天的安全会议香山论坛。这家法国非政府组织表示，此后就再也没有这位获奖记者下落的消息：“无国界记者组织在中国的各种消息来源也认为陈明妮被中国政权关押，他们称这些指控尚未公开披露，但似乎与国家安全有关，她将面临至少 10 年监禁。无国界记者组织无法核实这一信息，也无法找到她被拘留的明确证据，”他们在周二的新闻稿中表示。无国界记者组织亚太局宣传官员 Aleksandra Bielakowska。照片：无国界医生组织。无国界记者组织亚太办事处宣传经理亚历山德拉·别拉科斯卡 (Aleksandra Bielakowska) 表示，陈的下落“必须公开，国际社会必须竭尽全力确保释放这位不属于中国监狱的才华横溢的记者。” 2023年，当被问及陈的情况时，中国外交部发言人汪文斌表示：“我不了解此事。” 《南华早报》保持沉默的无国界记者表示，它已联系《南华早报》，“要求提供有关陈目前就业状况的信息，确认她被拘留的情况和任何指控的性质，以及如果她被拘留，将向该记者提供哪些支持的信息。截至发稿时，《南华早报》尚未回复。” 《南华早报》周二没有回应香港《金融时报》的询问。它威胁要对 HKFP 对陈明显失踪的最初报道采取法律行动，但没有对报道提出异议。该报当时表示，记者的安全至关重要，没有更多信息可透露。据无国界记者报道，中国是“世界上最大的记者监狱”，目前有 100 多名记者被关押。中国彭博社记者Haze Fan于2020年在中国失踪，但于2022年被保释。澳大利亚记者成雷于2020年在中国被关押，于2023年获释。2015年，香港书商桂民海在泰国失踪，然后在中国被监禁。

reflection.en: The disappearance of Minnie Chan, a reporter covering sensitive defense issues, raises profound questions about the safety of those who seek to inform the public. Her silence since October 2023 is a stark reminder of the risks faced by journalists in certain environments. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for...
reflection.zh: 报道敏感国防议题的记者陈敏儿的失踪，引发了关于那些试图告知公众者的安全问题的深刻疑问。自2023年10月以来她的音讯全无，是记者在某些环境中面临风险的严峻提醒。《箴言》31:8-9呼吁我们：“本应替那些不能说话的辩护，为所有不幸的人伸张正义。”

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Education University PhD student gets 160 hours of community service over doctored reference
title.zh: 教育大学博士生因伪造推荐信被判处160小时社区服务

summary.en: A mainland Chinese woman has been sentenced to 160 hours of community service after pleading guilty to obtaining services by deception for forging a reference letter to apply for a doctoral program at The Education University of Hong Kong. The court heard that she commissioned an agent to alter the letter after a...
summary.zh: 一名中国内地女子因伪造推荐信以申请香港教育大学博士课程而被判处160小时社区服务，她承认了通过欺骗手段获取服务罪。法庭获悉，在她先前申请被拒后，她委托中介修改了推荐信。

body.en: A mainland Chinese woman has been handed a 160-hour community service order after pleading guilty to forging a reference letter for her application to a doctoral programme at a Hong Kong university. The Education University of Hong Kong. Photo: Education University of Hong Kong. Li Zuer, who faced a charge of obtaining services by deception, appeared at the Fanling Magistrates’ Courts on Monday. The court heard earlier that she had commissioned an agent to rewrite a reference letter for a doctoral programme at the Education University of Hong Kong, after previously failing to gain admission, local media reported. According to the prosecution, she submitted a doctored letter – dated March 2024 – based on a reference that was written for her by Ho Wai-yip, a former associate professor at the Education University who taught her when she was studying for a master’s degree there. The letter stated that Li’s English proficiency could be improved. The edited version was rewritten to state that Li’s academic performance was exceptional. Fanling Magistrates’ Courts. Photo: Peter Lee/HKFP. Li was admitted to the university, studying international and comparative education. She has since lost her place at the school. Handing down the sentence, magistrate Kenneth Chan said the case was serious as Li could have robbed another applicant of their chance for enrolment, The Witness reported . But he said he took into account the defence’s evidence that Li had strong academic results and was devoted to teaching, and committed the offence because she was influenced by her agent. Li’s mother submitted a mitigation letter to the court stating that her daughter had always been an honest person and felt remorseful about her offence. Chan said that while imprisonment was a viable punishment for her case, he had decided to give her a chance and sentenced her to community service instead.
body.zh: 一名中国内地女子因伪造推荐信申请香港大学博士课程，被处以 160 小时社区服务令。香港教育大学。图片：香港教育大学。李祖儿周一在粉岭裁判法院出庭，被控以欺骗手段获取服务。据当地媒体报道，法庭早些时候获悉，在未能获得录取后，她委托代理人重写了香港教育大学博士课程的推荐信。检方称，她提交了一封篡改过的信件，日期为 2024 年 3 月，该信件基于教育大学前副教授何伟业为她撰写的推荐信，何伟业是她在教育大学攻读硕士学位时的老师。信中表示，李的英语水平还有待提高。编辑后的版本被重写，表明李的学习成绩非常出色。粉岭裁判法院。照片：Peter Lee/HKFP。李考入大学，主修国际与比较教育。从此她失去了在学校的位置。据《见证人》报道，地方法官陈启明在宣判判决时表示，案件很严重，因为李可能剥夺了另一名申请人的入学机会。但他表示，他考虑到了辩方提供的证据，即李拥有出色的学业成绩并致力于教学，并因受到经纪人的影响而犯下罪行。李母向法院提交了一份减刑信，称女儿一直是一个诚实的人，对自己的罪行感到悔恨。陈说，虽然监禁对她的案件来说是一种可行的惩罚，但他决定给她一个机会，并判处她社区服务。

reflection.en: The pursuit of education is a worthy goal, but the path taken matters. This student's attempt to bypass the system through deception led to a legal consequence, reminding us that integrity is foundational. Micah 6:8 calls us to 'act justly and to love mercy,' principles that should guide our ambitions and actions, especially in academic and professional...
reflection.zh: 追求教育是值得称赞的目标，但所走的道路同样重要。这位学生试图通过欺骗手段绕过制度，最终导致了法律后果，这提醒我们诚信是根本。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们“行公义，好怜悯”，这些原则应指导我们的抱负和行为，尤其是在学术和职业追求中。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers jailed for seven years in Hong Kong
title.zh: 香港国安法下，支联会前正副主席煽动颠覆罪成判囚七年

summary.en: Hong Kong activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan have been sentenced to seven years in prison after being found guilty of inciting subversion under the city's national security law for their roles in organizing an annual vigil commemorating the Tiananmen Square massacre.
summary.zh: 香港活动人士周庭栋和李卓人因在组织纪念天安门事件的年度集会中煽动颠覆国家政权，根据香港国安法被判处七年监禁。

body.en: Pro-democracy activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan were found guilty of ‘incitement to subversion’ in controversial national security case Two pro-democracy activists who were put on trial for organising an annual Tiananmen Square massacre vigil in Hong Kong have been sentenced to seven years in jail, in one of the city’s most significant national security cases. Chow Hang-tung, 41 and Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, were found guilty in August of incitement to subversion . The court found they had “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 民主活动人士周恒东和李卓人在有争议的国家安全案件中被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。两名因在香港组织一年一度的天安门广场大屠杀守夜活动而受审的民主活动人士被判处七年监禁，这是香港最重大的国家安全案件之一。 41 岁的周恒东和 69 岁的李卓人于 8 月被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。法院认为，他们“煽动他人以非法手段组织、策划、实施或者参与颠覆国家政权的行为”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The sentencing of Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan highlights a profound tension between civic duty and conscience. Their conviction for organizing a Tiananmen Square vigil raises questions about the limits of free expression and assembly when they are perceived to challenge state power. The principle of obeying God over human authorities, even when it...
reflection.zh: 周庭栋和李卓人的判刑凸显了公民责任与良知之间的深刻张力。他们因组织天安门事件悼念集会被定罪，引发了关于言论和集会自由界限的疑问，尤其是在这些自由被视为挑战国家权力之时。即使面临世俗的惩罚，也要优先顺服雅伟而非人间的命令，这一原则在这样的处境中引起了深刻共鸣。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Wall Street Journal publisher convicted in Hong Kong of deterring reporter from union role
title.zh: 《华尔街日报》出版商在香港被判犯有阻止记者担任工会职务的罪名

summary.en: Dow Jones, the publisher of The Wall Street Journal, has been convicted in a Hong Kong court of one count of deterring reporter Selina Cheng from taking up a role at the Hong Kong Journalist Association. The case raised concerns about press freedom in the city, as Cheng was dismissed weeks after her appointment as...
summary.zh: 《华尔街日报》的出版商道琼斯公司在香港一家法院被判犯有一项阻止记者郑丽莎担任香港记者协会职务的罪名。此案引发了对该市新闻自由的担忧，郑女士在2024年被任命为香港记协主席数周后被公司以重组为由解雇。

body.en: Dow Jones convicted of one count of deterring Selina Cheng from role at Hong Kong Journalist Association but cleared of second charge A Hong Kong court has convicted the publisher of the Wall Street Journal of deterring a reporter from taking up a trade union role, in a case that raised concerns about press freedom in the city. The newspaper dismissed Selina Cheng just weeks after she was appointed chair of the Hong Kong Journalist Association (HKJA) in 2024. She was told at the time her termination was officially due to restructuring. Continue reading...
body.zh: 道琼斯因一项阻止郑秀玲在香港记者协会任职的罪名被定罪，但第二项指控被洗清。香港一家法院判定《华尔街日报》出版商阻止一名记者担任工会职务的罪名成立，此案引起了人们对香港新闻自由的担忧。该报在 2024 年被任命为香港记者协会 (HKJA) 主席几周后解雇了郑嘉颖。当时她被告知，她的解雇正式是由于重组。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of Dow Jones in Hong Kong for deterring a reporter from union activity underscores a troubling trend where corporate actions can stifle worker advocacy. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly and loving mercy, even in the face of corporate restructuring or perceived inconvenience. May we pray for leaders...
reflection.zh: 道琼斯公司在香港被判阻止记者参与工会活动，这凸显了一个令人担忧的趋势：企业行为可能扼杀工人维权。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义在于秉行公义，喜爱怜悯，即使面对企业重组或所谓的“不便”。愿我们为媒体和商业界的领导者祈祷，愿他们坚守这些原则，确保追求利润不会掩盖员工的基本权利和尊严。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
