title.en: Scientists create 'super ice' that is ten times stronger and far harder to shatter
title.zh: 科学家创造出强度高十倍且极难破碎的“超级冰”

summary.en: Scientists have developed a new material called BioPykrete, a reinforced ice that is approximately 10 times stronger and can absorb 70 times more energy than ordinary ice before breaking. Unlike regular ice, it bends and breaks more gradually, offering potential as a building material.
summary.zh: 科学家们开发出一种名为BioPykrete的新型材料，这是一种增强型冰，其强度约为普通冰的10倍，在断裂前能吸收约70倍的能量。与普通冰不同，它会逐渐弯曲和断裂，有潜力作为建筑材料。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Ice is cheap, abundant and surprisingly strong. But it has one major weakness: Cracks can race through it, causing it to shatter without warning. Now, scientists have developed a new material that could overcome that problem. Called BioPykrete, the reinforced ice is about 10 times stronger than ordinary ice and can absorb roughly 70 times more energy before breaking.

Rather than shattering suddenly, it bends and breaks more gradually, a quality that could one day make it useful as a building material in some of the coldest places on Earth.

The research, published in Colloids and Surfaces B: Biointerfaces , was led by Prof. Ido Braslavsky of Hebrew University's Robert H. Smith Faculty of Agriculture, Food and Environment.

The idea of reinforcing ice is not new. During World War II, researchers experimented with Pykrete, a mixture of ice and wood pulp that was stronger and slower to melt than ordinary ice.

The team took that idea down to the molecular level. They mixed ice with cellulose nanocrystals, extremely small, stiff particles made from cellulose, the natural material that gives plants their structure. As the mixture froze, the particles formed a three-dimensional network around microscopic sections of ice.

The scientists then designed a protein that could attach to both materials. One part of the protein binds to ice, while the other binds to cellulose. Acting like a molecular glue, the protein helps hold the entire structure together.

"We wanted to go beyond simply mixing fibers into ice and instead control how the different materials connect at the molecular level," Braslavsky said. "The result changes not only how strong the ice is, but also how it breaks. Instead of suddenly shattering, it can absorb much more energy and deform gradually."

In ordinary ice, even a tiny crack can spread quickly and cause the entire structure to fail. In BioPykrete, the cellulose network and protein connections appear to slow down those cracks and prevent them from moving freely.

Once a crack begins to propagate through the ice, it encounters the cellulose network, which acts as an obstacle to further propagation. The molecular glue, a chimeric protein with one domain that binds ice and another that binds cellulose, anchors the cellulose network to the ice.

This anchoring increases the energy required to deform or tear the network, making it a more effective barrier to crack propagation. As a result, crack growth is arrested or redirected, helping to keep cracks small and confined.

Laboratory tests found that BioPykrete was about 10 times stronger under compression than...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 冰价格便宜、储量丰富，而且强度惊人。但它有一个主要弱点：裂缝可能会贯穿它，导致它在没有警告的情况下破碎。现在，科学家们开发出了一种可以克服这个问题的新材料。这种强化冰被称为 BioPykrete，其强度大约是普通冰的 10 倍，在破裂前可以吸收大约 70 倍的能量。 它不会突然破碎，而是逐渐弯曲和断裂，这种特性有一天可能会使其成为地球上一些最寒冷地区的建筑材料。 该研究由希伯来大学罗伯特·H·史密斯农业、食品和环境学院的 Ido Braslavsky 教授领导，发表在《Colloids and Surfaces B: Biointerfaces》杂志上。 加固冰的想法并不新鲜。第二次世界大战期间，研究人员对 Pykrete 进行了实验，这是一种冰和木浆的混合物，比普通冰更坚固且融化速度更慢。 该团队将这个想法降低到分子水平。他们将冰与纤维素纳米晶体混合，纤维素纳米晶体是由纤维素制成的极小而坚硬的颗粒，纤维素是赋予植物结构的天然材料。当混合物冻结时，颗粒在冰的微观部分周围形成三维网络。 然后，科学家们设计了一种可以附着在这两种材料上的蛋白质。蛋白质的一部分与冰结合，而另一部分与纤维素结合。这种蛋白质就像分子胶一样，有助于将整个结构粘合在一起。 布拉斯拉夫斯基说：“我们希望不仅仅是将纤维混合到冰中，而是控制不同材料如何在分子水平上连接。” “结果不仅改变了冰的强度，还改变了它的破裂方式。它不会突然破碎，而是可以吸收更多的能量并逐渐变形。” 在普通的冰中，即使是微小的裂缝也会迅速蔓延并导致整个结构失效。在 BioPykrete 中，纤维素网络和蛋白质连接似乎可以减缓这些裂缝并防止它们自由移动。 一旦裂缝开始在冰中传播，它就会遇到纤维素网络，纤维素网络会成为进一步传播的障碍。分子胶是一种嵌合蛋白，其一个结构域与冰结合，另一个结构域与纤维素结合，将纤维素网络锚定在冰上。 这种锚定增加了网络变形或撕裂所需的能量，使其成为裂纹扩展的更有效屏障。结果，裂纹扩展被阻止或改变方向，有助于保持裂纹较小且受到限制。 实验室测试发现 BioPykrete 在压缩下的强度比...强约 10 倍

reflection.en: Human ingenuity, when applied to understanding and utilizing the natural world, can yield remarkable results. The creation of BioPykrete, a stronger form of ice, demonstrates how careful observation and experimentation with the elements around us can lead to practical innovations. This pursuit of knowledge, rooted in the created order, reflects a...
reflection.zh: 人类的创造力在理解和利用自然界时，能带来非凡的成果。BioPykrete的创造——一种更坚固的冰——展示了通过仔细观察和实验周围的元素，如何能带来实用的创新。这种植根于受造秩序的求知探索，反映了人类深植的发现能力。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Advanced X-ray crystallography determines structure of macromolecule at unprecedented resolution
title.zh: 先进X射线晶体学以前所未有的分辨率确定了大分子的结构

summary.en: Proteins are high-performance molecular machines that carry out nearly every biochemical function inside living cells. To understand how they achieve this, scientists often examine their detailed atomic structure, which holds important clues to their activity. The more precision they achieve, the deeper the insight...
summary.zh: 蛋白质是执行活细胞内几乎所有生化功能的高性能分子机器。为了理解它们如何实现这一点，科学家们经常检查它们的详细原子结构，其中包含对其活性的重要线索。他们获得的精度越高，对蛋白质结构乃至最终功能的化学原理的理解就越深入。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Proteins are high-performance molecular machines that carry out nearly every biochemical function inside living cells. To understand how they achieve this, scientists often examine their detailed atomic structure, which holds important clues to their activity. The more precision they achieve, the deeper the insight they may gain into the chemical principles that underlie protein structure and, ultimately, function.

Marking a major advancement in X-ray crystallography, scientists led by Ashwin Chari from the Max Planck Institute for Multidisciplinary Sciences (Göttingen, Germany), Gleb Bourenkov from EMBL Hamburg (Hamburg, Germany), Clemens Schulze-Briese from DECTRIS (Baden, Switzerland), Paulina Maria Dominiak from the University of Warsaw (Poland) and Gérard Bricogne from Global Phasing Ltd. (Cambridge, UK) have determined the structure of the archaeal rubredoxin protein at a resolution of 0.43 Å.

"This, to the best of our knowledge, represents the highest-resolution protein structure yet determined," Chari explained. "This has been enabled by a series of technical innovations and streamlined procedures. We have combined cutting-edge X-ray crystallography with advanced quantum-chemical models, bridging the gap between structural biology and quantum chemistry." The results have now been published in Acta Crystallographica Section D: Structural Biology .

Previous experiments by Chari, Bricogne and Bourenkov, also published in Acta Crystallographica Section D: Structural Biology , laid the groundwork for this resolution record. There, the scientists investigated how X-rays alter protein structure and how radiation damage interferes with atomic model refinement and interpretation. During these experiments, the researchers developed a "resolution-in-dose" approach, which relied on low-dose data collection protocols on large protein crystals bathed in a "top-hat" beam, ultimately allowing the scientists to reach sub-Ångström resolutions.

The new study made use of one of the world's brightest X-ray sources: PETRA III at DESY in Hamburg (Germany). To collect the high-quality data that led to the resolution record, the scientists used the beamline P14 provided by EMBL Hamburg. This produces a tailored X-ray beam with a uniform radiation intensity, known as a "top-hat" beam. Its advantage: Its size and shape can be adjusted before the start of every data collection to match the dimensions of each protein crystal. This allows precise control over the X-ray dose delivered to the sample—just as the "resolution-in-dose" approach suggests.

The data collection and processing were...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 蛋白质是高性能分子机器，几乎执行活细胞内的所有生化功能。为了了解它们是如何实现这一目标的，科学家经常检查它们详细的原子结构，这为它们的活动提供了重要线索。他们获得的精度越高，他们对蛋白质结构和最终功能的化学原理的了解就越深入。 由马克斯·普朗克多学科科学研究所（德国哥廷根）的 Ashwin Chari、EMBL 汉堡（德国汉堡）的 Gleb Bourenkov、DECTRIS（瑞士巴登）的 Clemens Schulze-Briese、华沙大学（波兰）的 Paulina Maria Dominiak 和 Global Phasing Ltd.（剑桥）的 Gérard Bricogne 领导的科学家们标志着 X 射线晶体学领域取得了重大进展。 UK）以 0.43 Å 的分辨率确定了古菌红氧还蛋白的结构。 “据我们所知，这代表了迄今为止已确定的最高分辨率的蛋白质结构，”查里解释道。 “这是通过一系列技术创新和简化程序实现的。我们将尖端的 X 射线晶体学与先进的量子化学模型相结合，弥合了结构生物学和量子化学之间的差距。”该结果现已发表在《晶体学报 D 部分：结构生物学》上。 Chari、Bricogne 和 Bourenkov 之前的实验也发表在《晶体学报 D 部分：结构生物学》上，为这一分辨率记录奠定了基础。在那里，科学家们研究了 X 射线如何改变蛋白质结构以及辐射损伤如何干扰原子模型的细化和解释。在这些实验中，研究人员开发了一种“剂量分辨率”方法，该方法依赖于沐浴在“礼帽”光束中的大蛋白质晶体的低剂量数据收集协议，最终使科学家能够达到亚埃分辨率。 这项新研究利用了世界上最亮的 X 射线源之一：德国汉堡 DESY 的 PETRA III。为了收集导致分辨率记录的高质量数据，科学家们使用了 EMBL 汉堡提供的光束线 P14。这会产生具有均匀辐射强度的定制 X 射线束，称为“礼帽”光束。它的优点：它的大小和形状可以在每次数据收集开始之前调整，以匹配每个蛋白质晶体的尺寸。这样可以精确控制传递到样品的 X 射线剂量，正如“剂量分辨率”方法所建议的那样。 数据收集和处理是...

reflection.en: The pursuit of understanding the intricate machinery of life, like the structure of proteins, reflects a deep human drive to explore the wonders of creation. Through meticulous observation and advanced techniques, scientists uncover the elegant design woven into the fabric of existence, revealing the profound wisdom inherent in Yahweh's handiwork. This...
reflection.zh: 对生命复杂机制（如蛋白质结构）的理解的追求，反映了人类探索造物奇迹的深层驱动力。通过细致的观察和先进的技术，科学家们揭示了编织在存在之中的优雅设计，揭示了雅伟的工巧中固有的深刻智慧。 这项努力提醒我们，创造本身就是神圣智慧的证明。当我们深入分子世界时，我们被邀请惊叹于其中蕴含的复杂性和目的，从而培养对创造者的敬畏和崇敬之情。

title.en: Ancient DNA traces medieval migration from Sweden to Finland
title.zh: 古代DNA追踪从中世纪瑞典到芬兰的迁徙

summary.en: A new study led by the University of Turku provides new insights into the population history of Finland during the Late Iron Age and the Middle Ages. Researchers analyzed the genomes of people who lived in southwestern Finland and Häme between the 11th and 13th centuries to investigate population changes and...
summary.zh: 一项由图尔库大学牵头的新研究，为了解芬兰铁器时代晚期和中世纪的人口历史提供了新的见解。研究人员分析了11至13世纪居住在芬兰西南部和哈梅地区的人们的基因组，以研究中世纪人口的变化以及他们与波罗的海其他地区之间的联系。

body.en: A new study led by the University of Turku provides new insights into the population history of Finland during the Late Iron Age and the Middle Ages. The researchers analyzed the genomes of people who lived in southwestern Finland and Häme between the 11th and 13th centuries to investigate how the population changed over the course of the Middle Ages and how people were connected to other regions around the Baltic Sea.
body.zh: 图尔库大学领导的一项新研究为铁器时代晚期和中世纪芬兰的人口历史提供了新的见解。研究人员分析了 11 世纪至 13 世纪期间居住在芬兰西南部和哈姆的人们的基因组，以调查人口在中世纪过程中的变化以及人们与波罗的海周围其他地区的联系。

reflection.en: This study uses ancient DNA to trace the movements and connections of people across centuries. It’s a reminder that even in the deep past, human lives were interwoven with migration and interaction. As we uncover these ancient patterns, we see the intricate tapestry of humanity, a testament to the Creator’s ongoing work in shaping populations and lands.
reflection.zh: 这项研究利用古代DNA追溯了数个世纪以来人们的迁徙和联系。它提醒我们，即使在遥远的过去，人类的生活也交织着迁徙和互动。当我们揭示这些古老的模式时，我们看到了人类错综复杂的织锦，这是造物主在塑造人口和土地方面持续工作的见证。

title.en: Europe's e‑waste is a valuable resource—let's not throw it away
title.zh: 欧洲的电子垃圾是一笔宝贵的资源——不要浪费它

summary.en: Discarding something urgently needed, expensive, and difficult to source sounds absurd. Yet, of the 60 metals in old electronics like phones, screens, and washing machines, only a few are recycled, including precious metals like gold and silver, alongside aluminum and copper. The rest are effectively single-use, lost...
summary.zh: 丢弃一些急需、昂贵且难以获取的东西听起来很荒谬。然而，在手机、屏幕和洗衣机等旧电子设备所含的60种金属中，只有少数被回收，其中包括金银等贵金属，以及铝和铜。其余的基本上是一次性使用，在收集过程中或通过焚烧而丢失。

body.en: Throwing something away that is urgently needed, expensive and difficult to source sounds crazy. Yet of the 60 metals contained in old electronic devices such as phones, screens and washing machines, only a few are recycled. That includes precious metals such as gold and silver and other metals such as aluminum and copper. The rest are effectively single-use metals, used once and then lost during collection or through incineration.
body.zh: 扔掉那些急需的、昂贵的和难以获取的东西听起来很疯狂。然而，在电话、屏幕和洗衣机等旧电子设备中含有的 60 种金属中，只有少数被回收利用。其中包括金、银等贵金属以及铝和铜等其他金属。其余的实际上是一次性金属，使用一次，然后在收集或焚烧过程中丢失。

reflection.en: The news points to a profound wastefulness in our consumption patterns. We discard devices containing valuable resources, effectively treating them as disposable. The ancient wisdom of Job reminds us to look to creation and its elements, for they can teach us about the resources Yahweh has provided and how to steward them wisely. May we learn to see the...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻指出了我们消费模式中深刻的浪费现象。我们丢弃含有宝贵资源的设备，实际上将它们视为一次性用品。古老的约伯智慧提醒我们，要观察创造物及其元素，因为它们可以教导我们关于雅伟所提供的资源以及如何明智地管理它们。愿我们学会看到那些我们可能随意丢弃之物中的潜力和价值。

title.en: Smelling chocolate helped men complete more reps without feeling more tired
title.zh: 闻巧克力让男性完成更多次腿部训练，且不感觉更累

summary.en: A study found that smelling chocolate, particularly dark chocolate, before and during resistance exercise helped men complete more leg extension repetitions without increasing their perceived exertion. Researchers suggest familiar food aromas might influence appetite and motivation.
summary.zh: 一项研究发现，在阻力训练前和训练期间闻到巧克力的气味，特别是黑巧克力，可以帮助男性完成更多的腿部伸展重复次数，而不会增加他们的感觉劳累程度。研究人员推测，熟悉的食物香气可能会影响食欲和动机。

body.en:
A tough leg day may have an unexpectedly simple boost: the smell of chocolate. According to a new study published in Frontiers in Physiology , exposure to chocolate aromas before and during resistance exercise helped participants complete more repetitions without making the workout feel more difficult.

"Exposing moderately trained men to chocolate odors right before and between sets of resistance exercise significantly increased their overall training volume without increasing their perceived exertion," said senior author Dr. Mohamed Nashrudin bin Naharudin, an assistant professor at the Faculty of Sports and Exercise Science at the University of Malaya. "Seeing a substantial increase in repetitions without the athletes feeling like they were exerting themselves any harder is a fascinating psychobiological outcome."

The study included 23 healthy men in their early to mid-20s who were moderately trained. Researchers separated them into three groups and exposed each group to one of three samples: liquified dark chocolate containing 90% cocoa, liquified milk chocolate containing 60% cocoa, or water as a control.

"We know olfaction is powerfully wired into the brain's appetite and emotion networks, but surprisingly, no study has systematically looked at the three-way interaction between smell, appetite, and actual resistance exercise capacity," said Nashrudin Naharudin.

Before exercising, the participants had gone without food for at least 10 hours. They then performed leg extensions, an exercise in which a person sits and straightens the lower legs against resistance to lift a weight.

Researchers measured leg extension performance both before and during the training session. Before exercising, participants also rated their hunger, fullness, desire to eat, and intention to eat in the near future. While completing their sets, researchers measured hunger and desire to eat after each 30-second exposure to one of the scent samples.

Compared with both the water control and milk chocolate conditions, smelling dark chocolate was consistently associated with lower hunger, less desire and intention to eat, and greater feelings of fullness before exercise. The dark chocolate aroma therefore appeared to reduce appetite mainly by decreasing hunger and increasing perceived fullness.

Milk chocolate had a different effect. Participants rated its smell as more pleasant than either dark chocolate or water, but the aroma did not significantly change their hunger or appetite.

The effects were not limited to appetite. Chocolate aromas also appeared to influence how much exercise the participants could complete.

"Sniffing a 90% dark chocolate odor added about 18 more repetitions to participants' leg extensions, while a 60% milk chocolate odor added about nine...
body.zh: 艰难的腿部日可能会有一个意想不到的简单的提升：巧克力的味道。根据发表在《生理学前沿》上的一项新研究，在抗阻运动之前和过程中接触巧克力香气可以帮助参与者完成更多的重复次数，而不会让锻炼感觉更加困难。 马来亚大学运动与运动科学学院助理教授、资深作者穆罕默德·纳什鲁丁·本·纳哈鲁丁博士说：“在进行抗阻训练之前和之间，让接受过中等训练的男性接触巧克力气味，可以显着增加他们的整体训练量，而不会增加他们的体力感知。” “看到重复次数大幅增加，而运动员却没有感觉自己更加努力，这是一个令人着迷的心理生物学结果。” 该研究纳入了 23 名 20 岁出头至中期的健康男性，他们接受过中等训练。研究人员将他们分成三组，让每组接触三种样品之一：含有 90% 可可的液态黑巧克力、含有 60% 可可的液态牛奶巧克力，或作为对照的水。 纳什鲁丁·纳哈鲁丁说：“我们知道嗅觉与大脑的食欲和情绪网络密切相关，但令人惊讶的是，没有研究系统地研究嗅觉、食欲和实际抵抗运动能力之间的三向相互作用。” 运动前，参与者至少有 10 个小时没有进食。然后，他们进行了腿部伸展运动，在这项运动中，一个人坐着并伸直小腿以对抗阻力以举起重物。 研究人员在训练前和训练期间测量了腿部伸展表现。在运动前，参与者还对自己的饥饿感、饱腹感、进食欲望以及近期进食意愿进行了评分。在完成一组实验时，研究人员测量了每接触一种气味样本 30 秒后的饥饿感和进食欲望。 与控制水和牛奶巧克力条件相比，闻黑巧克力的味道始终与较低的饥饿感、较少的进食欲望和意图以及运动前的饱腹感有关。因此，黑巧克力香气似乎主要通过减少饥饿感和增加饱腹感来降低食欲。 牛奶巧克力有不同的效果。参与者认为它的气味比黑巧克力或水更令人愉悦，但这种香气并没有显着改变他们的饥饿或食欲。 影响不仅限于食欲。巧克力香气似乎也会影响参与者完成的运动量。 “闻 90% 的黑巧克力气味，参与者的腿部伸展次数增加了约 18 次，而 60% 的牛奶巧克力气味则增加了约 9 次......

reflection.en: The pursuit of physical fitness often involves pushing our limits. This study suggests that even in strenuous activity, our senses can play a role in our performance and perception of effort. Whether in the gym or in our daily tasks, Colossians 3:23 reminds us to approach all our endeavors with diligence, as if working for a higher purpose.
reflection.zh: 追求体能健康常常需要我们挑战极限。这项研究表明，即使在剧烈运动中，我们的感官也能影响我们的表现和对劳累的感知。无论是在健身房还是在日常的劳作中，歌罗西书3:23提醒我们，要以勤勉的态度对待我们所有的努力，仿佛是为主而做。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: This Australian cave hid 25,000 years of ritual secrets
title.zh: 这座澳大利亚洞穴隐藏了 25,000 年的仪式秘密

summary.en: Microscopic plant remains are revealing how GunaiKurnai ancestors used Cloggs Cave for ritual practices over thousands of years. People deliberately gathered whole grasses, carried them into the dark cave, and burned them in thin layers, leaving behind traces that may span 25,000 years. A standing stone erected around...
summary.zh: 微观植物遗骸揭示了 GunaiKurnai 祖先数千年来如何使用 Cloggs 洞穴进行仪式活动。人们故意收集整株草，将其带入黑暗的洞穴，并以薄层燃烧，留下了可能跨越 25,000 年的痕迹。大约 2,000 年前竖立的石碑和其他仪式物品加强了该洞穴是一个长期存在的精神场所的证据。

body.en: Microscopic plant remains are revealing how GunaiKurnai ancestors used Cloggs Cave for ritual practices over thousands of years. People deliberately gathered whole grasses, carried them into the dark cave, and burned them in thin layers, leaving behind traces that may span 25,000 years. A standing stone erected around 2,000 years ago and other ritual objects strengthen the evidence that the cave was a long-lived spiritual site.
body.zh: 微观植物遗骸揭示了古奈库尔奈 (GunaiKurnai) 祖先数千年来如何利用克洛格斯洞穴 (Cloggs Cave) 进行仪式活动。人们故意把整株草收集起来，带进黑暗的洞穴，薄薄地烧掉，留下的痕迹可能跨越25000年。大约 2000 年前竖立的立石和其他仪式物品进一步证明该洞穴是一个长期存在的精神场所。

reflection.en: For millennia, the GunaiKurnai people found spiritual meaning and connection within Cloggs Cave, using the natural world—grasses gathered and burned—as part of their rituals. This ancient practice reminds us that wisdom and sacredness can be discovered through careful observation and interaction with creation itself. The enduring traces left behind speak to...
reflection.zh: 数千年来，GunaiKurnai 人在 Cloggs 洞穴中找到了精神意义和联系，将自然界——收集和燃烧的草——作为他们仪式的一部分。这种古老的做法提醒我们，通过仔细观察和与受造物本身的互动，可以发现智慧和神圣。留下的持久痕迹诉说着对地方和实践的深切、长久的敬畏。

title.en: Scientists discover a major brain shift between ages 50 and 75
title.zh: 科学家发现50至75岁之间大脑发生重大转变

summary.en: Scientists have uncovered sweeping changes in how the human brain controls and organizes its genome beginning in midlife, offering new clues to why aging sharply increases the risk of Alzheimer’s and other neurodegenerative diseases. One of the biggest shifts occurred between about ages 50 and 75, when many of the...
summary.zh: 科学家们发现，从中老年开始，人脑控制和组织其基因组的方式发生了广泛变化，这为衰老如何急剧增加阿尔茨海默病和其他神经退行性疾病的风险提供了新线索。其中最大的变化发生在50至75岁之间，此时大脑的许多原始免疫细胞减少，并被更具炎症特征的细胞取代。研究人员还发现，有助于维持血脑屏障的细胞功能减弱，并且基因组的三维组织也普遍恶...

body.en: Scientists have uncovered sweeping changes in how the human brain controls and organizes its genome beginning in midlife, offering new clues to why aging sharply increases the risk of Alzheimer’s and other neurodegenerative diseases. One of the biggest shifts occurred between about ages 50 and 75, when many of the brain’s original immune cells declined and were replaced by cells with more inflammatory characteristics. Researchers also found weakening of cells that help maintain the blood-brain barrier, along with widespread deterioration in the genome’s three-dimensional organization.
body.zh: 科学家们发现，人类大脑从中年开始控制和组织基因组的方式发生了巨大变化，为解释为什么衰老会急剧增加阿尔茨海默病和其他神经退行性疾病的风险提供了新的线索。最大的转变之一发生在大约 50 岁到 75 岁之间，此时大脑的许多原始免疫细胞下降，并被具有更多炎症特征的细胞所取代。研究人员还发现，有助于维持血脑屏障的细胞减弱，基因组三维组织普遍恶化。

reflection.en: The human brain, a marvel of creation, continues to reveal its intricate workings as we age. This research, spanning decades of life, shows how even our genetic control centers shift and change. As we observe these biological processes, we can reflect on the profound wisdom embedded within the natural world, a testament to its Creator.
reflection.zh: 人脑作为造物的奇迹，随着年龄的增长，其错综复杂的功能不断被揭示。这项跨越数十年生命的研究表明，即使是我们基因控制中心也在发生变化。当我们观察这些生物过程时，可以反思自然界中蕴含的深刻智慧，这是其创造者的明证。

title.en: What weapon could the US have put into space?
title.zh: 美国可能在太空中部署了什么武器？

summary.en: The United States has announced the deployment of a weapon in Earth's orbit, sparking questions about the nature of space-based weaponry and its role in the strategic competition among major powers for dominance in this domain. The US Secretary of the Air Force stated the weapon is for safeguarding American forces but...
summary.zh: 美国宣布已在地球轨道上部署了一件武器，这引发了关于太空武器性质及其在主要大国争夺太空主导权中的作用的疑问。美国空军部长表示，该武器旨在保护美军，但未提供有关其能力或部署时间的具体细节。

body.en:
The announcement by the United States that it has deployed a space weapon in Earth's orbit has raised questions about what weaponry is actually in space, and what role it could play in efforts by great powers to dominate that arena.

Washington has given away little in its announcement. Secretary of the Air Force Troy Meink said the "on orbit" weapon was necessary to safeguard US forces against hostile enemy action, but gave no details about the weapon's capabilities or when it was put into orbit.

So what could this weapon be, and what is wider picture like for military developments in space? Who else could have similar weaponry?

Advanced militaries already deploy satellites in space for range of purposes, from supplying secure communications to reconnaissance, and providing precise location information for targeted strikes and detecting missile launches.

As warfare become more technologically advanced, analysts expect the use of military hardware in space to increase.

Dr Bleddyn Bowen, an associate fellow in military sciences at the Royal United Services Institute and associate professor in astropolitics at Durham University, said he was only able to hazard a guess about the weapon announced by the US.

"I would expect there to be some kind of electronic warfare or radio-jamming platform, possibly, this would be a non-destructive kind of anti-satellite weapon," he told BBC Radio 4's Today programme.

Such weaponry already exists on Earth and can disrupt satellite communications, he said. "If you take out the radio links then your satellite is very useless."

Bowen also would not rule out some sort of more disruptive and riskier weaponry, which could create a lot of debris and destruction.

"Less likely would be a kinetic kill vehicle of some sort, so a vehicle that would release a projectile of some sort that could ram into a satellite and destroy it," he said.

"Possibly some sort of close inspection and grappling satellite would be another possibility as well."

But while the weapon placed in orbit appears to be a first, the US - and indeed its Russian and Chinese rivals - have had weapons that can be pointed and shot into space for some time.

In fact in the last 10 years, Russia and China have been doing a lot more manoeuvres in space, known as rendezvous and proximity operations (RPOs) - "buzzing" Western satellites.

"Theoretically, these RPO sats can become hunter-killer satellites by physically colliding with them or by nudging them out of orbit," Dr Rod Thornton, reader in Russian Defence and Security Studies at King's College, London, told the BBC.

Bowen adds that the Chinese have demonstrated "space tug capability", saying: "A vehicle can go up to a satellite, can grapple it and move it into a different orbit."

body.zh: 美国宣布在地球轨道上部署太空武器，引发了人们的疑问：太空中到底有哪些武器，以及它在大国主导太空领域的努力中可以发挥什么作用。 华盛顿在声明中没有透露太多信息。美国空军部长特洛伊·梅克表示，“在轨”武器对于保护美军免受敌方行动是必要的，但没有透露该武器的能力或何时进入轨道的详细信息。 那么这种武器会是什么？太空军事发展的更广阔前景是怎样的？还有谁能拥有类似的武器？ 先进军队已经在太空中部署卫星用于多种用途，从提供安全通信到侦察，以及为有针对性的打击和探测导弹发射提供精确的位置信息。 随着战争技术变得更加先进，分析人士预计太空军事硬件的使用将会增加。 英国皇家联合军种研究所军事科学研究所副研究员、杜伦大学天体政治学副教授布莱丁·鲍文博士表示，他只能对美国宣布的这种武器进行大胆猜测。 “我预计会有某种电子战或无线电干扰平台，这可能是一种非破坏性的反卫星武器，”他告诉英国广播公司第四台“今日”节目。 他说，这种武器已经存在于地球上，并且可以扰乱卫星通信。 “如果你去掉无线电链路，那么你的卫星就毫无用处了。” 鲍文也不排除某种更具破坏性和风险性的武器，这可能会造成大量碎片和破坏。 他说：“不太可能是某种动能杀伤飞行器，因此可以释放某种射弹，撞击卫星并摧毁它。” “也许某种近距离检查和擒抱卫星也是另一种可能性。” 不过，虽然这种进入轨道的武器似乎是首创，但美国——实际上还有俄罗斯和中国的竞争对手——拥有可以瞄准并射入太空的武器已有一段时间了。 事实上，在过去十年中，俄罗斯和中国在太空进行了更多的演习，称为交会和邻近操作（RPO）——“嗡嗡”西方卫星。 伦敦国王学院俄罗斯国防与安全研究系的读者罗德·桑顿博士告诉英国广播公司：“理论上，这些 RPO 卫星可以通过与它们发生物理碰撞或将它们推出轨道而成为猎杀卫星。” 鲍文补充说，中国人已经展示了“太空拖拽能力”，他说：“飞行器可以到达卫星，可以抓住它并将其移入不同的轨道。” 他说，这可以...

As nations develop advanced capabilities for this new frontier, the prophetic vision of Isaiah 2:4, where weapons are transformed into tools for agriculture, offers a stark contrast and a hopeful alternative to the current trajectory of an arms...

title.en: UV light reveals possible camouflage on a 125-million-year-old crocodile
title.zh: 紫外光揭示1.25亿年前鳄鱼可能存在的伪装

summary.en: A remarkably preserved fossil of a crocodile relative from 125 million years ago has revealed skin, sensory organs, and respiratory structures. Using ultraviolet light, researchers discovered alternating bands on its tail, suggesting a potential camouflage pattern, offering new insights into the creature's life.
summary.zh: 一块保存完好的1.25亿年前鳄鱼近亲化石，揭示了其皮肤、感觉器官和呼吸结构。研究人员利用紫外光发现了其尾部交替的条带，表明可能存在伪装图案，为科学家们提供了关于这种生物生活的新见解。

body.en:
A remarkably preserved fossil from northeastern Spain is giving scientists a rare look at the skin, soft tissues, and possible coloration of an ancient crocodile relative that lived about 125 million years ago.

The new study, published in the Zoological Journal of the Linnean Society , provides the first detailed description of soft tissues preserved in Montsecosuchus depereti , a Lower Cretaceous crocodylomorph discovered at the Pedrera de Meià site in the province of Lleida (Catalonia, Spain). By examining the fossil under ultraviolet light, researchers uncovered new evidence about its skin, sensory structures, respiratory anatomy, and possible color pattern. The work was led by the Institut Català de Paleontologia Miquel Crusafont.

Approximately 125 million years ago, a small crocodile died in a karstic lake close to the coast of what is now the Catalan Pre-Pyrenees. Its body settled into fine lake sediments, where unusually favorable conditions helped preserve it in exceptional detail. Over time, those sediments became the lithographic limestones of the Pedrera de Meià, now part of the UNESCO Orígens Global Geopark.

The fossil, cataloged as MGB-512, is about 50 centimeters long and is housed at the Museum of Natural Sciences of Barcelona. It was discovered more than a century ago and received some scientific attention in the 90s, but researchers have now extracted information that had remained hidden since its discovery, including the shape and distribution of its preserved soft tissues.

The breakthrough came while paleontologists Oscar Castillo and Jesús Serrano were building a database of fossils from the lithographic limestones of Montsec held in Catalan and European museums. When they examined the holotype of Montsecosuchus depereti under ultraviolet light, they noticed structures that appeared to be remnants of soft tissue.

Ultraviolet light can cause fossilized tissues and the surrounding rock to respond differently, making otherwise invisible structures stand out.

"UV light allows us to see details that would otherwise remain completely hidden in the rock," explains Oscar Castillo-Visa, first author of the work.

Using this technique, the team documented several kinds of soft tissue, including epidermal scales. Although Montsecosuchus depereti has been known to science since the early 20th century, the new analysis provides the first detailed picture of what its skin looked like.

The scales varied considerably in shape and size across different parts of the body. The researchers also found that the animal lacked the high caudal fin seen in modern crocodiles.

The fossil may also preserve evidence of sensory organs in the skin. The possible structures appear within some scales, particularly around...
body.zh: 西班牙东北部的一块保存完好的化石让科学家们得以罕见地观察生活在大约 1.25 亿年前的远古鳄鱼亲戚的皮肤、软组织和可能的颜色。 这项发表在《林奈学会动物学杂志》上的新研究首次详细描述了 Montsecosuchus depereti 中保存的软组织，Montsecosuchus depereti 是在莱里达省（西班牙加泰罗尼亚）的 Pedrera de Meià 遗址发现的一种下白垩纪鳄鱼型。通过在紫外线下检查化石，研究人员发现了有关其皮肤、感觉结构、呼吸解剖结构和可能的颜色模式的新证据。这项工作由加泰罗尼亚古生物学研究所 Miquel Crusafont 领导。 大约 1.25 亿年前，一只小鳄鱼死在靠近现在加泰罗尼亚前比利牛斯山脉海岸的喀斯特湖中。它的身体沉入了细小的湖泊沉积物中，异常有利的条件帮助它保存了异常的细节。随着时间的推移，这些沉积物变成了 Pedrera de Meià 的平版石灰岩，现在是联合国教科文组织奥利根世界地质公园的一部分。 这块化石编号为 MGB-512，长约 50 厘米，现藏于巴塞罗那自然科学博物馆。它在一个多世纪前被发现，并在 90 年代受到了一些科学关注，但研究人员现在提取了自发现以来一直隐藏的信息，包括其保存的软组织的形状和分布。 这一突破是在古生物学家奥斯卡·卡斯蒂略（Oscar Castillo）和赫苏斯·塞拉诺（Jesús Serrano）建立加泰罗尼亚和欧洲博物馆收藏的蒙特塞克石版石灰岩化石数据库时实现的。当他们在紫外线下检查 Montsecosuchus depereti 的正模标本时，他们注意到似乎是软组织残留物的结构。 紫外线会导致化石组织和周围的岩石产生不同的反应，使原本看不见的结构脱颖而出。 该作品的第一作者 Oscar Castillo-Visa 解释道：“紫外线使我们能够看到原本完全隐藏在岩石中的细节。” 使用这种技术，研究小组记录了几种软组织，包括表皮鳞片。尽管德佩雷蒂山鳄自 20 世纪初就为科学所熟知，但新的分析首次提供了其皮肤外观的详细图片。 身体不同部位的鳞片的形状和大小差异很大。研究人员还发现，这种动物缺乏现代鳄鱼所具有的高尾鳍。 该化石还可能保存了皮肤感觉器官的证据。可能的结构出现在某些尺度内，特别是在......

reflection.en: The intricate patterns on the tail of this ancient crocodile, invisible until revealed by scientific tools, remind us that the created world holds many wonders. Job 12:7-9 encourages us to ask the animals and birds, the fish and the earth, for they all teach us about Yahweh's wisdom and design.
reflection.zh: 这只古代鳄鱼尾部复杂的图案，直到被科学工具揭示才显现，提醒我们受造的世界蕴藏着许多奇迹。约伯记12:7-9鼓励我们去问动物、飞鸟、鱼和大地，因为它们都教导我们关于雅伟的智慧和设计。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: US confirms for first time it has deployed weapons in space
title.zh: 美国首次确认已部署太空武器

summary.en: The US military has confirmed the deployment of weapons in space, a move that analysts warn could escalate a high-risk arms race with Russia and China in Earth's orbit. The confirmation comes from the US Air Force Secretary, who stated that "on-orbit" weapons are now active and circling the globe.
summary.zh: 美国军方已确认在太空部署了武器，分析人士警告此举可能加剧与俄罗斯和中国在地球轨道上的高风险军备竞赛。美国空军部长证实了这一消息，并表示“在轨”武器已处于活动状态并绕地球运行。

body.en: Analysts warn of an acceleration in high-risk arms race with Russia and China in Earth’s orbit The US has deployed weapons in space, the US military has confirmed, in an extraordinary public announcement that analysts warn will accelerate a high-risk arms race with Russia and China in Earth’s orbit. The US secretary of the air force, Troy Meink, said Washington had active “on-orbit” weapons, meaning they had been deployed and were circling the globe. Continue reading...

Isaiah's vision of a world where nations 'beat their swords into plowshares' offers a stark contrast to this trajectory. May we pray for wisdom and restraint among global powers, that the pursuit of security does not lead to...
reflection.zh: 在太空部署武器的确认是一个令人警醒的发展，凸显了人类将新领域武器化的持续驱动力。以赛亚关于世界各国“将刀打成犁头”的异象与这一轨迹形成了鲜明对比。愿我们为全球大国祈求智慧和克制，使对安全的追求不至于导致相互毁灭。

title.en: Data centre could threaten rare species, says charity
title.zh: 数据中心可能威胁稀有物种，慈善机构称

summary.en: The Essex Wildlife Trust warns that the construction of a new data centre could lead to the destruction of incredibly rare habitats, threatening endangered plants and a rare species of bumblebee.
summary.zh: 埃塞克斯野生动物信托基金警告称，新建数据中心的计划可能会导致极其罕见的栖息地被摧毁，威胁到濒危植物和一种稀有的熊蜂。

body.en:
Plans to build a new data centre could threaten the habitat of one of Britain's most endangered plants and a rare species of bumblebee, a wildlife trust said.

A planning application has already been submitted for the Google data centre at Arena Essex Raceway in Thurrock, which is designated as a local wildlife site.

It is home to the rare broad-leaved cudweed and shrill carder bumblebee and the Essex Wildlife Trust fears "incredibly rare" habitats would be "destroyed".

A Google spokesperson said it took "our environmental responsibilities very seriously".

Data centres are giant warehouses full of powerful computers used to run digital services, such as movie streaming, online banking and artificial intelligence.

There are 568 data centres listed in the UK, according to the data centre map. , external

Emily Buttress, from the Essex Wildlife Trust, said her team was worried about the water and energy usage required, the warming effect on the surrounding land, and a lack of research about the long-term impacts of these buildings.

"What would it do for the local community in a water drought county? We are not against development, but it has to happen sustainably."

The Arena Essex Raceway announced in 2018 that it would stop hosting speedway fixtures for the Lakeside Hammers team.

Meanwhile, the Essex Wildlife Trust says the surrounding grassland and woodland has become home to 687 invertebrate and 439 plant species.

The trust said this included dingy skipper, which is a small moth-like butterfly, and the shrill carder bumblebee, which was only found in two areas in England.

It was designated as a local wildlife site in 2006. This does not offer legal protection from development, but it means council planners expect developers to look after the ecology.

Nightingale birds, the brown-banded carder bee and the five-banded weevil-wasp have also been recorded at the site.

But Global Infrastructure UK Limited bought the 129-acre (52-hectare) site in July 2023 for £47m (exclusive of VAT).

It submitted plans for the data centre on behalf of Google last year, and as part of the application, consultancy firm Mallory Land Ltd said the proposals took into account the ecology there.

In a statement submitted as part of the plans, Mallory Land Ltd said: "The demand for data centres has expanded significantly in recent years, driven by exponential growth in digital services, the emergence of artificial intelligence, cloud-based technologies, and the increasing adoption of smart infrastructure."

"We share the Essex Wildlife Trust and Buglife's , external view that development at the former Arena Essex site must be sustainable," a spokesperson said.

reflection.en: The news of a proposed data centre in Thurrock raises concerns about the potential loss of unique habitats, home to endangered species like the broad-leaved cudweed and shrill carder bumblebee. The Psalmist marvels at the diversity of life, declaring, "How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures." This...
reflection.zh: 位于瑟罗克的拟议数据中心的新闻引发了对独特栖息地可能丧失的担忧，那里是宽叶鼠耳草和尖声绒毛熊蜂等濒危物种的家园。诗篇作者惊叹于生命的丰富多样，宣告说：“雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！万物都凭你的智慧造了；全地充满了你的造物。”这提醒我们所有受造物固有的复杂之美和价值，在开发影响自然世界时，敦促我们仔细权衡。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

body.en: Collagen powders, gummies and pills have boomed in popularity in recent years boosted by claims that they smooth wrinkles, promote glossy hair and help with joint pain. Amid the noise it can be hard to figure out whether there’s any actual science behind the promise of looking younger for longer. Luckily Dr Xand van Tulleken has spent the past three years writing Make me well: a quest to understand the confusing world of wellness , and his chapter on collagen dives deep into the evidence. He tells Madeleine Finlay what collagen does in the body, how we can get it without splashing out on expensive supplements, and why getting to the truth behind wellness claims can be so hard Continue reading...
body.zh: 近年来，胶原蛋白粉、软糖和药丸迅速流行起来，因为它们声称可以抚平皱纹、促进头发光泽并有助于缓解关节疼痛。在喧嚣声中，很难弄清楚让自己看起来更年轻的承诺背后是否有真正的科学依据。幸运的是，Xand van Tulleken 博士在过去三年里一直在撰写《让我康复：寻求理解令人困惑的健康世界》一书，他关于胶原蛋白的章节深入探讨了证据。他告诉玛德琳芬利胶原蛋白在体内的作用，我们如何在不花昂贵的补充剂的情况下获得胶原蛋白，以及为什么了解健康声明背后的真相如此困难继续阅读...

reflection.en: In a world saturated with wellness trends and marketing claims, it's easy to feel overwhelmed and unsure of what to believe. The pursuit of looking younger and healthier is understandable, but the noise surrounding supplements like collagen can obscure the truth. Philippians 4:8 reminds us to focus our minds on what is true, noble, right, pure, lovely, and...
reflection.zh: 在一个充斥着健康潮流和营销宣传的世界里，人们很容易感到不知所措，不知道该相信什么。追求看起来更年轻、更健康是可以理解的，但围绕胶原蛋白等补充剂的喧嚣可能会掩盖真相。腓立比书 4:8 提醒我们要将心思意念集中在真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事上，鼓励我们在困惑中保持分辨力。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Will El Niño bring winter snow to the UK?
title.zh: 厄尔尼诺会给英国带来冬季降雪吗？

summary.en: Meteorologist Matt Taylor provides a forecast for the upcoming autumn and winter months in the UK, considering the potential influence of the El Niño phenomenon on weather patterns, specifically snow.
summary.zh: 气象学家马特·泰勒展望了英国的秋冬季节，并探讨了厄尔尼诺现象对降雪可能产生的影响。

reflection.en: The changing weather patterns, influenced by phenomena like El Niño, remind us of the intricate systems governing our planet. The Psalmist marvels, 'How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.' (Psalm 104:24). We can find wonder in observing these natural cycles, recognizing the Creator's hand in the...
reflection.zh: 像厄尔尼诺这样的现象所带来的天气变化，提醒我们地球上运行着多么精密的系统。诗篇作者惊叹道：“雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！万物都凭你的智慧造了；全地充满了你的创造物。”（诗篇104:24）。我们可以在观察这些自然循环中找到惊奇，认识到造物主在我们世界微妙平衡中的手。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: They’re the sopranos of the forest, so what’s silencing the gibbons’ morning chorus?
title.zh: 森林里的女高音们，是什么让长臂猿的晨曲沉默了？

summary.en: As human development and roads increasingly fragment their habitats, a study suggests traffic noise could be altering the animals’ wake-up call. Dawn has broken, and the air is cool and still. It’s at about this time that gibbons usually erupt into song, wa-oo-ing and wa-ing from the highest branches and filling the...
summary.zh: 随着人类开发和道路日益分割它们的栖息地，一项研究表明交通噪音可能正在改变动物的唤醒曲。黎明破晓，空气凉爽而宁静。大约在这个时候，长臂猿通常会放声歌唱，从最高的树枝上发出哇呜哇呜的叫声，用丰富的旋律填满树冠。但在马来西亚这片被房屋和道路包围的森林角落里，居住的白手长臂猿却沉默着。唯一能听到的只有附近高速公路传来的交通噪音...

body.en: As human development and roads increasingly fragment their habitats, a study suggests traffic noise could be altering the animals’ wake-up call Dawn has broken, and the air is cool and still. It’s at about this time that gibbons usually erupt into song, wa-oo-ing and wa-ing from the highest branches and filling the tree tops with rich melodies. But in this corner of Malaysian forest, bordered by housing and roads, the resident white-handed gibbons are quiet. All that can be heard is the hum of traffic from a nearby highway. This isn’t a rare occurrence for this group of gibbons, according to research, which found these particular gibbons, named Mambang and Walinong, appeared to be producing far fewer morning songs than others that are not exposed to the same level of traffic noise. Continue reading...
body.zh: 随着人类发展和道路日益破碎它们的栖息地，一项研究表明，交通噪音可能会改变动物的叫醒声黎明已经破晓，空气凉爽而宁静。大约在这个时候，长臂猿通常会从最高的树枝上发出呜呜呜的歌声，让树顶充满丰富的旋律。但在马来西亚森林的这个角落，毗邻房屋和道路，居住的白掌长臂猿却很安静。只能听到附近高速公路传来的交通声。根据研究，这种情况对于这群长臂猿来说并不罕见，研究发现这些特殊的长臂猿，名为曼邦（Mambang）和瓦利农（Walinong），与其他没有暴露在同等交通噪音水平下的长臂猿相比，早上发出的歌曲似乎要少得多。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The vibrant chorus of gibbons, once a hallmark of the dawn, is being muted by the pervasive noise of human activity. This silencing is a poignant echo of the groaning of creation, as described in Romans 8:22, which suffers under the weight of our development. May we listen to these subtle cries and seek ways to live more harmoniously with the natural world.
reflection.zh: 长臂猿充满活力的合唱曾是黎明的标志，如今却被人类活动无处不在的噪音所压制。这种沉默是罗马书8:22中所描述的受造之物的叹息的凄美回响，它们承受着我们发展的重负。愿我们倾听这些细微的呼唤，并寻求与自然世界更和谐地相处之道。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Quality control of glycogen through direct ubiquitylation by RNF213
title.zh: 通过RNF213直接泛素化调控糖原质量

summary.en: A study published in Nature details how the enzyme RNF213 directly ubiquitylation controls the quality of glycogen, a key energy storage molecule. This discovery sheds light on cellular quality control mechanisms.
summary.zh: 发表在《自然》杂志上的一项研究详细介绍了酶RNF213如何通过直接泛素化来控制糖原（一种关键的能量储存分子）的质量。这一发现阐明了细胞质量控制机制。

reflection.en: The intricate processes within our cells, like the quality control of glycogen described in this study, reveal the profound wisdom embedded in creation. As Job 12:7-9 reminds us, 'Ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds of the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish of the sea inform you.'...
reflection.zh: 我们细胞内复杂的生化过程，例如本研究中描述的糖原质量控制，揭示了创造中蕴含的深刻智慧。正如约伯书12:7-9所提醒我们的：“你可以问走兽，它们会教导你；天空的飞鸟，它们会告诉你；或对大地说话，它会教导你；海中的鱼也会告诉你。” 自然界，直至分子层面，都是雅伟设计的明证，也是深刻理解的源泉。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Author Correction: Erythropoietin receptor on cDC1s dictates immune tolerance
title.zh: 作者勘误：cDC1上的促红细胞生成素受体决定免疫耐受

summary.en: An author correction is published regarding research on the erythropoietin receptor's function on cDC1 cells and its role in dictating immune tolerance. The correction addresses specific details within the original publication.
summary.zh: 一篇关于促红细胞生成素受体在cDC1细胞上功能及其在决定免疫耐受中作用的研究，发布了作者勘误。该勘误修正了原始出版物中的具体细节。

reflection.en: The scientific community constantly refines its understanding, as seen in this correction. It reminds us that diligent observation and study of the natural world, as Job 12:7 suggests, can reveal profound truths about its intricate workings. Even as knowledge advances, humility and a commitment to accuracy are essential.
reflection.zh: 科学界不断完善其理解，正如这次勘误所示。它提醒我们，正如约伯记12:7所建议的，勤奋地观察和研究自然世界，可以揭示其错综复杂运作的深刻真理。即使知识在进步，谦逊和对准确性的承诺也是必不可少的。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: A wake-up call: diversify global research funding
title.zh: 一个警钟：实现全球研究资助多元化

summary.en: Nature, Published online: 15 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02904-8 A wake-up call: diversify global research funding
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志，在线发表：2026年9月15日；doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02904-8 一个警钟：实现全球研究资助多元化

reflection.en: This editorial calls for a broader distribution of research funding worldwide, recognizing that diverse perspectives and locations are crucial for scientific advancement. The ancient wisdom of Job reminds us that creation itself is a source of profound understanding, urging us to look closely at the world around us, wherever we are, to uncover its secrets....
reflection.zh: 这篇社论呼吁在全球范围内更广泛地分配研究经费，认识到多元化的视角和地点对于科学进步至关重要。《约伯记》中的古老智慧提醒我们，创造本身就是深刻理解的源泉，敦促我们无论身在何处，都要仔细观察周围的世界，以揭示其奥秘。愿我们支持并鼓励来自世界各个角落的知识追求。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Technology Desk
title.zh: 科技前沿

strap.en: Technology shaping how we live, work, and think.
strap.zh: 正在改变生活、工作与思考方式的科技动态。

title.en: Trump blasts decision that blocks mail-in voting executive orders: ‘This court has really let our country down’ – live
title.zh: 特朗普抨击阻止邮寄投票行政命令的决定：“这个法院真的让我们的国家失望了”——直播

summary.en: The president called mail-in voting – which he has used on several occasions to cast a ballot – ‘a laughing stock’ across the world. The Supreme Court has rejected Trump’s mail ballot restrictions for midterm elections. Kash Patel, the FBI director, is now testifying before lawmakers on the Senate judiciary committee.
summary.zh: 总统称邮寄投票——他本人曾多次使用邮寄投票——是全世界的“笑柄”。最高法院驳回了特朗普对中期选举的邮寄选票限制。联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔目前正在参议院司法委员会就此向议员们作证。

body.en: The president called mail-in voting – which he has used on several occasions to cast a ballot – ‘a laughing stock’ across the world Supreme court rejects Trump’s mail ballot restrictions for midterm elections Sign up for US Breaking News emails Kash Patel , the FBI director, is now testifying before lawmakers on the Senate judiciary committee. A reminder that the last time he appeared before Congress was in May, when he sparred with senators on the appropriations committee and denied – under oath – allegations of excessive drinking and unexplained absences on the job, dismissing them as “baseless” during a fiery congressional hearing. Today’s hearing is also expected to be full of heated exchanges. “Mr Patel is the least qualified and most partisan FBI director in our nation’s history,” said Senator Dick Durbin, the judiciary committee’s top Democrat. “The bureau has been reshaped as a political weapon against President Trump’s political enemies and a shield to protect the president and his MAGA loyalists, not the American people.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 总统称邮寄投票——他曾多次使用这种方式进行投票——在全世界都是“笑柄”。最高法院驳回了特朗普对中期选举的邮寄选票限制。联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔目前正在参议院司法委员会的议员面前作证。提醒人们，他最后一次出现在国会是在五月份，当时他与拨款委员会的参议员发生争执，并在宣誓后否认了有关过度饮酒和不明原因缺勤的指控，并在一场激烈的国会听证会上驳斥称这些指控“毫无根据”。今天的听证会预计也会充满激烈的交流。 “帕特尔先生是我们国家历史上最不合格、最具党派倾向的联邦调查局局长，”司法委员会民主党领袖、参议员迪克·杜宾(Dick Durbin)说。 “该局已被重塑为对抗特朗普总统政敌的政治武器，以及保护总统和他的 MAGA 忠诚者而不是美国人民的盾牌。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The Supreme Court's rejection of mail-in voting restrictions, despite the president's strong objections, underscores the principle that legal processes often require hearing multiple perspectives. Proverbs 18:17 reminds us that even in disputes, there is value in listening to each party before rendering a verdict, a principle crucial for maintaining trust...
reflection.zh: 最高法院驳回了对邮寄投票的限制，尽管总统对此表示强烈反对，这凸显了法律程序通常需要听取多方观点的原则。箴言18:17提醒我们，即使在争端中，在做出裁决之前听取各方陈述也是有价值的，这一原则对于维护机构的信任至关重要。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Datacentre giant accused of using AI while lobbying for Victorian minister’s support for hyperscale factory
title.zh: 数据中心巨头被指控在游说维多利亚州部长支持其超大规模工厂时使用人工智能

summary.en: An exclusive report reveals correspondence where NextDC, a major data center company, allegedly used AI-generated errors while requesting Victorian Jobs Minister Melissa Horne to lobby for the approval of a large expansion of its "hyperscale AI factory." This comes amid growing community concerns about data centers.
summary.zh: 独家报道披露了一份通信文件，其中澳大利亚最大的数据中心公司之一 NextDC 在请求维多利亚州就业部长梅丽莎·霍恩为其“超大规模人工智能工厂”的大规模扩建争取批准时，据称使用了人工智能生成的错误。此前，社区对数据中心的担忧日益加剧。

body.en: Exclusive: Correspondence requests state MP Melissa Horne to lobby on NextDC’s behalf – but contains alleged AI-created errors Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The Victorian jobs minister has accused one of Australia’s largest datacentre companies of using artificial intelligence while requesting she lobby her colleague to approve a massive expansion of its “hyperscale AI factory”. Correspondence between Victorian cabinet minister Melissa Horne and the chief executive of ASX-listed company NextDC, Craig Scroggie, reveals increasing sensitivity to community concerns about datacentres before the state election. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家：信件要求州议员 Melissa Horne 代表 NextDC 进行游说，但包含涉嫌人工智能造成的错误 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 维多利亚州就业部长指责澳大利亚最大的数据中心公司之一使用人工智能，同时要求她游说她的同事批准大规模扩建其“超大规模人工智能工厂”。维多利亚州内阁部长 Melissa Horne 与澳大利亚证券交易所上市公司 NextDC 首席执行官 Craig Scroggie 之间的通信表明，在州选举之前，社区对数据中心的担忧日益敏感。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news raises questions about the integrity of corporate lobbying and the use of artificial intelligence in sensitive communications. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God. May we seek ethical practices in all our dealings, ensuring transparency and accountability, especially when seeking influence.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻引发了对企业游说诚信以及在敏感通信中使用人工智能的疑问。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与雅伟同行。愿我们在一切事务中寻求合乎道德的做法，确保透明度和问责制，尤其是在寻求影响力的过程中。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: ‘In this new car, I feel patronised’: which driver assistance systems actually improve safety?
title.zh: “在这辆新车里，我感觉被轻视了”：哪些驾驶辅助系统能真正提高安全性？

summary.en: Modern cars are equipped with features like autonomous emergency braking and fatigue monitoring. However, the article questions whether these systems genuinely assist drivers or merely distract them. The author describes a test-drive experience where the car's constant alerts and interventions felt intrusive and...
summary.zh: 现代汽车配备了自动紧急制动和疲劳监测等功能。然而，文章质疑这些系统是真正帮助驾驶员，还是仅仅分散他们的注意力。作者描述了一次试驾经历，汽车不断的警报和干预让人感到侵扰和被轻视，他将这种体验比作一个“看不见的存在”在控制汽车。

body.en: Modern cars are fitted with features like autonomous emergency braking and fatigue monitoring. But do they support motorists or drive them to distraction? This new car I’m test-driving boasts all the latest bells and whistles – or, rather, beeps and bings. Peer sideways for too long checking traffic and the car emits an irritating sound. Should I take a hand off the wheel to scratch an ear, I’m admonished with a strident beep. When the car determines it’s too near a white line, it tugs the wheel against my hands and brakes as a car slows ahead. Its haptic “buttons” feel like fingers pressing back – as if an invisible presence has its hands and feet on the controls: a ghost in the machine I’m inside. Continue reading...
body.zh: 现代汽车配备了自动紧急制动和疲劳监测等功能。但它们是支持驾车者还是让他们分心呢？我正在试驾的这辆新车拥有所有最新的花哨功能 - 或者更确切地说，是蜂鸣声和鸣响声。长时间侧身观察路况，汽车会发出刺耳的声音。如果我把手从方向盘上拿开去抓耳朵，我会听到刺耳的嘟嘟声警告。当汽车确定它距离白线太近时，它会将车轮拉向我的手，并在汽车减速时刹车。它的触觉“按钮”感觉就像手指向后压——就好像一个无形的存在将手和脚放在了控制器上：我所在的机器里有一个幽灵。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of technology, as seen in modern cars with their complex driver-assistance systems, brings both potential benefits and new challenges. Daniel 12:4 speaks of knowledge increasing in the end times, a prophecy that resonates with our current era of technological acceleration. We are called to discern how these innovations serve human...
reflection.zh: 正如现代汽车及其复杂的驾驶辅助系统所展示的，技术的飞速发展既带来了潜在的好处，也带来了新的挑战。但以理书12:4提到末世知识必增长，这预言与我们当前技术加速的时代产生了共鸣。我们被呼召去辨别这些创新如何服务于人类的繁荣与安全，而不是成为分心或被控制的根源。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: This Atlantic hurricane season is about to do something that hasn't happened in 175 years
title.zh: 今年大西洋飓风季将出现175年来未有的情况

summary.en: The Atlantic hurricane season has passed its traditional peak without any tropical storms or hurricanes forming, a phenomenon not seen in 175 years. This unusual quiet is attributed to factors like Saharan dust and wind shear, bringing relief to coastal areas.
summary.zh: 大西洋飓风季已过其传统高峰期，但至今未出现任何热带风暴或飓风，这是175年来首次出现的情况。这种异常的平静归因于撒哈拉尘埃和风切变等因素，给沿海地区带来了宽慰。

body.en: Last week, the Atlantic hurricane season blew through its traditional peak—which comes around September 10—with nary a tropical wave in sight, let alone a storm or hurricane. This is remarkable. Usually this is the time of year when sea surface temperatures reach their warmest in the tropics, and with a favorable atmosphere it should be smooth skating for tropical systems. But this year, the main region where most tropical systems develop is choked with Saharan dust and wind shear. No one is complaining. Landfalling hurricanes are incredibly destructive for coastal areas and have the potential for considerable inland rainfall. Even storms at sea, in the Gulf of Mexico, can send energy prices skyrocketing—the last thing needed this year. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 上周，大西洋飓风季节经历了传统的高峰期（9 月 10 日左右），看不到热带波浪，更不用说风暴或飓风了。这是非常了不起的。通常，这是一年中热带海面温度达到最热的时间，在有利的气氛下，热带系统应该会顺利滑冰。但今年，大多数热带系统发展的主要地区都被撒哈拉沙尘和风切变所堵塞。没有人抱怨。登陆的飓风对沿海地区具有极大的破坏性，并有可能带来大量的内陆降雨。即使墨西哥湾的海上风暴也会导致能源价格飙升——这是今年最不需要的事情。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The absence of hurricanes this season offers a welcome respite, a moment of calm amidst the usual anxieties of storm season. It reminds us that even in a world prone to natural upheaval, there are seasons of peace and protection, offering a tangible sense of refuge.
reflection.zh: 本季飓风的缺席提供了一个受欢迎的喘息机会，是在风暴季节的惯常焦虑中难得的平静时刻。它提醒我们，即使在一个易受自然动荡影响的世界里，也有和平与保护的季节，带来切实的避难感。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: ‘I created my mom and talk to her’: AI ghosts and deathslop are changing the way we mourn
title.zh: “我创造了我妈妈并和她说话”：人工智能幽灵和死亡回响正在改变我们的哀悼方式

summary.en: The increasing use of AI-generated tributes and bots designed for 'talking' to the deceased is raising concerns among experts that individuals may increasingly grieve in isolation. The article notes instances like tributes to Dolly Parton and a viral AI-generated song, highlighting a trend that blurs the lines between...
summary.zh: 人工智能生成的悼念和用于“与逝者交谈”的机器人日益普及，引起专家担忧，认为人们可能会越来越孤立地哀悼。文章提到了对桃乐茜·帕金的悼念以及一首病毒式传播的人工智能歌曲，突显了一种模糊纪念与人工智能互动界限的趋势。

body.en: The rise of AI-generated tributes and bots for ‘talking’ to the dead has experts concerned more people will grieve in isolation Tributes rolled in after the death of Dolly Parton last month. Jack White performed Jolene at a London gig. Kesha sang Old Flames (Can’t Hold a Candle to You), a single her mother wrote for the country music titan. Even Pitbull stopped his Madison Square Garden show to memorialize Parton and all the other “powerful women” in the crowd. But one of the strangest – and most viral – eulogies did not come from a celebrity. It did not even come from a person. Run Jolene, at just under five minutes, is an earworm of a country song, containing all the cliches of the genre: twangy singer, banjo licks, corny lyrics. Those lyrics concern Jolene, the fictional romantic rival made infamous by Parton. “Somebody better warn Jolene / Dolly’s coming through those gates,” the voice croons. “Run Jolene / Girl you better move your feet.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 人工智能生成的悼念和与死者“交谈”的机器人的兴起让专家担心更多的人会在孤立的环境中哀悼上个月多莉·帕顿去世后，悼念活动不断涌现。杰克·怀特（Jack White）在伦敦的一场演出中扮演乔琳（Jolene）。凯莎演唱了她母亲为乡村音乐巨头创作的单曲《Old Flames》（Can't Hold a Candle to You）。就连比特犬也停止了麦迪逊广场花园的演出，以纪念帕顿和人群中所有其他“有权势的女性”。但最奇怪、最广为传播的悼词之一并不是来自名人。它甚至不是来自一个人。 《Run Jolene》时长不到五分钟，是一首令人耳目一新的乡村歌曲，包含了该流派的所有陈词滥调：鼻音歌手、班卓琴乐句、老套歌词。这些歌词涉及乔琳（Jolene），她是虚构的浪漫对手，因帕顿而臭名昭著。 “最好有人警告乔琳/多莉正从那些大门进来，”那个声音低声说道。 “快跑，乔琳/女孩，你最好移动你的脚。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The emergence of AI 'ghosts' and digital replicas of the deceased presents a profound challenge to how we understand grief and human connection. While these technologies offer a novel way to remember loved ones, they also risk isolating individuals in their mourning. The Genesis account reminds us that each person is created in the image of God, possessing...
reflection.zh: 人工智能“幽灵”和已故亲属数字复制品的出现，对我们理解哀悼和人际联系的方式提出了严峻的挑战。尽管这些技术为纪念亲人提供了一种新颖的方式，但它们也可能使人们在哀悼中感到孤立。《创世记》提醒我们，每个人都是按照雅伟的形象被造的，拥有技术无法复制的内在尊严和独特本质，这促使我们在失去亲人的痛苦中寻求真实的连接。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Exclusive: Paying for frontier AI models buys 4-month head start at 5x the cost
title.zh: 独家：支付前沿人工智能模型的费用可获得 4 个月的领先优势，但成本是原来的 5 倍

summary.en: Ars Technica has previewed a Mozilla report detailing how inexpensive open-source AI models have rapidly caught up in capability to expensive, cutting-edge proprietary models.
summary.zh: Ars Technica 预览了 Mozilla 的一份报告，该报告详细介绍了廉价开源人工智能模型如何在功能上迅速赶上昂贵、尖端的专有模型。

body.en: The performance gap between frontier AI models from US tech companies and the best open-weights models from Chinese companies has closed to just 4.4 months, according to a Mozilla report. That explains why many companies are shifting to the significantly cheaper open models for routine work—and helps reveal a narrow band of workloads where frontier models are worth the cost. Most organizations should ideally be using open models as the default for the majority of their work, according to the latest State of Open Source AI report from Mozilla, published on September 15 and shared with Ars prior to publication. The report highlights how a leading open model, Moonshot AI’s Kimi K3, achieves a composite AI performance score on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index that is just three points behind Anthropic’s Fable 5 closed frontier model, all while costing just 30 percent of the latter. “Closed earns its premium in a few places: expert professional work, high-intensity retrieval, and long context,” Raffi Krikorian, chief technology officer at Mozilla, said in an email to Ars. “We see the decision to pay for closed as workload-specific rather than organization-specific.” Read full article Comments
body.zh: 根据 Mozilla 的一份报告，美国科技公司的前沿人工智能模型与中国公司的最佳开放权重模型之间的性能差距已缩小至仅 4.4 个月。这解释了为什么许多公司正在转向更便宜的开放模型来进行日常工作，并有助于揭示前沿模型值得花费的一小部分工作负载。根据 Mozilla 于 9 月 15 日发布并在发布前与 Ars 分享的最新开源人工智能现状报告，大多数组织在理想情况下应该使用开放模型作为其大部分工作的默认设置。该报告重点介绍了领先的开放模型 Moonshot AI 的 Kimi K3 如何在人工智能分析智能指数上取得综合 AI 性能得分，仅落后 Anthropic 的 Fable 5 封闭前沿模型 3 分，而成本仅为后者的 30%。 Mozilla 首席技术官 Raffi Krikorian 在给 Ars 的电子邮件中表示：“Closed 在几个方面赢得了它的溢价：专业的专业工作、高强度的检索和长的上下文。” “我们认为支付关闭费用的决定是针对特定工作负载而不是针对特定组织的。”阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The pace of AI development is astonishing, with open-source models rapidly closing the gap with proprietary ones. This rapid increase in knowledge and capability, as described in Daniel 12:4, calls us to consider how we steward these powerful tools. May we seek wisdom and discernment in their application, ensuring they serve humanity ethically and for good.
reflection.zh: 人工智能发展的速度令人震惊，开源模型正在迅速缩小与专有模型的差距。正如但以理书 12:4 所述，知识和能力的这种快速增长，促使我们思考如何管理这些强大的工具。愿我们寻求智慧和辨别力来应用它们，确保它们合乎道德地为人类服务并造福人类。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Volvo increases the batteries for 2028 XC60 and XC90 plug-in refresh
title.zh: 沃尔沃为2028年XC60和XC90插电式混合动力车型更新提升了电池续航

summary.en: Volvo has refreshed its XC60 and XC90 plug-in hybrid SUVs, significantly increasing their electric range and updating infotainment systems. The XC60, a bestseller for the brand, receives subtle styling changes alongside the powertrain improvements.
summary.zh: 沃尔沃更新了其XC60和XC90插电式混合动力SUV，显著增加了电动续航里程并更新了信息娱乐系统。作为该品牌畅销车型，XC60在动力系统改进的同时也获得了细微的造型调整。

body.en: Volvo provided flights from Washington, DC, to London, England, and accommodation so Ars could see its refreshed vehicles. Ars does not accept paid editorial content. There must be a case of upgrade fever taking hold in Gothenburg. Yesterday, we saw the revised Volvo XC40 ; today it’s the turn of another pair of Volvo SUVs, the bestselling XC60 and the three-row XC90. While the styling changes are more subtle, the new plug-in hybrid powertrain—which more than doubles its real-world electric range—is most welcome. Volvo had sold more than 2.7 million XC60s worldwide by the end of last year, so it’s an important car for the brand. Visually, there are changes to the “Thor’s Hammer” headlights: these keep their distinctive daylight running light signature but now hide matrix LED projectors within their depths. There’s a new front grille as well, one that has been slimmed down a little, together with tweaks to the bumpers, wings, and some other body panels. On the inside, there’s a new ventilated leather interior option, and like the XC40, the new 11.2-inch infotainment system sports a Gemini personal assistant to enable conversational voice control of the android automotive OS-based infotainment system. Based on some brief testing, the new Gemini voice assistant does at least perform a lot better than the previous version, which, if anything, has degraded in ability over the past few years. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 沃尔沃提供了从华盛顿特区飞往英国伦敦的航班，并提供住宿，以便 Ars 能够看到其更新的车辆。 Ars 不接受付费编辑内容。哥德堡一定有升级热潮。昨天，我们看到了改款的沃尔沃XC40；今天轮到另一款沃尔沃 SUV：最畅销的 XC60 和三排座 XC90。虽然造型变化更加微妙，但新的插电式混合动力系统（其实际电动续航里程增加了一倍多）最受欢迎。截至去年底，沃尔沃XC60在全球的销量已超过270万辆，因此它对该品牌来说是一款重要的汽车。从视觉上看，“雷神之锤”头灯发生了变化：保留了其独特的日间行车灯标志，但现在将矩阵 LED 投影仪隐藏在其深处。还有一个新的前格栅，它已经缩小了一点，同时对保险杠、机翼和其他一些车身面板进行了调整。在内部，有一个新的通风皮革内饰选项，与 XC40 一样，新的 11.2 英寸信息娱乐系统配备了 Gemini 个人助理，可以对基于 Android 汽车操作系统的信息娱乐系统进行对话式语音控制。根据一些简短的测试，新的 Gemini 语音助手的性能至少比之前的版本好很多，如果说有什么不同的话，那就是在过去几年里，之前的版本在能力上有所下降。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The engineers and designers at Volvo have dedicated themselves to improving their vehicles, as seen in the enhanced electric range and new infotainment systems for the XC60 and XC90. This commitment to diligent work, aiming to serve customers better, echoes the principle of doing all things for the glory of God.
reflection.zh: 沃尔沃的工程师和设计师致力于改进他们的车辆，正如XC60和XC90的电动续航里程提升和新的信息娱乐系统所示。这种致力于勤奋工作、旨在更好地为客户服务的精神，呼应了凡事为雅伟荣耀而做的原则。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Pubs in England and Wales to allow digital ID apps to prove age
title.zh: 英威尔士酒吧允许使用数字身份证应用程序证明年龄

summary.en: New rules mean pubs and shops in England and Wales can accept digital ID apps alongside physical documents to verify age, aiming for quicker and more secure checks.
summary.zh: 新规意味着英格兰和威尔士的酒吧和商店可以接受数字身份证应用程序以及实体证件来验证年龄，旨在实现更快、更安全的检查。

body.en:
Alcohol buyers will be able to use a digital ID app on their phones to prove their age under new rules introduced on Tuesday.

Pubs and shops in England and Wales can use the tech in addition to current physical forms of ID - with the government saying a digital option will make age-checks quicker and more secure for customers and staff.

Customers will be able to choose ID apps from a range of suppliers such as the Post Office, Yoti or Luciditi, provided they are on a government-approved list.

The change means businesses will no longer be required to let people use physical ID, but the government contends most establishments would.

The plan will be technology-agnostic, meaning that the government is not setting out in detail how each app must work.

It argues that under the voluntary digital ID scheme, drinkers would share fewer personal details with a venue or shop - such as tapping their phone on a reader or displaying a scannable QR code rather than handing over an official document.

The apps will also need to guard against customers borrowing devices from older friends and relatives, and ensure the ID app belongs to the person using it.

Yoti's digital ID app, for example, will only let a user log in if a scan of their face matches that of the person who signed up for the app.

The app then generates a QR code that can be scanned by a business with a free checker app, which tells them the person's age.

Digital government minister Stephanie Peacock said having the option for digital ID would "mean you do not need to carry a physical ID, nor hand over sensitive personal information" meaning people could "feel safer on a night out'".

Allen Simpson, chief executive of trade body UKHospitality, said the new rules were a "positive step".

He added the industry would work with government to make sure the scheme's roll-out would not be "burdensome" for the hospitality sector.

This would include ensuring there were multiple options for suppliers and that it was cost-efficient, Simpson said.

The government wants digital ID apps under its scheme to work together so customers do not need to use different apps in different venues.

It also wants the services to work offline and accessible even without mobile data or a Wi-Fi connection.

In future, the digital proof of age scheme could be extended to cover tobacco and vapes.

But digital rights campaigners have said such measures could lead to the exclusion of some groups.

Jasleen Chaggar of Big Brother Watch said while having multiple ways to prove your identity was helpful, the Government should ensure that digital ID did not become effectively mandatory "as it would shut out millions of people".

"Many people have legitimate reasons for relying on physical ID, whether out of choice, privacy and...
body.zh: 根据周二推出的新规定，酒类购买者将能够使用手机上的数字身份应用程序来证明自己的年龄。 除了当前的实体身份证件之外，英格兰和威尔士的酒吧和商店还可以使用这项技术——政府表示，数字选项将使年龄检查对顾客和员工来说更快、更安全。 客户将能够从 Post Office、Yoti 或 Luciditi 等一系列供应商那里选择 ID 应用程序，前提是它们位于政府批准的列表中。 这一变化意味着企业将不再被要求让人们使用实体身份证，但政府认为大多数企业都会这样做。 该计划将与技术无关，这意味着政府不会详细说明每个应用程序必须如何运行。 它认为，根据自愿数字身份计划，饮酒者将与场所或商店分享更少的个人详细信息，例如将手机放在阅读器上或显示可扫描的二维码，而不是提交官方文件。 这些应用程序还需要防止客户从年长的朋友和亲戚那里借用设备，并确保 ID 应用程序属于使用它的人。 例如，Yoti 的数字身份证应用程序只有在面部​​扫描与注册该应用程序的人的面部扫描相匹配时才会允许用户登录。 然后，该应用程序会生成一个二维码，企业可以使用免费的检查应用程序扫描该二维码，从而得知该人的年龄。 数字政府部长斯蒂芬妮·皮科克表示，选择数字身份证“意味着你不需要携带实体身份证，也不需要交出敏感的个人信息”，这意味着人们可以“在晚上外出时感到更安全”。 贸易机构英国酒店业协会首席执行官艾伦·辛普森表示，新规定是“积极的一步”。 他补充说，该行业将与政府合作，确保该计划的推出不会给酒店业带来“负担”。 辛普森说，这包括确保供应商有多种选择，并且具有成本效益。 政府希望其计划下的数字身份应用程序能够协同工作，这样客户就不需要在不同的场所使用不同的应用程序。 它还希望这些服务能够离线工作，即使没有移动数据或 Wi-Fi 连接也可以访问。 未来，数字年龄证明计划可能会扩展到涵盖烟草和电子烟。 但数字权利活动人士表示，此类措施可能会导致某些群体被排除在外。 Big Brother Watch 的贾斯琳·查加尔 (Jasleen Chaggar) 表示，虽然有多种方法来证明你的身份很有帮助，但政府应该确保数字身份不会成为有效的强制措施，“因为这会将数百万人拒之门外”。 “许多人有合理的理由依赖实体身份证，无论是出于选择、隐私还是......

reflection.en: The digital age continues to accelerate, bringing new tools like age-verification apps. Daniel spoke of a time when knowledge would increase and many would hurry to and fro. This technological advancement is a clear sign of that prophecy being fulfilled, urging us to consider how we use this growing knowledge wisely and ethically.
reflection.zh: 数字时代持续加速，带来了诸如年龄验证应用程序之类的新工具。但以理曾预言，在末后的日子，知识将增多，人也必往返奔走。这项技术进步是这一预言实现的明显标志，促使我们思考如何明智且合乎道德地运用日益增长的知识。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Valve's Steam Frame is excellent - but at over £1,000 is VR still too expensive?
title.zh: Valve的Steam Frame表现出色——但超过1000英镑，VR是否仍然太贵了？

summary.en: Tom Gerken from the BBC gets hands-on with the latest virtual reality headset, the Steam Frame, and finds it to be excellent hardware but questions its high price point of over £1,000.
summary.zh: BBC的汤姆·格肯亲身体验了最新的虚拟现实头显Steam Frame，发现其硬件表现出色，但对其超过1000英镑的高昂价格提出了质疑。

body.en:
Valve's new virtual reality headset, the Steam Frame, has officially been released - but it comes at a high price.

The hardware is excellent - a light device which feels comfortable to wear and is packed with clever technology - so long as you're willing to pay a whopping £1,089 for a headset with 1TB of storage.

Both are capable of streaming from a PC as well as playing games on-device, with varying degrees of success.

But it carries a price tag which will make a lot of people roll their eyes, and doesn't do much to dispel criticism that increasingly-costly VR headsets are pricing people out of the hobby.

But before we get into that hefty price tag, is the Steam Frame actually any good?

I've owned VR headsets for well over a decade, and Valve's latest effort makes a promising first impression.

Games run well - really the bare minimum considering the price tag - and it's easy enough to use.

One of the nice things is, like Meta's Quest 3, it has flat "pancake" lenses allowing you to see clearly when you put the headset on.

It's light - weighing little more than a can of soup. But what makes it comfortable is the decision to separate the internals up.

The battery pack rests on the back of your head while the screen is at the front - meaning you don't feel front-heavy, a common criticism of other headsets.

But there are better screens out there. The PlayStation VR2 for example has incredible OLED displays, albeit without the pancake lenses.

Yet these come at a serious premium, costing significantly more than the Steam Frame.

When Meta launched the Quest 3 in June 2023, its 128GB model retailed for £480. Less storage, but a much lower price.

Three years later, it's hard to believe VR just keeps getting more expensive when the Quest 3 felt like a turning point.

"VR today is ultimately a high-end niche," gaming writer Christopher Dring told me.

"Meta had been subsidising the Quest hardware, and it's difficult to imagine they will going forward as they pivot away from those experiences."

Of course, there are reasons for prices going up. AI developers are building giant data centres filled with racks of powerful servers, using many of the same components needed to make devices like the Steam Frame.

Ram prices alone more than doubled in price between October 2025 and the start of 2026 . Meanwhile, the graphics card I bought for £500 a few months ago now sits at closer to £650.

As prices climb higher and higher, hardware developers don't have much of a choice but to put up their own.

"We set out to come out with a device that would have been much more affordable," Valve developer Jeremy Selan said.

"But the global Ram market has impacted us the same way it's impacted everybody."

"The idea that it's too expensive is one of the biggest...
body.zh: Valve 的新款虚拟现实耳机 Steam Frame 已正式发布，但价格高昂。 其硬件非常出色，是一款佩戴舒适、采用巧妙技术的轻便设备，只要您愿意花 1,089 英镑购买一款具有 1TB 存储空间的耳机。 两者都能够从 PC 上进行流媒体播放，也能够在设备上玩游戏，并取得了不同程度的成功。 但它的价格标签会让很多人翻白眼，而且并不能消除人们对日益昂贵的虚拟现实头显让人们放弃这项爱好的批评。 但在我们讨论这个高昂的价格之前，Steam Frame 真的好吗？ 我拥有 VR 耳机已有十多年了，Valve 的最新成果给我留下了美好的第一印象。 游戏运行良好——考虑到价格标签，这确实是最低限度——而且它很容易使用。 优点之一是，与 Meta 的 Quest 3 一样，它具有扁平的“煎饼”镜片，让您戴上耳机时可以清晰地看到。 它很轻——只比一罐汤重一点。但让它感到舒适的是决定将内部结构分开。 电池组位于您的后脑勺上，而屏幕位于前面，这意味着您不会感到前部沉重，这是其他耳机常见的批评。 但还有更好的屏幕。例如，PlayStation VR2 拥有令人难以置信的 OLED 显示屏，尽管没有薄饼镜头。 然而，这些产品的溢价非常高，其成本远远高于 Steam Frame。 当 Meta 于 2023 年 6 月推出 Quest 3 时，其 128GB 型号的零售价为 480 英镑。存储空间更少，但价格却低得多。 三年后，当 Quest 3 感觉像是一个转折点时，很难相信 VR 会变得越来越贵。 “今天的虚拟现实最终是一个高端利基市场，”游戏作家克里斯托弗·德林告诉我。 “Meta 一直在补贴 Quest 硬件，很难想象他们会在放弃这些体验时继续前进。” 当然，价格上涨是有原因的。人工智能开发人员正在建造巨大的数据中心，其中充满了强大服务器的机架，使用许多与制造 Steam Frame 等设备所需的相同组件。 从 2025 年 10 月到 2026 年初，仅公羊的价格就上涨了一倍多。与此同时，我几个月前花 500 英镑购买的显卡现在价格接近 650 英镑。 随着价格越来越高，硬件开发商别无选择，只能自己开发。 Valve 开发者杰里米·塞兰 (Jeremy Selan) 表示：“我们打算推出一款价格更加实惠的设备。” “但全球公羊市场对我们的影响就像对每个人的影响一样。” “价格太贵是最大的想法之一......

reflection.en: The Steam Frame headset is lauded for its excellent technology and comfortable design, but its steep price of £1,089 raises questions about accessibility. This echoes the biblical caution that while knowledge and capability may advance, not everything that can be done is necessarily beneficial or wise for all people.
reflection.zh: Steam Frame头显因其出色的技术和舒适的设计而受到赞扬，但其高达1089英镑的昂贵价格引发了关于可及性的问题。这呼应了圣经中的告诫：虽然知识和能力可能在进步，但并非所有能做到的事情都对所有人有益或明智。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: What is AI, how does it work and why are some people concerned about it?
title.zh: 人工智能是什么，它是如何工作的，为什么有些人担心它？

summary.en: AI is transforming modern life, but not without worry for some that it may be abused or have an adverse environmental impact.
summary.zh: 人工智能正在改变现代生活，但有些人担心它可能被滥用或对环境产生不利影响。

body.en:
The technology takes many forms - from personalising social media feeds to spotting friends in smartphone photos - and accelerating medical breakthroughs.

But the rise of chatbots like OpenAI's ChatGPT has prompted concern about the tech's environmental impact, ethical implications and data use.

Recent claims that AI could become too powerful and threaten humanity have also triggered calls for slower development and tighter regulation.

AI allows computers to process large amounts of data, identify patterns and follow detailed instructions about what to do with that information.

However, scientists have developed systems that can perform tasks which usually require human intelligence, trying to replicate how people acquire and use knowledge.

This could be trying to anticipate what product an online shopper might buy, based on previous purchases, in order to recommend items.

The technology is also behind voice-controlled virtual assistants like Apple's Siri and Amazon's Alexa, and is being used to develop systems for self-driving cars.

AI also helps social platforms like Facebook, TikTok and X decide what posts to show users. Streaming services Spotify and Deezer use AI to suggest music.

There are also a number of applications in medicine, as scientists use AI to help spot cancers, review X-ray results, speed up diagnoses and identify new treatments.

Generative AI is used to create new content which can seem like it has been made by a human.

It does this by learning from vast quantities of existing data such as online text and images.

ChatGPT and Chinese rival DeepSeek's chatbot are popular generative AI tools that can be used to produce text, images, code and more material.

Apps like Midjourney or Veo 3 are dedicated to creating images or video from simple text prompts.

Songs mimicking the style or sound of famous musicians have gone viral , sometimes leaving fans confused about their authenticity.

While acknowledging AI's potential, some experts are worried about the implications of its rapid growth.

The International Monetary Fund (IMF) suggested that AI could affect nearly 40% of jobs , and worsen global financial inequality.

Prof Geoffrey Hinton, a computer scientist regarded as a "godfather" of AI development, warned powerful AI systems could even make humans extinct - although his fear was dismissed by his fellow "AI godfather", Yann LeCun .

In September 2026 similar fears were raised again after some AI researchers warned the tech could threaten humanity in the near future .

But experts have urged a focus on present risks and AI dangers - such as its potential to reproduce biased information, or discriminate against some social groups .

This is because public data used to train many AI systems can reflect existing societal...
body.zh: 该技术有多种形式——从个性化社交媒体信息到在智能手机照片中识别朋友——并加速医学突破。 但 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 等聊天机器人的兴起引发了人们对该技术的环境影响、道德影响和数据使用的担忧。 最近有关人工智能可能变得过于强大并威胁人类的说法也引发了要求放慢发展和加强监管的呼声。 人工智能允许计算机处理大量数据、识别模式并遵循有关如何处理这些信息的详细说明。 然而，科学家们已经开发出可以执行通常需要人类智能的任务的系统，试图复制人们获取和使用知识的方式。 这可能是试图根据之前的购买情况来预测在线购物者可能会购买什么产品，以便推荐商品。 该技术还支持苹果 Siri 和亚马逊 Alexa 等语音控制虚拟助手，并被用于开发自动驾驶汽车系统。 人工智能还帮助 Facebook、TikTok 和 X 等社交平台决定向用户展示哪些帖子。流媒体服务 Spotify 和 Deezer 使用人工智能来推荐音乐。 人工智能在医学领域也有许多应用，科学家利用人工智能来帮助发现癌症、审查 X 射线结果、加快诊断速度并确定新的治疗方法。 生成式人工智能用于创建看起来像是人类制作的新内容。 它通过学习大量现有数据（例如在线文本和图像）来实现这一点。 ChatGPT 和中国竞争对手 DeepSeek 的聊天机器人是流行的生成式人工智能工具，可用于生成文本、图像、代码和更多材料。 Midjourney 或 Veo 3 等应用程序专门用于根据简单的文本提示创建图像或视频。 模仿著名音乐家的风格或声音的歌曲在网上疯传，有时让歌迷对它们的真实性感到困惑。 在承认人工智能的潜力的同时，一些专家担心其快速增长的影响。 国际货币基金组织（IMF）表示，人工智能可能影响近40%的就业岗位，并加剧全球金融不平等。 被视为人工智能发展“教父”的计算机科学家杰弗里·辛顿（Geoffrey Hinton）教授警告说，强大的人工智能系统甚至可能使人类灭绝——尽管他的“人工智能教父”同行扬·勒昆（Yann LeCun）驳回了他的担忧。 2026 年 9 月，一些人工智能研究人员警告该技术可能在不久的将来威胁人类后，类似的担忧再次出现。 但专家们敦促关注当前的风险和人工智能的危险，例如它可能复制有偏见的信息，或歧视某些社会群体。 这是因为用于训练许多人工智能系统的公共数据可以反映现有的社会……

reflection.en: Artificial intelligence offers remarkable advancements, from medical breakthroughs to personalized experiences. Yet, as this report notes, the rapid development of AI also brings significant ethical and environmental concerns. The Apostle Paul reminds us that while many things are permissible, not all are beneficial, urging us to consider the true impact of...
reflection.zh: 人工智能带来了非凡的进步，从医学突破到个性化体验。然而，正如本报道所指出的，人工智能的快速发展也带来了重大的伦理和环境问题。使徒保罗提醒我们，虽然许多事情是允许的，但并非所有事情都有益，敦促我们考虑我们创新的真正影响。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

strap.zh: 雅伟所造的世界——它的奇妙，以及一个渐暖、渐伤的地球所付的代价。

title.en: Indonesian wildfires threaten leading orangutan research site in Borneo
title.zh: 印度尼西亚野火威胁婆罗洲猩猩主要研究地

summary.en: Critically endangered Bornean orangutans are fleeing their forest homes as staff at the Cabang Panti research site work tirelessly to combat a wildfire. The blaze has reached within 200 meters of the Rangkong research station, a satellite of the main Cabang Panti station in Gunung Palung national park, threatening one...
summary.zh: 极度濒危的婆罗洲猩猩正逃离森林家园，而卡邦潘提研究站的工作人员正不懈努力地扑灭野火。大火已逼近 Gunung Palung 国家公园内卡邦潘提研究站卫星站Rangkong研究站200米以内，威胁着全球最长期的野生猿类研究之一。

body.en: Critically endangered Bornean orangutans flee forests as staff at Cabang Panti work round the clock to stave off blaze Wildfires in Indonesia are sweeping through a critical research site for Bornean orangutans and are now threatening a celebrated research camp, home to one of the world’s longest-running studies of wild apes. In the past few days, the fires have burned within 200 metres of Rangkong research station, a satellite of Cabang Panti research station, which lies about four miles north in Gunung Palung national park. Continue reading...
body.zh: 极度濒临灭绝的婆罗洲猩猩逃离森林，卡邦潘蒂的工作人员昼夜不停地工作以扑灭大火。印度尼西亚的野火正在席卷婆罗洲猩猩的一个重要研究地点，现在正威胁着一个著名的研究营地，这里是世界上进行时间最长的野生猿研究的所在地。过去几天，大火已蔓延至Rangkong研究站200米范围内，Rangkong研究站是Cabang Panti研究站的卫星，位于Gunung Palung国家公园以北约4英里。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The fires raging through Borneo's forests are a stark reminder of creation's vulnerability. The orangutans' flight and the researchers' desperate efforts to save their site echo the Apostle Paul's description of all creation groaning in travail, awaiting redemption. May we recognize our role in stewarding this fragile world and act with greater care.
reflection.zh: 在婆罗洲森林中肆虐的大火，是对受造界脆弱性的严峻提醒。猩猩的逃离和研究人员拯救其研究点的绝望努力，呼应了使徒保罗所描述的，万物一同劳苦叹息，等候得赎的情形。愿我们认识到自己在这脆弱世界上的管家之责，并以更大的关怀去行动。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

This sixth arribada of the season saw thousands of turtles gather on the beach in less than 48 hours to lay eggs. While these turtles play a vital role in marine ecosystems, the climate crisis poses a significant...
